```{r}
counts <- GetAssayData(amnion_seurat_object[["RNA"]], layer = "counts")
metadata <- amnion_seurat_object@meta.data

# -------------------------
# 2) Build new Seurat object
# -------------------------
obj <- CreateSeuratObject(
  counts = counts,
  meta.data = metadata,
  assay = "RNA",
  project = "Amnion_Rebuild"
)

# -------------------------
# 3) Preprocessing
# -------------------------
# Normalize
obj <- NormalizeData(obj, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 1e4)

# Find variable features
obj <- FindVariableFeatures(obj, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 3000)

# Scale data
obj <- ScaleData(obj, features = rownames(obj))

# -------------------------
# 4) PCA
# -------------------------
obj <- RunPCA(obj, features = VariableFeatures(obj), verbose = FALSE)

# -------------------------
# 5) Neighbors and Clustering
# -------------------------
obj <- FindNeighbors(obj, dims = 1:20)
obj <- FindClusters(obj, resolution = 0.5)

# -------------------------
# 6) UMAP
# -------------------------
obj <- RunUMAP(obj, dims = 1:20)

amnion_seurat_object <- obj

amnion_seurat_object <- ScaleData(amnion_seurat_object, features = VariableFeatures(amnion_seurat_object), verbose = FALSE)
rm(obj)
rm(counts)

amnion_all <- amnion_seurat_object
gc()

```

# Figure 1: Overview

#### UMAP Cell Type

# Figure 1

## c umap celltype

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggrastr)
library(shadowtext)   # install.packages("shadowtext") -- gives white halo on labels

# ---- 1. Clean names and fix the ordering ------------------------------------
amnion_seurat_object[["Cell Type"]] <- amnion_seurat_object$cell_type %>%
  str_replace_all("_", " ") %>%
  str_replace_all("[0-9]", "") %>%
  str_replace_all("Macrophage- Mother", "Macrophage Mother") %>%
  str_replace_all("Macrophage- Fetus", "Macrophage Fetus")

# alphabetical order -> number 1..n
ct_levels <- sort(unique(amnion_seurat_object$`Cell Type`))
amnion_seurat_object$`Cell Type` <- factor(amnion_seurat_object$`Cell Type`,
                                           levels = ct_levels)

# legend labels: "1  CTB Fetus", "2  Decidual Mother", ...
legend_labels <- paste0(seq_along(ct_levels), "  ", ct_levels)
names(legend_labels) <- ct_levels

# ---- 2. Cluster centroids for the on-plot numbers ---------------------------
umap_df <- data.frame(
  Embeddings(amnion_seurat_object, "umap")[, 1:2],
  cell_type = amnion_seurat_object$`Cell Type`
)
colnames(umap_df)[1:2] <- c("UMAP_1", "UMAP_2")

centroids <- umap_df %>%
  group_by(cell_type) %>%
  summarise(UMAP_1 = median(UMAP_1),      # median = robust to stragglers
            UMAP_2 = median(UMAP_2),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(label = as.integer(factor(cell_type, levels = ct_levels)))

# ---- 3. Build the plot ------------------------------------------------------
p <- DimPlot(amnion_seurat_object, reduction = "umap",
             group.by = "Cell Type", pt.size = 0.1, raster = FALSE) +
  scale_colour_discrete(labels = legend_labels) +
  geom_shadowtext(data = centroids,
                  aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2, label = label),
                  inherit.aes = FALSE,
                  size     = 7 / .pt,      # 7 pt
                  fontface = "bold",
                  colour   = "black",
                  bg.colour= "white",
                  bg.r     = 0.15) +
  theme_ncb() +
  labs(title = NULL, x = "UMAP 1", y = "UMAP 2") +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(
    override.aes = list(size = 1.5),
    ncol = 1,
    keyheight = unit(3, "mm"))) +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank())

p <- rasterize(p, layers = "Point", dpi = 600)

save_panel(p, "Figure1/panel_c_umap_celltype",
           width_mm = 114.366, height_mm = 91.151)

print(p)
```



```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(writexl)
library(ggplot2)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. CONSOLIDATE MOTHER/FETUS ORIGINS FROM THE CLEANED "Cell Type"
# ---------------------------------------------------------

# Use @meta.data to safely extract the column as a true atomic vector
amnion_seurat_object[["Broad_Cell_Type"]] <- amnion_seurat_object@meta.data[["Cell Type"]] %>%
  # Remove the words "Mother" or "Fetus"
  str_remove_all("Mother|Fetus") %>%
  # Clean up any trailing spaces or hyphens left over
  str_trim() %>%
  str_replace_all("-$", "") %>%
  str_trim()

# Set the active identity to this new combined column
Idents(amnion_seurat_object) <- "Broad_Cell_Type"

# Quick sanity check: Print the new consolidated groups to your console
print(unique(Idents(amnion_seurat_object)))


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2. RUN DIFFERENTIAL EXPRESSION
# ---------------------------------------------------------

# Ensure you are operating on the RNA assay
DefaultAssay(amnion_seurat_object) <- "RNA"

# (Optional: Uncomment if using Seurat v5 and layers need joining)
# amnion_seurat_object <- JoinLayers(amnion_seurat_object)

# Find markers for the consolidated cell types
all_markers <- FindAllMarkers(amnion_seurat_object, 
                              only.pos = TRUE, 
                              min.pct = 0.25, 
                              logfc.threshold = 0.25)

# Extract the top 20 markers per consolidated cell type
top20 <- all_markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = avg_log2FC, n = 20)


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3. SAVE TO EXCEL
# ---------------------------------------------------------

# Create a new main folder for these broad markers
main_dir <- "Amnion_Broad_Markers"
if (!dir.exists(main_dir)) {
  dir.create(main_dir)
}

# Save the outputs
write_xlsx(all_markers, file.path(main_dir, "all_broad_cell_type_markers.xlsx"))
write_xlsx(top20, file.path(main_dir, "top_20_broad_markers_per_cell_type.xlsx"))


cat("Done! The broad analysis is finished using the cleaned up 'Cell Type' data. Outputs are in:", main_dir, "\n")
```

# Figure 2: General Change and HSP70/90.

### DEG Bulk

```{r}
amnion_no_graphs <- amnion_seurat_object
amnion_no_graphs@graphs <- list()

all_seurat_object_filtered <- subset(amnion_no_graphs, subset = timepoint %in% c("Week_25", "Week_38"))
all_seurat_object_filtered <- subset(all_seurat_object_filtered, subset = tissue_source %in% c("Peripher"))

pseudo_bulk <- AggregateExpression(all_seurat_object_filtered, assays = "RNA", return.seurat = T, group.by = c("timepoint_plus", "Donor_Nr", "cell_type"))

pseudo_bulk$celltype.stim <- paste(pseudo_bulk$timepoint_plus, pseudo_bulk$cell_type, sep = "_")
Idents(pseudo_bulk) <- "celltype.stim"
```

```{r}
# Create a list to store DE results
de_results <- list()

# Get unique cell types
cell_types <- unique(pseudo_bulk$cell_type)

# Iterate over each cell type
for (cell_type in cell_types) {
  ident_1 <- paste("Week-25", cell_type, sep = "_")
  ident_2 <- paste("Week-38", cell_type, sep = "_")
  
  # Get the number of cells in each group
  cells_1 <- WhichCells(pseudo_bulk, idents = ident_1)
  cells_2 <- WhichCells(pseudo_bulk, idents = ident_2)
  
  # Check if both groups have at least 3 cells
  if (length(cells_1) >= 3 & length(cells_2) >= 3) {
    # Perform differential expression analysis
    de_result <- FindMarkers(object = pseudo_bulk, 
                             ident.1 = ident_2, 
                             ident.2 = ident_1,
                             test.use = "DESeq2",
                             logfc.threshold = 0.0)
    
    # Ensure gene names are preserved as row names
    de_result$Gene <- rownames(de_result)
    
    # Store results in a list
    de_results[[cell_type]] <- de_result
  } else {
    message(paste("Skipping", cell_type, "because one or both groups have fewer than 3 cells."))
  }
}

# Write results to an Excel file if there are valid comparisons
if (length(de_results) > 0) {
  # Save each DE result as a separate sheet in the Excel file
  output_file <- "DE_results.xlsx"
  write.xlsx(de_results, file = output_file, rowNames = TRUE)  # rowNames=TRUE ensures gene names are included
  message("DE analysis results saved to DE_results.xlsx")
} else {
  message("No valid comparisons. No file was created.")
}

pb_counts <- GetAssayData(pseudo_bulk, layer = "counts", assay = "RNA")
```

# Figure 2

## b dotplot NOLABELS

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

genes_to_label <- c("PAPPA", "PAPPA2", "NOTUM", "HPGD", "ZEB1", "TFAP2A",
                    "TCF7L1", "TCF7L2", "WNT5A", "VTCN1", "LAMB1", "COL5A2",
                    "COL12A1", "TGFBI", "MMP2", "MRC1", "CD163", "IGFBP3",
                    "COL4A1", "COL4A2", "COL4A3", "COL4A5", "COL4A6")

desired_order <- rev(c(
  "Endometrial Mother", "Decidual Mother", "Fibroblast Mother", "LED Mother",
  "Macrophage Mother", "T-Cell-Resting Mother", "HSC Mother",
  "EVT Fetus", "CTB Fetus", "Stromal Fetus", "Epithelial Fetus"))

plot_df <- de_df %>%
  filter(p_val_adj < 0.05) %>%
  mutate(CellType = CellType %>%
           str_replace_all("_", " ") %>%
           str_replace_all("[0-9]", "") %>%
           str_replace_all("-(Mother|Fetus)", " \\1") %>%
           str_replace_all("Macrophage- Mother", "Macrophage Mother") %>%
           str_replace_all("Macrophage- Fetus", "Macrophage Fetus"),
         CellType = factor(CellType, levels = desired_order))

set.seed(123)
plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(CellType)) %>%
  mutate(y_num = as.numeric(CellType),
         y_jit = y_num + runif(n(), -0.28, 0.28))

label_df <- plot_df %>%
  filter(Gene %in% genes_to_label) %>%
  filter(!(CellType == "Epithelial Fetus" & !str_detect(Gene, "^COL4A")))

# ---- 1. the plot WITHOUT labels (final artwork) -----------------------------
p_base <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = avg_log2FC, y = y_jit, colour = p_val_adj)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.4, stroke = 0, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq_along(desired_order),
                     labels = desired_order,
                     expand = expansion(add = 0.7)) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.05)) +
  theme_ncb() +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_line(linewidth = 0.15, colour = "grey92"),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        legend.key.width   = unit(3, "mm"),
        legend.key.height  = unit(3, "mm")) +
  labs(y = NULL, x = "Log2 fold change", colour = "Adjusted\nP value")

save_panel(p_base, "Figure2/panel_b_dotplot_NOLABELS",
           width_mm = 78, height_mm = 117)

# ---- 2. same plot WITH plain labels, identical scales (guide layer) ---------
p_lab <- p_base +
  geom_text(data = label_df, aes(label = Gene),
            size = 7 / .pt, colour = "black", hjust = 0, nudge_x = 0.15)

save_panel(p_lab, "Figure2/panel_b_dotplot_WITHLABELS",
           width_mm = 78, height_mm = 117)

print(p_lab)
```

```{r}
amnion_seurat_object_nocon@meta.data <- amnion_seurat_object_nocon@meta.data %>%
  mutate(layer_and_gestation2 = gsub("_", " ", layer_and_gestation)) %>%
  mutate(layer_and_gestation2 = case_when(
    Donor_Nr %in% c("26", "41") & layer == "Amnion" ~ "Amnion Preterm Preeclampsia",
    Donor_Nr %in% c("26", "41") & layer == "Chorion" ~ "Chorion Preterm Preeclampsia",
    TRUE ~ layer_and_gestation2
  ))

metadata <- amnion_seurat_object_nocon@meta.data
```

```{r}

library(viridis)
library(RColorBrewer)

n_colors = 17
n_colors <- length(unique(amnion_seurat_object_nocon$cell_type))
color_palette <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(12, "Paired"))(n_colors)

# Step 1: Calculate actual cell counts

cell_counts <- amnion_seurat_object_nocon@meta.data %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  group_by(samples, layer_and_gestation2, cell_type) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(Cell_Count = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop")


# Step 2: Get all unique samples and cell types (only)
all_samples <- unique(amnion_seurat_object_nocon@meta.data$samples)
all_cell_types <- unique(amnion_seurat_object_nocon@meta.data$cell_type)

# Step 3: Expand data to include all sample–cell_type combinations
# Only existing combinations of (sample, layer_and_gestation2) are kept
cell_counts_complete <- cell_counts %>%
  group_by(samples, layer_and_gestation2) %>%
  complete(cell_type = all_cell_types, fill = list(Cell_Count = 0)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Step 4: Calculate total and percentages per sample
sample_percentage_data <- cell_counts_complete %>%
  group_by(samples) %>%
  mutate(
    Total_Cells = sum(Cell_Count),
    Sample_Percentage = ifelse(Total_Cells > 0, (Cell_Count / Total_Cells) * 100, 0)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(samples, layer_and_gestation2, cell_type, Sample_Percentage)

# Ensure correct ordering of 'layer_and_gestation22' factor in sample data
sample_percentage_data <- sample_percentage_data %>%
  mutate(layer_and_gestation2 = factor(layer_and_gestation2, levels = c("Amnion Midterm","Amnion Preterm","Amnion Preterm Preeclampsia","Amnion Term", "Amnion Term Placenta","Chorion Midterm","Chorion Preterm","Chorion Preterm Preeclampsia","Chorion Term","Chorion Term Placenta")))

# Step 2: Calculate mean and standard error for each cell type within each layer_and_gestation2
error_data <- sample_percentage_data %>%
  group_by(layer_and_gestation2, cell_type) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Mean_Percentage = mean(Sample_Percentage),
    SE_Percentage = sd(Sample_Percentage) #/ sqrt(n())
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


# Calculate the number of cells per cell_type within each group
cell_type_counts <- metadata %>%
  group_by(layer_and_gestation2, cell_type) %>%
  tally(name = "cell_type_count") # Rename 'n' to 'cell_type_count' directly

# Calculate the total number of cells per group
total_counts <- metadata %>%
  group_by(layer_and_gestation2) %>%
  tally(name = "total_cell_count")

# Merge counts and calculate percentages
cell_type_percentages <- cell_type_counts %>%
  left_join(total_counts, by = "layer_and_gestation2") %>%
  mutate(percentage = (cell_type_count / total_cell_count) * 100)

# Define the order of the groups
group_order <- c("Amnion Midterm","Amnion Preterm","Amnion Preterm Preeclampsia","Amnion Term", "Amnion Term Placenta","Chorion Midterm","Chorion Preterm","Chorion Preterm Preeclampsia","Chorion Term","Chorion Term Placenta")

# Reorder the groups in the data frame
cell_type_percentages <- cell_type_percentages %>%
  mutate(layer_and_gestation2 = factor(layer_and_gestation2, levels = group_order))

# Add a new column with the total count for each cell type across all groups
cell_type_percentages <- cell_type_percentages %>%
  group_by(cell_type) %>%
  mutate(total_cell_type_count = sum(cell_type_count, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()  # Remove grouping

# Create a named vector for facet labels including total cell counts per cell type
facet_labels <- cell_type_percentages %>%
  distinct(cell_type, total_cell_type_count) %>%  # Keep unique cell_type and its total
  mutate(label = paste0(cell_type, "\n (Total: ", total_cell_type_count, ")")) %>%
  dplyr::select(cell_type, label) %>%
  deframe()



```


```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Step 0: Create a tissue type column based on cell_type or layer_and_gestation2
error_data <- error_data %>%
  mutate(tissue = ifelse(grepl("Amnion", layer_and_gestation2), "Amnion", "Chorion"))

sample_percentage_data <- sample_percentage_data %>%
  mutate(tissue = ifelse(grepl("Amnion", layer_and_gestation2), "Amnion", "Chorion"))

# Define colors for the two tissues
tissue_colors <- c("Amnion" = "#1f78b4",  # blue
                   "Chorion" = "#33a02c") # green

# Update facet labels, keeping the totals intact
facet_labels <- sapply(facet_labels, function(label) {
  parts <- str_split(label, "\n", simplify = TRUE)
  cell_type <- parts[1] %>%
    str_replace_all("_", " ") %>%          # Replace underscores with spaces
    str_replace_all("[0-9]", "") %>%       # Remove numbers
    str_replace_all("Macrophage- Mother", "Macrophage Mother") %>% # Special cases
    str_replace_all("Macrophage- Fetus", "Macrophage Fetus") %>%
    str_squish()                            # Remove extra spaces
  paste(cell_type, parts[2], sep = "\n")   # Recombine with the total
})

```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(patchwork)

# ---- group column -----------------------------------------------------------
add_group <- function(df) {
  df %>% mutate(group = ifelse(str_detect(cell_type, "_Mother$"), "Mother", "Fetus"))
}
error_data             <- add_group(error_data)
sample_percentage_data <- add_group(sample_percentage_data)

error_mother  <- error_data             %>% filter(group == "Mother")
error_fetus   <- error_data             %>% filter(group == "Fetus")
sample_mother <- sample_percentage_data %>% filter(group == "Mother")
sample_fetus  <- sample_percentage_data %>% filter(group == "Fetus")

clean <- function(x) {
  x %>% str_replace_all("_", " ") %>% str_replace_all("[0-9]", "") %>%
        str_replace_all("Macrophage- Mother", "Macrophage Mother") %>%
        str_replace_all("Macrophage- Fetus",  "Macrophage Fetus") %>% str_squish()
}

mother_order <- clean(c("Endometrial_Mother","Decidual_Mother","Fibroblast_Mother",
                        "LED_Mother","Macrophage-1_Mother","NK-cell_Mother",
                        "T-Cell-Resting_Mother","HSC_Mother"))
fetus_order  <- clean(c("CTB_Fetus","EVT_Fetus","Stromal1_Fetus","LED_Fetus",
                        "Macrophage-2_Fetus","Epithelial_Fetus"))

# pad fetal side to 8 slots so both columns have equal facet heights
fetus_order_padded <- c(" ", "  ", fetus_order)   # blanks at TOP

error_mother$cell_type  <- factor(clean(error_mother$cell_type),  levels = mother_order)
sample_mother$cell_type <- factor(clean(sample_mother$cell_type), levels = mother_order)
error_fetus$cell_type   <- factor(clean(error_fetus$cell_type),   levels = fetus_order_padded)
sample_fetus$cell_type  <- factor(clean(sample_fetus$cell_type),  levels = fetus_order_padded)

# ---- abbreviated x labels ---------------------------------------------------
short_lab <- c("Amnion Midterm"               = "Am Mid",
               "Amnion Preterm"               = "Am Pre",
               "Amnion Preterm Preeclampsia"  = "Am PE",
               "Amnion Term"                  = "Am Term",
               "Amnion Term Placenta"         = "Am Pl",
               "Chorion Midterm"              = "Ch Mid",
               "Chorion Preterm"              = "Ch Pre",
               "Chorion Preterm Preeclampsia" = "Ch PE",
               "Chorion Term"                 = "Ch Term",
               "Chorion Term Placenta"        = "Ch Pl")

tissue_cols <- c("Amnion" = "#1f78b4", "Chorion" = "#33a02c")

make_col <- function(err, smp, title, lvls) {
  ggplot(err, aes(x = layer_and_gestation2, y = Mean_Percentage, fill = tissue)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.9), width = 0.75, linewidth = 0) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pmax(Mean_Percentage - SE_Percentage, 0),
                      ymax = Mean_Percentage + SE_Percentage),
                  width = 0.25, linewidth = 0.2,
                  position = position_dodge(0.9), colour = "grey30", na.rm = TRUE) +
    geom_point(data = smp, aes(y = Sample_Percentage),
               position = position_jitter(width = 0.18, seed = 123),
               size = 1, stroke = 0, colour = "grey25", alpha = 0.8, na.rm = TRUE) +
    facet_wrap(~cell_type, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y", drop = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = tissue_cols) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = short_lab, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08)),
                       breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(3)) +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = "Percentage (%)") +
    theme_ncb() +
    theme(axis.text.x        = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 7),
          axis.text.y        = element_text(size = 7),
          strip.text         = element_text(size = 7, margin = margin(b = 0.5, unit = "mm")),
          plot.title         = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0.5),
          panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
          panel.spacing.y    = unit(0.8, "mm"),
          legend.position    = "none")
}

p_mother <- make_col(error_mother, sample_mother, "Maternal cells", mother_order)
p_fetus  <- make_col(error_fetus,  sample_fetus,  "Fetal cells",    fetus_order_padded)

combined <- p_mother | p_fetus

save_panel(combined, "Figure2/panel_a_proportions",
           width_mm = 95, height_mm = 112)

print(combined)
```

### Check for Significance in the Cell Proporotions

```{r}
library(speckle)
set.seed(123)

run_prop <- function(meta, keep, label) {
  m <- meta %>% dplyr::filter(layer_and_gestation2 %in% keep)
  res <- propeller(clusters  = m$cell_type,
                   sample    = m$samples,
                   group     = droplevels(factor(m$layer_and_gestation2)),
                   transform = "logit")
  res$cell_type  <- rownames(res)
  res$comparison <- label
  write.csv(res, file.path("Figure2", paste0("propeller_", label, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
  res
}

meta <- amnion_seurat_object_nocon@meta.data

prop_omnibus       <- propeller(clusters = meta$cell_type, sample = meta$samples,
                                group = meta$layer_and_gestation2, transform = "logit")
prop_amnion_gest   <- run_prop(meta, c("Amnion Midterm",  "Amnion Term"),           "amnion_term_vs_mid")
prop_chorion_gest  <- run_prop(meta, c("Chorion Midterm", "Chorion Term"),          "chorion_term_vs_mid")
prop_amnion_place  <- run_prop(meta, c("Amnion Term",     "Amnion Term Placenta"),  "amnion_placenta_vs_periph")
prop_chorion_place <- run_prop(meta, c("Chorion Term",    "Chorion Term Placenta"), "chorion_placenta_vs_periph")

prop_amnion_gest[order(prop_amnion_gest$FDR), ]
prop_chorion_gest[order(prop_chorion_gest$FDR), ]
```

### HSP heatshock only maternal and fetal total 


```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

SCORE_COL <- "HeatShock1"
stopifnot(SCORE_COL %in% colnames(amnion_seurat_object@meta.data))

# ---- 1. Long data, collapsed to cell origin ---------------------------------
md <- amnion_seurat_object@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    Donor_Nr, cell_type, timepoint,
    score  = .data[[SCORE_COL]],
    Origin = factor(ifelse(grepl("_Mother$", cell_type), "Maternal", "Fetal"),
                    levels = c("Maternal", "Fetal")),
    Timepoint = factor(gsub("_", " ", timepoint),
                       levels = c("Week 25", "Week 30", "Week 34", "Week 38")))

# ---- 2. Donor-level means ----------------------------------------------------
donor <- md %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Origin, Timepoint, Donor_Nr) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(mean_score = mean(score, na.rm = TRUE),
                   n_nuclei   = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop")

# ---- 3. Statistics: week 25 vs week 38 within each origin -------------------
stats <- donor %>%
  dplyr::filter(Timepoint %in% c("Week 25", "Week 38")) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Origin) %>%
  dplyr::group_modify(~{
    tt <- t.test(mean_score ~ Timepoint, data = .x, var.equal = FALSE)
    m  <- .x %>% dplyr::group_by(Timepoint) %>%
            dplyr::summarise(m = mean(mean_score), s = sd(mean_score),
                             n = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop")
    sp <- sqrt(((m$n[1]-1)*m$s[1]^2 + (m$n[2]-1)*m$s[2]^2) / (sum(m$n)-2))
    tibble::tibble(n_week25 = m$n[1], n_week38 = m$n[2],
                   mean_week25 = m$m[1], mean_week38 = m$m[2],
                   sd_week25 = m$s[1],   sd_week38 = m$s[2],
                   t_statistic = unname(tt$statistic),
                   df = unname(tt$parameter), p_value = tt$p.value,
                   cohens_d = (m$m[2] - m$m[1]) / sp)
  }) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(p_adjusted = p.adjust(p_value, "BH"),
                significance = as.character(
                  cut(p_adjusted, c(-Inf,.001,.01,.05,Inf),
                      c("***","**","*","ns"))),
                test = "two-sided Welch t-test on donor means, BH-adjusted")

cat("\n=========== HEAT SHOCK: MATERNAL vs FETAL ===========\n")
print(as.data.frame(stats %>%
  dplyr::select(Origin, n_week25, n_week38, mean_week25, mean_week38,
                t_statistic, df, p_value, p_adjusted, significance, cohens_d)))

# ---- 4. Significance bracket, week 25 to week 38 -----------------------------
y_top <- quantile(md$score, 0.995, na.rm = TRUE)

bracket <- stats %>%
  dplyr::transmute(Origin,
                   x    = as.numeric(Origin) - 0.30,   # week 25 violin
                   xend = as.numeric(Origin) + 0.30,   # week 38 violin
                   y    = y_top * 1.04,
                   label = ifelse(significance == "ns",
                                  sprintf("ns (P = %.3f)", p_adjusted),
                                  sprintf("%s (P = %.3g)", significance, p_adjusted)))

# ---- 5. Violin panel ---------------------------------------------------------
p <- ggplot(md, aes(x = Origin, y = score, fill = Timepoint)) +
  geom_violin(scale = "width", trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.75,
              linewidth = 0.15, colour = "grey30",
              position = position_dodge(0.8)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.12, outlier.shape = NA, linewidth = 0.15,
               position = position_dodge(0.8), show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_segment(data = bracket, aes(x = x, xend = xend, y = y, yend = y),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_text(data = bracket, aes(x = as.numeric(Origin), y = y * 1.02,
                                label = label),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 7 / .pt, vjust = 0) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(4),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.14))) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-0.3, 1.8)) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1)) +
  theme_ncb() +
  theme(axis.text.x        = element_text(size = 7),
        axis.text.y        = element_text(size = 7),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        panel.border       = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA,
                                          linewidth = 0.25),
        plot.title         = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0.5,
                                          margin = margin(b = 1, unit = "mm")),
        legend.position    = "top",
        legend.title       = element_blank(),
        legend.key.size    = unit(3, "mm"),
        legend.margin      = margin(t = -1, b = -2, unit = "mm")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Module score", title = "Heat Shock Module")

save_panel(p, "Figure2/panel_c_heatshock",
           width_mm = 105, height_mm = 70, source_data = FALSE)
print(p)

# ---- 6. Source data ----------------------------------------------------------
sd_add("Fig2c_HeatShock_donor_values", as.data.frame(donor))
sd_add("Fig2c_HeatShock_statistics",   as.data.frame(stats))

# ---- 7. Legend sentence ------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n=========== FOR THE FIGURE LEGEND ===========\n")
for (i in seq_len(nrow(stats))) {
  r <- stats[i, ]
  cat(sprintf("  %s cells: t(%.2f) = %.2f, adjusted P = %s, Cohen's d = %.2f (n = %d vs %d donors)\n",
              r$Origin, r$df, r$t_statistic,
              ifelse(r$p_adjusted < 0.001, "< 0.001", signif(r$p_adjusted, 3)),
              r$cohens_d, r$n_week25, r$n_week38))
}

```

### Quantifaction Plot from the Image Staining

## d HSPA2

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)

# ---- 1. Read and annotate ---------------------------------------------------
df <- read_csv("HSPA2_measurements.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    Timepoint = ifelse(str_detect(Image, "HT"), "Week 38", "Week 25"),
    Donor_raw = str_split_i(Image, " - ", 1)
  ) %>%
  group_by(Timepoint) %>%
  mutate(Donor = paste0("Donor_", as.integer(factor(Donor_raw,
                                                    levels = unique(Donor_raw))))) %>%
  ungroup()

# excluded in the original analysis: single-scene image with very low detections
df_root <- df %>% filter(!str_detect(Image, fixed("250414_HSPA2.czi")))

# ---- 2. Donor-level weighted percent positive -------------------------------
donor_summary <- df_root %>%
  group_by(Donor, Timepoint) %>%
  summarise(Total_Positive = sum(`Num Positive`,   na.rm = TRUE),
            Total_Detected = sum(`Num Detections`, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Percent_Positive = Total_Positive / Total_Detected * 100)

stats_df <- donor_summary %>%
  group_by(Timepoint) %>%
  summarise(median = median(Percent_Positive),
            sd     = sd(Percent_Positive),
            n      = n(), .groups = "drop")

print(donor_summary)
print(stats_df)

# ---- 3. Welch t-test --------------------------------------------------------
tt <- t.test(Percent_Positive ~ Timepoint, data = donor_summary, var.equal = FALSE)
print(tt)

p_val  <- tt$p.value
p_star <- cut(p_val, c(-Inf, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, Inf), c("***", "**", "*", "ns"))
cat(sprintf("p = %.4f  ->  %s\n", p_val, p_star))

# ---- 4. Plot ----------------------------------------------------------------
set.seed(1)
y_top <- max(donor_summary$Percent_Positive) * 1.18

p <- ggplot(donor_summary, aes(x = Timepoint, y = Percent_Positive)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0, size = 2, stroke = 0,
              colour = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(data = stats_df,
                aes(x = Timepoint, y = median,
                    ymin = median - sd, ymax = median + sd),
                width = 0.18, linewidth = 0.3, colour = "red", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_point(data = stats_df, aes(x = Timepoint, y = median),
             size = 2.5, stroke = 0, colour = "red", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  # significance bracket
  annotate("segment", x = 1, xend = 2, y = y_top, yend = y_top, linewidth = 0.25) +
  annotate("segment", x = 1, xend = 1, y = y_top, yend = y_top * 0.975, linewidth = 0.25) +
  annotate("segment", x = 2, xend = 2, y = y_top, yend = y_top * 0.975, linewidth = 0.25) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = y_top * 1.01, label = as.character(p_star),
           size = 8 / .pt, vjust = 0) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, y_top * 1.12),
                     breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(5),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  theme_ncb() +
  theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.25),
        plot.title   = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0.5,
                                    margin = margin(b = 1, unit = "mm"))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Percent positive cells (%)", title = "HSPA2")

save_panel(p, "Figure2/panel_d_HSPA2", width_mm = 50, height_mm = 70)

print(p)

```

```{r}
library(svglite)

OUTDIR   <- "FigureCCC"
SIZE_MM  <- 90     # per circos panel: 2 x 86 + 8 mm gutter = 180 mm
TOP_N    <- 30     # reduce further (15) if labels still collide
 
dir.create(OUTDIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
 
 
# ---- 1. Build the prioritized table -----------------------------------------
prioritized_tbl_oi_all <- get_top_n_lr_pairs(
  multinichenet_output$prioritization_tables,
  top_n = TOP_N, rank_per_group = TRUE)
 
# full ranked list for the supplement / source data
cell_cell_communication <- get_top_n_lr_pairs(
  multinichenet_output$prioritization_tables,
  top_n = 500, rank_per_group = TRUE)
 
writexl::write_xlsx(
  cell_cell_communication,
  file.path(OUTDIR, "cell_cell_communication_multinichenet_midterm_term.xlsx"))
 
prioritized_tbl_oi <-
  multinichenet_output$prioritization_tables$group_prioritization_tbl %>%
  filter(id %in% prioritized_tbl_oi_all$id) %>%
  distinct(id, sender, receiver, ligand, receptor, group) %>%
  left_join(prioritized_tbl_oi_all)
 
prioritized_tbl_oi$prioritization_score[
  is.na(prioritized_tbl_oi$prioritization_score)] <- 0
 
senders_receivers <- union(unique(prioritized_tbl_oi$sender),
                           unique(prioritized_tbl_oi$receiver)) %>% sort()
 
pal <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(11, "Spectral"))(length(senders_receivers))
colors_sender   <- magrittr::set_names(pal, senders_receivers)
colors_receiver <- magrittr::set_names(pal, senders_receivers)
 
# note the drawing order so you can name the files correctly afterwards
group_order <- unique(prioritized_tbl_oi$group)
cat("Groups will be drawn in this order:\n"); print(group_order)
 
 
# ---- 2. Draw the circos DIRECTLY into the svglite device --------------------
svglite::svglite(file.path(OUTDIR, "circos_%03d.svg"),
                 width     = SIZE_MM / 25.4,
                 height    = SIZE_MM / 25.4,
                 pointsize = 7)                 # <- now actually respected
 
par(mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0))
# If labels still come out larger than 7 pt, uncomment the next line and tune:
# par(cex = 7/11)
 
circos.clear()
circos.par(track.margin            = c(0.005, 0.005),
           cell.padding            = c(0, 0, 0, 0),
           gap.degree              = 1,
           points.overflow.warning = FALSE)
 
invisible(make_circos_group_comparison(prioritized_tbl_oi,
                                       colors_sender, colors_receiver))
 
circos.clear()
dev.off()
 
 
# ---- 3. Rename the numbered output to meaningful panel names ----------------
made <- sort(list.files(OUTDIR, pattern = "^circos_\\d+\\.svg$", full.names = TRUE))
cat("\nFiles produced:\n"); print(basename(made))
 
if (length(made) == length(group_order)) {
  targets <- file.path(OUTDIR,
                       sprintf("panel_%s_circos_%s.svg",
                               letters[seq_along(made)],
                               gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "", group_order)))
  file.rename(made, targets)
  cat("\nRenamed to:\n"); print(basename(targets))
} else {
  warning("Number of SVGs (", length(made), ") != number of groups (",
          length(group_order), "). Rename manually after checking each file.")
}
 
 
# ---- 4. Shared cell type legend (180 x 14 mm, sits under both circles) -----
legend_df <- data.frame(
  cell_type = factor(senders_receivers, levels = senders_receivers))
 
p_leg <- ggplot(legend_df, aes(x = 1, y = cell_type, fill = cell_type)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors_sender, name = NULL) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE,      # 2 rows at 180 mm wide
                             keywidth  = unit(2.5, "mm"),
                             keyheight = unit(2.5, "mm"))) +
  theme_void(base_size = 7, base_family = FONT) +
  theme(legend.position  = "bottom",
        legend.text      = element_text(size = 7, family = FONT),
        legend.spacing.x = unit(0.5, "mm"))
```

# Figure 3 — signalling modules

Eight panels: growth factor expression (a), IGF binding proteins (b),
PAPPA1/PAPPA2 (c), VEGFA (d), TGFB ligands (e), TGFB receptors (f), canonical
WNT (g) and WNT inhibitors (h).

Only the six modules that appear in the figure are scored. Statistics are
computed once per panel by a single helper, on donor-level pseudobulk means
with a two-sided Welch t-test, Benjamini–Hochberg correction across the cell
types shown, and Cohen's d. Source data are captured at the same time.

## Objects and module scores

```{r fig3-setup}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(rstatix)

SEED <- 42

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## Two subsets are needed, and they are NOT interchangeable:
##   all_filtered     -- week 25/38, peripheral only. Panel a.
##   amnion_filtered  -- placenta and preeclampsia removed. Panels b-h.
## Neither overwrites amnion_seurat_object.
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
no_graphs <- amnion_seurat_object
no_graphs@graphs <- list()

all_filtered <- subset(no_graphs,
                       subset = timepoint %in% c("Week_25", "Week_38") &
                                tissue_source == "Peripher")

no_graphs@meta.data <- no_graphs@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    layer_and_gestation2 = gsub("_", " ", layer_and_gestation),
    layer_and_gestation2 = dplyr::case_when(
      Donor_Nr %in% c("26", "41") & layer == "Amnion"  ~ "Amnion Preterm Preeclampsia",
      Donor_Nr %in% c("26", "41") & layer == "Chorion" ~ "Chorion Preterm Preeclampsia",
      TRUE ~ layer_and_gestation2))

amnion_filtered <- subset(no_graphs,
  subset = !grepl("Placenta|Preeclampsia", layer_and_gestation2))

cat("all_filtered   :", ncol(all_filtered),    "nuclei\n")
cat("amnion_filtered:", ncol(amnion_filtered), "nuclei\n")
rm(no_graphs)

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## Only the modules shown in Figure 3.
## AddModuleScore draws control gene bins at random, so the seed is fixed.
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
modules <- list(
  IGF_Inhibitors = c("IGFBP1","IGFBP2","IGFBP3","IGFBP4",
                     "IGFBP5","IGFBP6","IGFBP7"),
  IGF_Regulators = c("PAPPA","PAPPA2"),
  TGFB_Ligands   = c("TGFB1","TGFB2","TGFB3"),
  TGFB_Receptors = c("TGFBR1","TGFBR2","TGFBR3"),
  Canonical_WNT  = c("WNT1","WNT3","WNT3A","WNT7A","WNT7B","WNT8A","WNT8B",
                     "LRP5","LRP6","FZD1","FZD2","FZD5","FZD7","FZD9","FZD10",
                     "CTNNB1","APC","AXIN1","AXIN2","GSK3B","CSNK1A1",
                     "TCF7","LEF1","TCF7L1","TCF7L2"),
  Canonical_WNT_Inhibitors = c("DKK1","DKK2","DKK3","DKK4",
                               "KREMEN1","KREMEN2","NOTUM"))

for (m in names(modules)) {
  genes <- intersect(modules[[m]], rownames(amnion_filtered))
  cat(sprintf("  %-26s %2d/%2d genes detected\n",
              m, length(genes), length(modules[[m]])))
  set.seed(SEED)
  amnion_filtered <- AddModuleScore(amnion_filtered, features = list(genes),
                                    name = m, verbose = FALSE)
}
```

## Statistics helper

```{r fig3-stats-helper}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## One function for every panel: donor-level pseudobulk means, two-sided Welch
## t-test per cell type, BH correction across the cell types shown, Cohen's d.
## Writes both source-data sheets and prints the legend sentence.
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
panel_stats <- function(obj, value_col, label, cell_types,
                        timepoints = c("Week_25", "Week_38"),
                        rename_map = NULL) {

  stopifnot(value_col %in% colnames(obj@meta.data))

  donor <- obj@meta.data %>%
    dplyr::filter(cell_type %in% cell_types, timepoint %in% timepoints) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(Donor_Nr, cell_type, timepoint,
                     value = .data[[value_col]]) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(cell_type, timepoint, Donor_Nr) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(mean_value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
                     n_nuclei   = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop")

  if (!is.null(rename_map))
    donor <- donor %>% dplyr::mutate(cell_type = dplyr::recode(cell_type, !!!rename_map))

  stats <- donor %>%
    dplyr::group_by(cell_type) %>%
    dplyr::filter(dplyr::n_distinct(timepoint) == 2, min(table(timepoint)) >= 2) %>%
    dplyr::group_modify(~{
      tt <- t.test(mean_value ~ timepoint, data = .x, var.equal = FALSE)
      m  <- .x %>% dplyr::group_by(timepoint) %>%
              dplyr::summarise(m = mean(mean_value), s = sd(mean_value),
                               n = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop")
      sp <- sqrt(((m$n[1]-1)*m$s[1]^2 + (m$n[2]-1)*m$s[2]^2) / (sum(m$n)-2))
      tibble::tibble(n_week25 = m$n[1], n_week38 = m$n[2],
                     mean_week25 = m$m[1], mean_week38 = m$m[2],
                     sd_week25 = m$s[1],   sd_week38 = m$s[2],
                     t_statistic = unname(tt$statistic),
                     df = unname(tt$parameter), p_value = tt$p.value,
                     cohens_d = (m$m[2] - m$m[1]) / sp)
    }) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(p_adjusted = p.adjust(p_value, "BH"),
                  significance = as.character(
                    cut(p_adjusted, c(-Inf,.001,.01,.05,Inf),
                        c("***","**","*","ns"))),
                  variable = value_col,
                  test = "two-sided Welch t-test on donor means, BH-adjusted")

  sd_add(paste0(label, "_donor_values"), as.data.frame(donor))
  sd_add(paste0(label, "_statistics"),   as.data.frame(stats))

  cat("\n---", label, "---\n")
  print(as.data.frame(stats %>%
    dplyr::select(cell_type, n_week25, n_week38, t_statistic, df,
                  p_value, p_adjusted, significance, cohens_d)))

  sig <- stats %>% dplyr::filter(p_adjusted < 0.05)
  if (nrow(sig)) {
    cat("\nlegend: ", paste(sprintf(
      "%s: t(%.2f) = %.2f, adjusted P = %s, Cohen's d = %.2f",
      sig$cell_type, sig$df, sig$t_statistic,
      ifelse(sig$p_adjusted < 0.001, "< 0.001", signif(sig$p_adjusted, 3)),
      sig$cohens_d), collapse = "; "), "\n\n", sep = "")
  } else cat("\nlegend: no comparison significant after correction\n\n")

  invisible(stats)
}

module_panel <- function(obj, value_col, title, cell_types, rename_map,
                         level_order, file, width_mm, height_mm,
                         y_lab = "Module score", outliers = FALSE) {

  d <- obj@meta.data %>%
    dplyr::filter(cell_type %in% cell_types) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(cell_type = dplyr::recode(cell_type, !!!rename_map),
                  cell_type = factor(cell_type, levels = level_order))

  p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = cell_type, y = .data[[value_col]], fill = timepoint)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape  = if (outliers) 16 else NA,
                 outlier.size   = 0.3,
                 outlier.stroke = 0,
                 outlier.alpha  = 0.5,
                 width = 0.7, linewidth = 0.2,
                 position = position_dodge(0.8)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(4)) +
    theme_ncb() +
    theme(axis.text.x        = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1,
                                            size = 7),
          axis.text.y        = element_text(size = 7),
          panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
          panel.border       = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA,
                                            linewidth = 0.25),
          plot.title         = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0.5,
                                            margin = margin(b = 1, unit = "mm")),
          legend.position    = "none") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = y_lab, title = title)

  save_panel(p, file, width_mm = width_mm, height_mm = height_mm,
             source_data = FALSE)
  print(p)
  invisible(p)
}
```

```{r}
  dplyr::filter(dplyr::n_distinct(timepoint) == 2, sd(mean_expression) > 0) %>%
  rstatix::t_test(mean_expression ~ timepoint, detailed = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  rstatix::adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>%
  rstatix::add_significance("p.adj")

                                               p.adj.signif)))
```

# Figure 4: ECM

All panels use `amnion_filtered` — peripheral fetal membrane only, with
placenta-adjacent tissue and preeclampsia donors removed. This is the same
subset used for the Figure 3 modules, so every module analysis in the paper
rests on one consistent donor set.

```{r fig4-setup}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)

SEED <- 42

## amnion_filtered is created in the Figure 3 setup chunk. Rebuild it here if
## this section is run on its own.
if (!exists("amnion_filtered")) {
  ng <- amnion_seurat_object; ng@graphs <- list()
  ng@meta.data <- ng@meta.data %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      layer_and_gestation2 = gsub("_", " ", layer_and_gestation),
      layer_and_gestation2 = dplyr::case_when(
        Donor_Nr %in% c("26","41") & layer == "Amnion"  ~ "Amnion Preterm Preeclampsia",
        Donor_Nr %in% c("26","41") & layer == "Chorion" ~ "Chorion Preterm Preeclampsia",
        TRUE ~ layer_and_gestation2))
  amnion_filtered <- subset(ng,
    subset = !grepl("Placenta|Preeclampsia", layer_and_gestation2))
  rm(ng)
}

cat("nuclei:", ncol(amnion_filtered), "\n")
```

## a basement membrane volcano

```{r}
plot_deg_go <- function(obj, go_genes, label, time1, time2, out_file,
                        width_mm = 75, height_mm = 60, n_label = 15) {

  Idents(obj) <- obj$timepoint
  degs <- FindMarkers(obj, ident.1 = time1, ident.2 = time2,
                      min.pct = 0.01, logfc.threshold = 0)
  degs$gene <- rownames(degs)

  d <- degs %>%
    dplyr::filter(gene %in% go_genes) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Significance = dplyr::case_when(
      p_val_adj < 0.05 & avg_log2FC >  1 ~ "Upregulated",
      p_val_adj < 0.05 & avg_log2FC < -1 ~ "Downregulated",
      TRUE                               ~ "Not Significant"),
      Significance = factor(Significance,
        levels = c("Downregulated", "Not Significant", "Upregulated")))

  lab <- d %>% dplyr::filter(Significance != "Not Significant") %>%
    dplyr::arrange(p_val_adj) %>% dplyr::slice_head(n = n_label)

  p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = avg_log2FC, y = -log10(p_val_adj),
                     colour = Significance)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed",
               linewidth = 0.15, colour = "grey60") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed",
               linewidth = 0.15, colour = "grey60") +
    geom_point(size = 1.4, stroke = 0, alpha = 0.85) +
    scale_colour_manual(
      values = c("Downregulated" = "blue", "Not Significant" = "grey70",
                 "Upregulated" = "red"),
      breaks = c("Upregulated", "Downregulated", "Not Significant")) +
    geom_text_repel(data = lab, aes(label = gene, colour = Significance),
                    size = 7/.pt, segment.size = 0.15, segment.colour = "grey50",
                    min.segment.length = 0, point.padding = unit(1, "mm"),
                    box.padding = unit(0.5, "mm"), max.overlaps = Inf,
                    seed = 123, bg.colour = "white", bg.r = 0.12,
                    show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.12)) +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 1.6, alpha = 1),
                                 ncol = 1)) +
    theme_ncb() +
    theme(panel.border    = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA,
                                         linewidth = 0.25),
          plot.title      = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0.5,
                                         margin = margin(b = 1, unit = "mm")),
          legend.position = "right",
          legend.key.size = unit(3, "mm"),
          legend.margin   = margin(l = -2, unit = "mm")) +
    labs(title = label, x = "Log2 fold change",
         y = expression(-log[10]~"adjusted "*italic(P)),
         colour = "Significance")

  save_panel(p, out_file, width_mm, height_mm, source_data = FALSE)
  print(p)
  d
}
```

## Collagen expression, panels b and d

```{r fig4-collagen}
## one helper for both panels: plot, statistics and source data
collagen_panel <- function(obj, genes, celltype, title, file,
                           width_mm, height_mm, label) {

  genes <- intersect(genes, rownames(obj))
  sub   <- subset(obj, cells = colnames(obj)[obj$cell_type == celltype])

  d <- FetchData(sub, vars = c(genes, "timepoint", "Donor_Nr")) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(dplyr::all_of(genes), names_to = "gene",
                        values_to = "expression") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(gene = factor(gene, levels = genes))

  p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = gene, y = expression, fill = timepoint)) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.7, position = position_dodge(0.8),
                 outlier.shape = 16, outlier.size = 0.3, outlier.stroke = 0,
                 linewidth = 0.2, alpha = 0.85) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(4)) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1)) +
    theme_ncb() +
    theme(axis.text.x        = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1,
                                            size = 7),
          panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
          panel.border       = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA,
                                            linewidth = 0.25),
          plot.title         = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0.5,
                                            margin = margin(b = 1, unit = "mm")),
          legend.position    = "top",
          legend.title       = element_blank(),
          legend.key.size    = unit(3, "mm"),
          legend.margin      = margin(t = -1, b = -2, unit = "mm")) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Expression", title = title)

  save_panel(p, file, width_mm, height_mm, source_data = FALSE)
  print(p)

  ## donor-level means and statistics
  donor <- d %>%
    dplyr::filter(timepoint %in% c("Week_25", "Week_38")) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(gene, timepoint, Donor_Nr) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(mean_expression = mean(expression),
                     n_nuclei = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop")

  stats <- donor %>%
    dplyr::group_by(gene) %>%
    dplyr::filter(dplyr::n_distinct(timepoint) == 2, sd(mean_expression) > 0) %>%
    dplyr::group_modify(~{
      tt <- t.test(mean_expression ~ timepoint, data = .x, var.equal = FALSE)
      m  <- .x %>% dplyr::group_by(timepoint) %>%
              dplyr::summarise(m = mean(mean_expression), s = sd(mean_expression),
                               n = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop")
      sp <- sqrt(((m$n[1]-1)*m$s[1]^2 + (m$n[2]-1)*m$s[2]^2)/(sum(m$n)-2))
      tibble::tibble(n_week25 = m$n[1], n_week38 = m$n[2],
                     t_statistic = unname(tt$statistic), df = unname(tt$parameter),
                     p_value = tt$p.value, cohens_d = (m$m[2]-m$m[1])/sp)
    }) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(p_adjusted = p.adjust(p_value, "BH"),
                  significance = as.character(
                    cut(p_adjusted, c(-Inf,.001,.01,.05,Inf),
                        c("***","**","*","ns"))))

  cat("\n---", label, "---\n"); print(as.data.frame(stats))
  sd_add(paste0(label, "_donor_values"), as.data.frame(donor))
  sd_add(paste0(label, "_statistics"),   as.data.frame(stats))
  invisible(stats)
}
```

```{r}
## Scored on amnion_filtered, matching every other module analysis.
emt_modules <- list(
  EMT_drivers   = c("SNAI1","SNAI2","TWIST1","TWIST2","ZEB1","ZEB2",
                    "FOXC2","PRRX1","TCF4"),
  EMT_effectors = c("VIM","FN1","COL1A1","COL3A1","NID2","MMP2","MMP9","S100A4"),
  MET_drivers   = c("GRHL2","OVOL1","OVOL2","KLF4","KLF5","ESRP1","ESRP2"),
  MET_effectors = c("CDH1","CLDN3","CLDN4","OCLN","EPCAM","KRT8","KRT18"))

for (m in names(emt_modules)) {
  set.seed(SEED)
  amnion_filtered <- AddModuleScore(amnion_filtered,
    features = list(intersect(emt_modules[[m]], rownames(amnion_filtered))),
    name = m, verbose = FALSE)
}

celltypes_of_interest <- c("Stromal1_Fetus", "Epithelial_Fetus")
score_cols <- paste0(names(emt_modules), "1")

plot_df <- amnion_filtered@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::filter(timepoint %in% c("Week_25", "Week_38"),
                cell_type %in% celltypes_of_interest) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(cell_type = dplyr::recode(cell_type,
                  "Epithelial_Fetus" = "Epithelial Fetus",
                  "Stromal1_Fetus"   = "Stromal Fetus"),
                cell_type = factor(cell_type,
                  levels = c("Epithelial Fetus", "Stromal Fetus")),
                Timepoint = dplyr::recode(timepoint,
                  "Week_25" = "Week 25", "Week_38" = "Week 38")) %>%
  dplyr::select(Donor_Nr, cell_type, Timepoint, dplyr::all_of(score_cols)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(dplyr::all_of(score_cols),
                      names_to = "module", values_to = "score") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(module = factor(gsub("_", " ", sub("1$", "", module)),
                                levels = gsub("_", " ", names(emt_modules))))

p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = cell_type, y = score, fill = Timepoint)) +
  geom_violin(position = position_dodge(0.8), trim = FALSE, scale = "width",
              linewidth = 0.15, alpha = 0.75) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.12, position = position_dodge(0.8),
               outlier.shape = NA, linewidth = 0.15, alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~module, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Week 25" = "#F8766D", "Week 38" = "#00BFC4")) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(4)) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1)) +
  theme_ncb() +
  theme(axis.text.x        = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1,
                                          size = 7),
        strip.text         = element_text(size = 7,
                                          margin = margin(b = 0.5, unit = "mm")),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        panel.border       = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA,
                                          linewidth = 0.25),
        panel.spacing.x    = unit(1.5, "mm"),
        legend.position    = "top",
        legend.title       = element_blank(),
        legend.key.size    = unit(3, "mm"),
        legend.margin      = margin(t = -1, b = -2, unit = "mm")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Module score")

save_panel(p, "Figure4/panel_c_EMT_MET_modules",
           width_mm = 170, height_mm = 47, source_data = FALSE)
print(p)

## statistics per module x cell type
emt_donor <- plot_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(module, cell_type, Timepoint, Donor_Nr) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(mean_score = mean(score), .groups = "drop")

emt_stats <- emt_donor %>%
  dplyr::group_by(module, cell_type) %>%
  dplyr::group_modify(~{
    tt <- t.test(mean_score ~ Timepoint, data = .x, var.equal = FALSE)
    m  <- .x %>% dplyr::group_by(Timepoint) %>%
            dplyr::summarise(m = mean(mean_score), s = sd(mean_score),
                             n = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop")
    sp <- sqrt(((m$n[1]-1)*m$s[1]^2 + (m$n[2]-1)*m$s[2]^2)/(sum(m$n)-2))
    tibble::tibble(n_week25 = m$n[1], n_week38 = m$n[2],
                   t_statistic = unname(tt$statistic), df = unname(tt$parameter),
                   p_value = tt$p.value, cohens_d = (m$m[2]-m$m[1])/sp)
  }) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(p_adjusted = p.adjust(p_value, "BH"),
                significance = as.character(
                  cut(p_adjusted, c(-Inf,.001,.01,.05,Inf),
                      c("***","**","*","ns"))))

print(as.data.frame(emt_stats))
sd_add("Fig4c_EMT_MET_donor_values", as.data.frame(emt_donor))
```

## f ColXII

```{r}
library(readr); library(stringr)

d <- read_csv("Col12_measurements.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.na(Classification)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Timepoint = ifelse(str_detect(Image, "HT"), "Week 38", "Week 25"),
                Donor_raw = str_split_i(Image, " - ", 1)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Timepoint) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Donor = paste0("Donor_", as.integer(
    factor(Donor_raw, levels = unique(Donor_raw))))) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

per_image <- d %>%
  dplyr::transmute(Image, Donor, Timepoint,
    Positive_area = `First_Collagen12: Positive area µm^2`,
    Negative_area = `First_Collagen12: Negative area µm^2`,
    Percent_Positive = Positive_area / (Positive_area + Negative_area) * 100)

donor_summary <- per_image %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Donor, Timepoint) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(Percent_Positive = mean(Percent_Positive), .groups = "drop")

tt <- t.test(Percent_Positive ~ Timepoint, data = donor_summary, var.equal = FALSE)
p_star <- as.character(cut(tt$p.value, c(-Inf,.001,.01,.05,Inf),
                           c("***","**","*","ns")))
cat(sprintf("Col XII: t(%.2f) = %.2f, P = %.4g  %s\n",
            tt$parameter, tt$statistic, tt$p.value, p_star))

stats_df <- donor_summary %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Timepoint) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(median = median(Percent_Positive), sd = sd(Percent_Positive),
                   n = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop")

set.seed(5)
y_top <- max(donor_summary$Percent_Positive) * 1.18

p <- ggplot(donor_summary, aes(x = Timepoint, y = Percent_Positive)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0, size = 2.5, stroke = 0, colour = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(data = stats_df, aes(x = Timepoint, y = median,
                                     ymin = median - sd, ymax = median + sd),
                width = 0.18, linewidth = 0.3, colour = "red", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_point(data = stats_df, aes(x = Timepoint, y = median),
             size = 2.5, stroke = 0, colour = "red", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  annotate("segment", x = 1, xend = 2, y = y_top, yend = y_top, linewidth = 0.25) +
  annotate("segment", x = 1, xend = 1, y = y_top, yend = y_top*0.975, linewidth = 0.25) +
  annotate("segment", x = 2, xend = 2, y = y_top, yend = y_top*0.975, linewidth = 0.25) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = y_top*1.01, label = p_star,
           size = 8/.pt, vjust = 0) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-2, y_top*1.12), breaks = seq(0, 30, 5),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  theme_ncb() +
  theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.25),
        plot.title   = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0.5,
                                    margin = margin(b = 1, unit = "mm"))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Percent positive area (%)", title = "Col XII")

save_panel(p, "Figure4/panel_f_ColXII", width_mm = 42, height_mm = 65,
           source_data = FALSE)
print(p)

sd_add("Fig4f_ColXII_raw_images",  as.data.frame(per_image))
sd_add("Fig4f_ColXII_donor_means", as.data.frame(donor_summary))
sd_add("Fig4f_ColXII_statistics", data.frame(
  comparison = "Week 38 vs Week 25",
  test = "Two-sided Welch t-test on donor means",
  n_week25 = stats_df$n[1], n_week38 = stats_df$n[2],
  t_statistic = unname(tt$statistic), df = unname(tt$parameter),
  p_value = tt$p.value, significance = p_star))
```

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

# =============================================================================
# Figure 5 -- Interferon gamma signalling volcano (60 x 58 mm)
# =============================================================================

plot_deg_go <- function(seurat_obj, go_genes, label, time1, time2,
                        out_file, width_mm = 60, height_mm = 58,
                        n_label = 10) {

  Idents(seurat_obj) <- seurat_obj$timepoint

  degs <- FindMarkers(seurat_obj,
                      ident.1         = time1,
                      ident.2         = time2,
                      min.pct         = 0.01,
                      logfc.threshold = 0)
  degs$gene <- rownames(degs)

  degs_go <- degs %>%
    filter(gene %in% go_genes) %>%
    mutate(Significance = case_when(
             p_val_adj < 0.05 & avg_log2FC >  1 ~ "Upregulated",
             p_val_adj < 0.05 & avg_log2FC < -1 ~ "Downregulated",
             TRUE                               ~ "Not Significant"),
           Significance = factor(Significance,
             levels = c("Downregulated", "Not Significant", "Upregulated")))

  # label only the strongest hits -- more will collide at this size
  label_df <- degs_go %>%
    filter(Significance != "Not Significant") %>%
    arrange(p_val_adj) %>%
    slice_head(n = n_label)

  p <- ggplot(degs_go, aes(x = avg_log2FC, y = -log10(p_val_adj),
                           colour = Significance)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed",
               linewidth = 0.15, colour = "grey60") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed",
               linewidth = 0.15, colour = "grey60") +
    geom_point(size = 1.4, stroke = 0, alpha = 0.85) +
    scale_colour_manual(
      values = c("Downregulated"   = "blue",
                 "Not Significant" = "grey70",
                 "Upregulated"     = "red"),
      breaks = c("Upregulated", "Downregulated", "Not Significant")) +
    geom_text_repel(data = label_df, aes(label = gene, colour = Significance),
                    size               = 7 / .pt,
                    segment.size       = 0.15,
                    segment.colour     = "grey50",
                    min.segment.length = 0,
                    point.padding      = unit(1.0, "mm"),
                    box.padding        = unit(0.5, "mm"),
                    max.overlaps       = Inf,
                    seed               = 123,
                    bg.colour          = "white", bg.r = 0.12,
                    show.legend        = FALSE) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.12)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(4)) +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 1.6, alpha = 1),
                                 ncol = 1)) +
    theme_ncb() +
    theme(panel.border    = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA,
                                         linewidth = 0.25),
          plot.title      = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0.5,
                                         margin = margin(b = 1, unit = "mm")),
          legend.position = "right",
          legend.title    = element_text(size = 7),
          legend.text     = element_text(size = 7),
          legend.key.size = unit(3, "mm"),
          legend.margin   = margin(l = -2, unit = "mm")) +
    labs(title  = label,
         x      = "Log2 fold change",
         y      = expression(-log[10]~"adjusted "*italic(P)),
         colour = "Significance")

  save_panel(p, out_file, width_mm = width_mm, height_mm = height_mm)
  print(p)
  degs_go
}

# ---- run --------------------------------------------------------------------
degs_go <- plot_deg_go(
  seurat_obj = subset_amnion,
  go_genes   = interferon_gamma_genes,
  label      = "Interferon Gamma Signaling",
  time1      = "Week_38",
  time2      = "Week_25",
  out_file   = "Figure5/panel_f_volcano_interferon_gamma",
  width_mm   = 60,
  height_mm  = 58,
  n_label    = 10)

# ---- counts -----------------------------------------------------------------
sig_genes <- degs_go[degs_go$p_val_adj < 0.05, ]
cat("Upregulated genes:",   sum(sig_genes$avg_log2FC > 0), "\n")
cat("Downregulated genes:", sum(sig_genes$avg_log2FC < 0), "\n")

# ---- source data ------------------------------------------------------------
dir.create("SourceData", showWarnings = FALSE)
writexl::write_xlsx(degs_go, "SourceData/Fig5f_interferon_gamma_DEG.xlsx")

```

```{r}
prioritized_tbl_oi <-
  multinichenet_output$prioritization_tables$group_prioritization_tbl %>%
  filter(id %in% prioritized_tbl_oi_all$id) %>%
  distinct(id, sender, receiver, ligand, receptor, group) %>%
  left_join(prioritized_tbl_oi_all)

prioritized_tbl_oi$prioritization_score[
  is.na(prioritized_tbl_oi$prioritization_score)] <- 0

senders_receivers <- union(unique(prioritized_tbl_oi$sender),
                           unique(prioritized_tbl_oi$receiver)) %>% sort()

pal <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(11, "Spectral"))(length(senders_receivers))
colors_sender   <- magrittr::set_names(pal, senders_receivers)
colors_receiver <- magrittr::set_names(pal, senders_receivers)

group_order <- unique(prioritized_tbl_oi$group)
cat("Drawing order:\n"); print(group_order)

# ---- 2. Draw DIRECTLY into the svglite device (so 7 pt is respected) --------
svglite::svglite(file.path(OUTDIR, "circos_immune_%03d.svg"),
                 width     = SIZE_MM / 25.4,
                 height    = SIZE_MM / 25.4,
                 pointsize = 7)

par(mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0))
circos.clear()
circos.par(track.margin            = c(0.005, 0.005),
           cell.padding            = c(0, 0, 0, 0),
           gap.degree              = 1,
           points.overflow.warning = FALSE)

invisible(make_circos_group_comparison(prioritized_tbl_oi,
                                       colors_sender, colors_receiver))

circos.clear()
dev.off()

# ---- 3. Rename ---------------------------------------------------------------
made <- sort(list.files(OUTDIR, pattern = "^circos_immune_\\d+\\.svg$",
                        full.names = TRUE))
cat("\nProduced:\n"); print(basename(made))

if (length(made) == length(group_order)) {
  targets <- file.path(OUTDIR,
    sprintf("panel_d_circos_%s.svg", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "", group_order)))
  file.rename(made, targets)
  cat("Renamed to:\n"); print(basename(targets))
} else {
  warning("SVG count != group count -- rename manually.")
}

# ---- 4. Shared sender/receiver legend ---------------------------------------
legend_df <- data.frame(
  cell_type = factor(senders_receivers, levels = senders_receivers))

p_leg <- ggplot(legend_df, aes(x = 1, y = cell_type, fill = cell_type)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors_sender, name = NULL) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE,
                             keywidth  = unit(2.5, "mm"),
                             keyheight = unit(2.5, "mm"))) +
  theme_void(base_size = 7, base_family = FONT) +
  theme(legend.position  = "bottom",
        legend.text      = element_text(size = 7, family = FONT),
        legend.spacing.x = unit(0.5, "mm"))

leg <- tryCatch(
  cowplot::get_plot_component(p_leg, "guide-box-bottom", return_all = TRUE),
  error = function(e) cowplot::get_legend(p_leg))

save_panel(cowplot::ggdraw(leg), file.path(OUTDIR, "panel_d_circos_legend"),
           width_mm = 170, height_mm = 14)
```

### Quantification of Imgaes Histology CD163


## e CD163

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)

# ---- 1. Read and annotate ---------------------------------------------------
df <- read_csv("CD163_measurements.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(!str_detect(Image, fixed("2025_11_17_250414_MMC1_CD163.czi"))) %>%
  mutate(
    Timepoint = ifelse(str_detect(Image, "HT"), "Week 38", "Week 25"),
    Donor_raw = str_split_i(Image, " - ", 1)
  ) %>%
  group_by(Timepoint) %>%
  mutate(Donor = paste0("Donor_", as.integer(factor(Donor_raw,
                                                    levels = unique(Donor_raw))))) %>%
  ungroup()

# ---- 2. Donor-level weighted percent positive -------------------------------
donor_summary <- df %>%
  group_by(Donor, Timepoint) %>%
  summarise(Total_Positive = sum(as.numeric(`Num Positive`),   na.rm = TRUE),
            Total_Detected = sum(as.numeric(`Num Detections`), na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Percent_Positive = Total_Positive / Total_Detected * 100)

stats_df <- donor_summary %>%
  group_by(Timepoint) %>%
  summarise(median = median(Percent_Positive),
            sd     = sd(Percent_Positive),
            n      = n(), .groups = "drop")

print(donor_summary); print(stats_df)

# ---- 3. Welch t-test --------------------------------------------------------
tt <- t.test(Percent_Positive ~ Timepoint, data = donor_summary, var.equal = FALSE)
print(tt)

p_val  <- tt$p.value
p_star <- as.character(cut(p_val, c(-Inf, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, Inf),
                           c("***", "**", "*", "ns")))
cat(sprintf("p = %.5f  ->  %s\n", p_val, p_star))

# ---- 4. Plot ----------------------------------------------------------------
set.seed(3)
y_top <- max(donor_summary$Percent_Positive) * 1.18

p <- ggplot(donor_summary, aes(x = Timepoint, y = Percent_Positive)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0, size = 2.5, stroke = 0, colour = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(data = stats_df,
                aes(x = Timepoint, y = median,
                    ymin = median - sd, ymax = median + sd),
                width = 0.18, linewidth = 0.3, colour = "red", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_point(data = stats_df, aes(x = Timepoint, y = median),
             size = 2.5, stroke = 0, colour = "red", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  annotate("segment", x = 1, xend = 2, y = y_top, yend = y_top, linewidth = 0.25) +
  annotate("segment", x = 1, xend = 1, y = y_top, yend = y_top * 0.975, linewidth = 0.25) +
  annotate("segment", x = 2, xend = 2, y = y_top, yend = y_top * 0.975, linewidth = 0.25) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = y_top * 1.01, label = p_star,
           size = 8 / .pt, vjust = 0) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-2, y_top * 1.12),
                     breaks = seq(0, 30, by = 5),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  theme_ncb() +
  theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.25),
        plot.title   = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0.5,
                                    margin = margin(b = 1, unit = "mm"))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Percent positive cells (%)", title = "CD163")

save_panel(p, "Figure5/panel_e_CD163", width_mm = 42, height_mm = 56)

print(p)

dir.create("SourceData", showWarnings = FALSE)
writexl::write_xlsx(donor_summary, "SourceData/Fig5e_CD163.xlsx")

```

```{r}
                               keyheight = unit(2.6, "mm"))) +
  theme_ncb() +
  labs(x = "UMAP 1", y = "UMAP 2") +
```

```{r}
counts1_full <- Matrix(0, nrow = length(all_genes), ncol = ncol(counts1),
                       dimnames = list(all_genes, colnames(counts1)), sparse = TRUE)

                       dimnames = list(all_genes, colnames(counts2)), sparse = TRUE)

counts2_full[rownames(counts2), colnames(counts2)] <- counts2

DefaultAssay(subset_amnion_epithel) <- "combined_RNA"
```

```{r}
counts <- GetAssayData(subset_amnion_epithel, assay = "combined_RNA", layer = "counts")
meta <- subset_amnion_epithel@meta.data
meta$cell_id <- rownames(meta)

# --- Step 3: Combine timepoint and dataset_origin to create pseudobulk groups ---
meta$group <- paste0("W", meta$timepoint_num, "_", meta$dataset_origin)
groups <- unique(meta$group)

pseudobulk_counts <- sapply(groups, function(g) {
  cells <- rownames(meta)[meta$group == g]
  if(length(cells) == 0) {
    rep(0, nrow(counts))
  } else if(length(cells) == 1) {
    counts[, cells]
  } else {
    rowSums(counts[, cells, drop = FALSE])
  }
})

pseudobulk_counts <- as.matrix(pseudobulk_counts)
colnames(pseudobulk_counts) <- groups

# --- Step 4: Filter genes ---
# Keep only genes expressed (non-zero) in at least one sample for every timepoint
timepoints <- unique(meta$timepoint_num)

keep_genes <- apply(pseudobulk_counts, 1, function(x) {
  counts_per_timepoint <- sapply(timepoints, function(tp) {
    cols <- grep(paste0("W", tp, "_"), colnames(pseudobulk_counts))
    sum(x[cols] > 0)  # number of non-zero samples in this timepoint
  })
  all(counts_per_timepoint > 0)  # TRUE only if all timepoints have >=1 counts
})

pseudobulk_counts_filtered <- pseudobulk_counts[keep_genes, ]

# --- Step 5: Create DESeq2 metadata ---
coldata <- data.frame(group = groups)
rownames(coldata) <- groups
coldata$timepoint_num <- as.numeric(sub("W(\\d+)_.*", "\\1", groups))
coldata$dataset_origin <- factor(sub("W\\d+_(.*)", "\\1", groups))

# --- Step 6: DESeq2 dataset ---
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = pseudobulk_counts_filtered,
  colData = coldata,
  design = ~ dataset_origin + timepoint_num
)

dds <- DESeq(dds)
res <- results(dds)

```

```{r}
library(openxlsx)

# Convert results to data frame
res_df <- as.data.frame(res)
res_df$gene <- rownames(res_df)

# Save to Excel
write.xlsx(res_df, file = "Figure6/DESeq2_timecourse_results_weekly_epithel_nobatchcorrection.xlsx", rowNames = FALSE)


```

#### Placenta Comparision

Donors for whom both placenta-adjacent and peripheral fetal membrane were
collected. Differential expression uses donor-paired pseudobulk with DESeq2
(`~ Donor_Nr + tissue_source`), so each donor serves as their own control.

This section works on `placenta_obj` and `placenta_paired` throughout and never
modifies `amnion_seurat_object`.

```{r placenta-subset}
library(Seurat)

placenta_obj <- readRDS("seurat_object_midterm_term_fetalmembrane.rds")
stopifnot(ncol(placenta_obj) == 59626)

paired_donors <- unique(
  placenta_obj$Donor_Nr[placenta_obj$tissue_source == "Placenta"])

placenta_paired <- subset(placenta_obj, cells = colnames(placenta_obj)[
  as.character(placenta_obj$Donor_Nr) %in% as.character(paired_donors)])

placenta_paired$Location <- placenta_paired$tissue_source

cat("paired donors:", paste(paired_donors, collapse = ", "),
    "| nuclei:", ncol(placenta_paired), "\n")
print(table(placenta_paired$tissue_source))
```

### Donor-paired pseudobulk differential expression

```{r placenta-deseq}
library(DESeq2)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(writexl)

pb <- AggregateExpression(placenta_paired, assays = "RNA",
                          return.seurat = TRUE,
                          group.by = c("cell_type", "Donor_Nr", "tissue_source"))

counts <- GetAssayData(pb, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")
meta   <- pb@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::select(cell_type, Donor_Nr, tissue_source) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(dplyr::everything(), factor),
                tissue_source = relevel(tissue_source, ref = "Peripher"))

de_list <- list()

for (ct in levels(meta$cell_type)) {

  i  <- meta$cell_type == ct
  mi <- meta[i, ]; ci <- counts[, i]

  ## keep only donors with BOTH locations, so the paired design is valid
  keep_donors <- mi %>%
    dplyr::count(Donor_Nr, tissue_source) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = tissue_source, values_from = n,
                       values_fill = 0) %>%
    dplyr::filter(Placenta > 0, Peripher > 0) %>%
    dplyr::pull(Donor_Nr)

  k  <- mi$Donor_Nr %in% keep_donors
  mi <- droplevels(mi[k, ]); ci <- ci[, k]

  if (dplyr::n_distinct(mi$Donor_Nr) < 2) {
    message("  skipping ", ct, ": fewer than 2 paired donors"); next
  }

  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(ci, mi, design = ~ Donor_Nr + tissue_source)
  dds <- DESeq(dds, quiet = TRUE)
  res <- as.data.frame(results(dds, contrast = c("tissue_source",
                                                 "Placenta", "Peripher")))
  res$Gene      <- rownames(res)
  res$cell_type <- ct
  res$n_donors  <- dplyr::n_distinct(mi$Donor_Nr)

  de_list[[ct]] <- res %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(padj)) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(padj)

  cat(sprintf("  %-24s %2d donors | %4d genes at padj < 0.05\n",
              ct, res$n_donors[1], sum(de_list[[ct]]$padj < 0.05)))
}

de_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(de_list) %>%
  dplyr::select(cell_type, Gene, baseMean, log2FoldChange, lfcSE,
                pvalue, padj, n_donors)

writexl::write_xlsx(de_all, "Figure6/DE_pseudobulk_placenta_vs_peripher.xlsx")
sd_add("Fig6_placenta_DE", de_all %>% dplyr::filter(padj < 0.05))

cat("\ncell types tested:", length(de_list),
    "| significant genes:", sum(de_all$padj < 0.05), "\n")
```

```{r}
cat("terms > 30 chars:\n")

                            size = `enrichment score`,
                            colour = `false discovery rate`)) +

save_panel(p_base, "Figure6/panel_f_GO_dotplot",

save_panel(p_base, "Figure6/panel_f_GO_dotplot_BIG",
```

#### Preeclampsia 

Preeclampsia samples were available only at week 34. Differential expression is
therefore assessed with donor-level pseudobulk counts and limma-voom, fitting
gestational age as a continuous covariate so that the preeclampsia donors are
compared against the fitted gestational trend rather than against an unmatched
set of controls. This analysis is exploratory: only two preeclampsia donors were
available, and the results require confirmation in adequately powered cohorts.

This section uses `pe_obj` and `pe_umap_obj` and never modifies
`amnion_seurat_object`, which carries the module scores used elsewhere.

```{r pe-objects}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)

## Full atlas for the model; reuse placenta_obj if it is already loaded.
pe_obj <- if (exists("placenta_obj") && ncol(placenta_obj) == 59626) {
  placenta_obj
} else {
  readRDS("seurat_object_midterm_term_fetalmembrane.rds")
}
stopifnot(ncol(pe_obj) == 59626)

## Donors 26 and 41 are the week 34 preeclampsia cases.
pe_obj$Condition <- factor(
  ifelse(as.character(pe_obj$Donor_Nr) %in% c("26", "41"),
         "Preeclampsia", "Healthy"),
  levels = c("Healthy", "Preeclampsia"))

stopifnot(all(c("Healthy", "Preeclampsia") %in% pe_obj$Condition))
print(table(pe_obj$Condition, pe_obj$timepoint))

## Donor 10 is the gestational-age-matched control for the UMAP panel.
pe_umap_obj <- subset(pe_obj, cells = colnames(pe_obj)[
  as.character(pe_obj$Donor_Nr) %in% c("10", "26", "41")])
pe_umap_obj <- RunUMAP(RunPCA(pe_umap_obj, verbose = FALSE),
                       dims = 1:20, verbose = FALSE)
```

```{r}
plot_df <- data.frame(Embeddings(pe_umap_obj, "umap")[, 1:2],
                      group = pe_umap_obj$Condition)
colnames(plot_df)[1:2] <- c("UMAP_1", "UMAP_2")

set.seed(123)
plot_df <- plot_df[sample(nrow(plot_df)), ]

p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2, colour = group)) +
  rasterise(geom_point(size = 0.3, alpha = 0.6, stroke = 0), dpi = 900) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 1,
                               override.aes = list(size = 1.3, alpha = 1))) +
  theme_ncb() +
  labs(x = "UMAP 1", y = "UMAP 2") +
  theme(legend.title    = element_blank(),
```

### Differential expression: donor-level pseudobulk with limma-voom

```{r pe-limma}
library(edgeR); library(limma); library(writexl)

run_pseudobulk_limma <- function(obj, celltype, min_cells = 30) {

  ct_obj <- subset(obj, cells = colnames(obj)[obj$cell_type == celltype])
  counts <- GetAssayData(ct_obj, layer = "counts")
  meta   <- ct_obj@meta.data[colnames(counts), ]

  ## donors contributing enough nuclei
  n_per_donor <- table(meta$Donor_Nr)
  keep_donors <- names(n_per_donor[n_per_donor >= min_cells])
  if (length(keep_donors) < 3) {
    message("  skip ", celltype, ": <3 donors with >=", min_cells, " nuclei")
    return(NULL)
  }
  meta   <- meta[meta$Donor_Nr %in% keep_donors, ]
  counts <- counts[, rownames(meta)]

  ## aggregate to donor-level pseudobulk
  donor    <- factor(meta$Donor_Nr)
  donor_mm <- model.matrix(~ 0 + donor); colnames(donor_mm) <- levels(donor)
  pb       <- counts %*% donor_mm

  dm <- meta %>%
    dplyr::distinct(Donor_Nr, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::select(Donor_Nr, Condition, timepoint) %>%
    as.data.frame()
  rownames(dm) <- dm$Donor_Nr; dm$Donor_Nr <- NULL
  dm <- dm[colnames(pb), , drop = FALSE]
  dm$timepoint <- as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9.]", "", dm$timepoint))

  if (anyNA(dm$timepoint) || dplyr::n_distinct(dm$Condition) < 2) {
    message("  skip ", celltype, ": design not estimable"); return(NULL)
  }

  design <- model.matrix(~ timepoint + Condition, data = dm)
  fit <- eBayes(lmFit(voom(calcNormFactors(DGEList(pb)), design), design))

  res <- topTable(fit, coef = grep("^Condition", colnames(design), value = TRUE),
                  number = Inf, sort.by = "P")
  res$gene <- rownames(res); res$cell_type <- celltype; res$n_donors <- nrow(dm)
  cat(sprintf("  %-24s %2d donors | %4d genes at adj.P < 0.05\n",
              celltype, nrow(dm), sum(res$adj.P.Val < 0.05)))
  res
}

results_list <- list()
for (ct in sort(unique(pe_obj$cell_type))) {
  r <- run_pseudobulk_limma(pe_obj, ct)
  if (!is.null(r)) results_list[[ct]] <- r
}

cat("\nCell types tested:", length(results_list), "\n")

write_xlsx(dplyr::bind_rows(results_list),
           "Figure6/PE_vs_Normal_pseudobulk_limma_by_celltype.xlsx")
```
