#Supplement Figures

### Stress Genes

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(rstatix)
library(msigdbr)
library(stringr)

# 1. Setup Folder Structure
si_dir <- "SI_Figure_Stress"
if (!dir.exists(si_dir)) dir.create(si_dir)

# 2. Setup: Define the Stress GO terms
all_human_genesets <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens")
stress_terms <- c(
  "GOBP_CELLULAR_RESPONSE_TO_STRESS", 
  "GOBP_RESPONSE_TO_STRESS", 
  "GOBP_ACUTE_PHASE_RESPONSE"
)

seurat_subset <- subset(amnion_seurat_object, subset = `Gestational Age` %in% c("Week 25", "Week 38"))

all_stress_stats <- list()

message("Starting global stress analysis. Figures and stats saved to: ", si_dir)

# 3. Loop through terms
for (term in stress_terms) {
  
  term_genes_raw <- all_human_genesets %>%
    filter(gs_name == term) %>%
    pull(gene_symbol) %>%
    unique()
  
  valid_genes <- intersect(term_genes_raw, rownames(seurat_subset))
  
  if (length(valid_genes) < 5) {
    message("Skipping ", term, ": Insufficient gene coverage.")
    next
  }
  
  # Add module score
  seurat_subset <- AddModuleScore(seurat_subset, features = list(valid_genes), name = "Stress_Mod_")
  
  # Fetch data
  plot_data <- FetchData(seurat_subset, vars = c("Stress_Mod_1", "Gestational Age", "Donor_Nr"))
  colnames(plot_data) <- c("Score", "Timepoint", "Donor_Nr")
  
  # A. Plotting
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Timepoint, y = Score, fill = Timepoint)) +
    geom_violin(scale = "width", alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, outlier.shape = NA) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Week 25" = "#56B4E9", "Week 38" = "#E69F00")) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Global Stress:", str_replace_all(term, "_", " ")),
      subtitle = paste("Based on", length(valid_genes), "detected genes"),
      y = "Aggregate Stress Score", 
      x = "Gestational Age"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
  
  # Save Plot
  safe_name <- str_remove(term, "GOBP_")
#  ggsave(file.path(si_dir, paste0(safe_name, "_plot.png")), plot = p, width = 6, height = 5)
  
  # B. Statistics (Pseudobulk)
  stats <- plot_data %>% 
    group_by(Donor_Nr, Timepoint) %>% 
    summarise(mean_score = mean(Score, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    t_test(mean_score ~ Timepoint)
  
  stats$term <- term
  all_stress_stats[[term]] <- stats
  
  # Cleanup
  seurat_subset$Stress_Mod_1 <- NULL
}

# 4. Final Summary Export
if (length(all_stress_stats) > 0) {
  results_df <- bind_rows(all_stress_stats) %>% adjust_pvalue(method = "BH")
  write.csv(results_df, file.path(si_dir, "Stress_Pathway_Stats.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  message("Success! Analysis complete. Files saved in: ", si_dir)
}
```

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(rstatix)
library(msigdbr)
library(stringr)

SEED    <- 42
BASE_PT <- 9
ed_dir  <- "SI_Figure_Stress"
dir.create(ed_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ---- 1. Gene sets ------------------------------------------------------------
all_human_genesets <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens")

stress_terms <- c("GOBP_CELLULAR_RESPONSE_TO_STRESS",
                  "GOBP_ACUTE_PHASE_RESPONSE")

# fail loudly if a term is not in this msigdbr version
for (tm in stress_terms) {
  n <- sum(all_human_genesets$gs_name == tm)
  cat(sprintf("%-36s %6d gene records in msigdbr\n", tm, n))
  if (n == 0) stop("Term not found in msigdbr: ", tm)
}

# ---- 2. Collect module scores, with a fixed seed -----------------------------
collect_scores <- function(obj, set_label) {
  out <- list()
  for (term in stress_terms) {
    genes <- all_human_genesets %>%
      filter(gs_name == term) %>% pull(gene_symbol) %>% unique()
    valid <- intersect(genes, rownames(obj))
    cat(sprintf("  %-16s %-36s %5d detected genes\n",
                set_label, term, length(valid)))
    if (length(valid) < 5) stop("Too few genes for ", term, " in ", set_label)

    set.seed(SEED)                       # <<< reproducible control bins
    obj <- AddModuleScore(obj, features = list(valid), name = "Stress_Mod_")

    d <- FetchData(obj, vars = c("Stress_Mod_1", "Gestational Age", "Donor_Nr"))
    colnames(d) <- c("Score", "Timepoint", "Donor_Nr")
    d$term <- term; d$set <- set_label; d$n_genes <- length(valid)
    out[[term]] <- d
    obj$Stress_Mod_1 <- NULL
  }
  bind_rows(out)
}

seurat_global <- subset(amnion_seurat_object,
                        subset = `Gestational Age` %in% c("Week 25", "Week 38"))
seurat_mother <- subset(amnion_seurat_object,
                        subset = `Gestational Age` %in% c("Week 25", "Week 38") &
                                 origin == "Mother")

cat("\nGene coverage:\n")
plot_data <- bind_rows(
  collect_scores(seurat_global, "Global Stress"),
  collect_scores(seurat_mother, "Maternal Stress"))

# ---- 3. Facet labels ---------------------------------------------------------
label_lookup <- plot_data %>%
  distinct(set, term, n_genes) %>%
  mutate(facet_label = paste0(set, ":\n",
                              str_replace_all(term, "_", " "),
                              "\nBased on ", n_genes, " detected genes"))

plot_data <- plot_data %>% left_join(label_lookup, by = c("set","term","n_genes"))

facet_levels <- label_lookup %>%
  mutate(set  = factor(set,  levels = c("Global Stress", "Maternal Stress")),
         term = factor(term, levels = stress_terms)) %>%
  arrange(set, term) %>% pull(facet_label)

plot_data$facet_label <- factor(plot_data$facet_label, levels = facet_levels)

# ---- 4. Statistics: donor pseudobulk, two-sided t-test, BH over all 4 -------
stats_df <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(set, term, facet_label, Donor_Nr, Timepoint) %>%
  summarise(mean_score = mean(Score, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(set, term, facet_label) %>%
  t_test(mean_score ~ Timepoint) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>%       # all four tests, one family
  add_significance("p.adj")

# direction of change, so the text can say "enriched at week 38" correctly
direction_df <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(set, term, Donor_Nr, Timepoint) %>%
  summarise(m = mean(Score, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(set, term, Timepoint) %>%
  summarise(grand = mean(m), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Timepoint, values_from = grand) %>%
  mutate(higher_at = ifelse(`Week 38` > `Week 25`, "week 38", "week 25"))

stats_df <- left_join(stats_df, direction_df, by = c("set", "term"))

cat("\n=========== STATISTICS ===========\n")
print(as.data.frame(stats_df %>%
        dplyr::select(set, term, n1, n2, statistic, df, p, p.adj, p.adj.signif,
               `Week 25`, `Week 38`, higher_at)))

write.csv(stats_df, file.path(ed_dir, "ED1_stress_pathway_stats.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

# ---- 5. Brackets --------------------------------------------------------------
bracket_df <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(facet_label) %>%
  summarise(y = max(Score, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.10, .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(stats_df %>% dplyr::select(facet_label, p.adj, p.adj.signif), by = "facet_label") %>%
  mutate(label = ifelse(p.adj.signif == "ns", "ns.", p.adj.signif))

# ---- 6. Plot -----------------------------------------------------------------
p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Timepoint, y = Score, fill = Timepoint)) +
  geom_violin(scale = "width", alpha = 0.7, linewidth = 0.25, trim = FALSE) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.12, outlier.shape = NA, linewidth = 0.25, fill = "white") +
  geom_segment(data = bracket_df, aes(x = 1, xend = 2, y = y, yend = y),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_segment(data = bracket_df, aes(x = 1, xend = 1, y = y, yend = y * 0.98),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_segment(data = bracket_df, aes(x = 2, xend = 2, y = y, yend = y * 0.98),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(data = bracket_df, aes(x = 1.5, y = y * 1.02, label = label),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, size = (BASE_PT + 2) / .pt, vjust = 0) +
  facet_wrap(~facet_label, ncol = 2, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Week 25" = "#56B4E9", "Week 38" = "#E69F00")) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(4),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.14))) +
  theme_ncb(base_size = BASE_PT) +
  theme(axis.text       = element_text(size = BASE_PT),
        axis.title      = element_text(size = BASE_PT),
        strip.text      = element_text(size = BASE_PT, hjust = 0, lineheight = 1.1,
                                       margin = margin(1, 1, 2, 1, "mm")),
        panel.border    = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.25),
        panel.spacing   = unit(4, "mm"),
        legend.position = "none") +
  labs(x = "Gestational Age", y = "Aggregate Stress Score")

save_panel(p, file.path(ed_dir, "ED1_stress_response"),

print(p)

# ---- 7. Source data ----------------------------------------------------------
dir.create("SourceData", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
writexl::write_xlsx(

  "SourceData/ED1_stress_response.xlsx")
```

```{r}
  dplyr::filter(dplyr::n_distinct(timepoint) == 2, min(table(timepoint)) >= 2) %>%

    m  <- .x %>% dplyr::group_by(timepoint) %>%
            dplyr::summarise(m = mean(mean_score), s = sd(mean_score),
                             n = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop")
    sp <- sqrt(((m$n[1]-1)*m$s[1]^2 + (m$n[2]-1)*m$s[2]^2) / (sum(m$n)-2))
    tibble::tibble(n_week25 = m$n[1], n_week38 = m$n[2],
                   mean_week25 = m$m[1], mean_week38 = m$m[2],
                   t_statistic = unname(tt$statistic), df = unname(tt$parameter),
                   p_value = tt$p.value, cohens_d = (m$m[2] - m$m[1]) / sp)
  }) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(p_adjusted = p.adjust(p_value, "BH"),
                significance = as.character(
                  cut(p_adjusted, c(-Inf,.001,.01,.05,Inf),
                      c("***","**","*","ns"))))

cat("\n=========== PANEL B STATISTICS (per cell type) ===========\n")
print(as.data.frame(stats_b %>% dplyr::arrange(p_value) %>%
  dplyr::select(`Cell Type`, n_week25, n_week38, t_statistic, df,
                p_value, p_adjusted, significance, cohens_d)))
cat("\nraw P < 0.05:", sum(stats_b$p_value < 0.05),
    "| BH-adjusted P < 0.05:", sum(stats_b$p_adjusted < 0.05), "\n")

## asterisks only where the adjusted value passes
sig_b <- stats_b %>%
  dplyr::filter(p_adjusted < 0.05) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(hs %>% dplyr::group_by(`Cell Type`) %>%
                     dplyr::summarise(y = quantile(score, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE),
                                      .groups = "drop"),
                   by = "Cell Type")

p_b <- ggplot(hs, aes(x = `Cell Type`, y = score, fill = timepoint)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, linewidth = 0.2, width = 0.7,
               position = position_dodge(0.8)) +
  {if (nrow(sig_b) > 0)
    geom_text(data = sig_b, aes(x = `Cell Type`, y = y * 1.05,
                                label = significance),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, size = (BASE_PT + 1) / .pt, vjust = 0)} +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(4)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-0.3, 1.8)) +
  theme_ncb(base_size = BASE_PT) +
  theme(axis.text.x        = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1,
                                          size = BASE_PT - 1),
        axis.text.y        = element_text(size = BASE_PT),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        panel.border       = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA,
                                          linewidth = 0.25),
        plot.title         = element_text(size = BASE_PT + 1, hjust = 0.5,
                                          margin = margin(b = 1, unit = "mm")),
        legend.position    = "top",
        legend.title       = element_blank(),
        legend.key.size    = unit(3, "mm"),
        legend.margin      = margin(t = -1, b = -2, unit = "mm")) +
  labs(y = "Module score", x = NULL, title = "Heat Shock Module by Cell Type")

# =============================================================================
# ASSEMBLE
# =============================================================================
p_final <- p_a / p_b +
  plot_layout(heights = c(0.60, 0.40)) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a") &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", family = FONT))

save_panel(p_final, file.path(ed_dir, "ED1_stress_response"),
           width_mm = 160, height_mm = 180, source_data = FALSE)

print(p_final)

# =============================================================================
# EXPORT
# =============================================================================
write.csv(stats_a, file.path(ed_dir, "ED1a_stress_pathway_stats.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(stats_b, file.path(ed_dir, "ED1b_heatshock_celltype_stats.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

sd_add("ED1a_stress_donor_values",
       plot_data %>%
         dplyr::group_by(set, term, Donor_Nr, Timepoint) %>%
         dplyr::summarise(mean_score = mean(Score), .groups = "drop") %>%
         as.data.frame())
sd_add("ED1a_stress_statistics",   as.data.frame(stats_a))
sd_add("ED1b_heatshock_donor_values", as.data.frame(hs_donor))
sd_add("ED1b_heatshock_statistics",   as.data.frame(stats_b))
```

### GO term for telomer maintenance

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(msigdbr)
library(rstatix)

# 1. Setup Folder Structure
si_dir <- "SI_Figure_Telomeres"
if (!dir.exists(si_dir)) dir.create(si_dir)

# 2. Subset
seurat_subset <- subset(
  amnion_seurat_object, 
  subset = `Gestational Age` %in% c("Week 25", "Week 38")
)

all_human_genesets <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens")
telomere_pathways <- all_human_genesets %>%
  filter(grepl("TELOMERE_MAINTENANCE", gs_name, ignore.case = TRUE))

pathway_names <- unique(telomere_pathways$gs_name)
all_pathway_stats <- list()

message("Starting Telomere analysis. Figures and stats saved to: ", si_dir)

# 3. Execution Loop
for (pathway in pathway_names) {
  
  pathway_genes <- telomere_pathways %>%
    filter(gs_name == pathway) %>%
    pull(gene_symbol) %>%
    unique()
  
  valid_pathway_genes <- intersect(pathway_genes, rownames(seurat_subset))
  
  if (length(valid_pathway_genes) == 0) next
  
  # Calculate Module Score
  seurat_subset <- AddModuleScore(
    object = seurat_subset, 
    features = list(valid_pathway_genes), 
    name = "Temp_Module_"
  )
  
  # Fetch data
  plot_data <- FetchData(
    object = seurat_subset, 
    vars = c("Temp_Module_1", "Cell Type", "Gestational Age", "Donor_Nr")
  )
  colnames(plot_data) <- c("Expression", "cell_type", "Timepoint", "Donor_Nr")
  
  # Plot
  clean_title <- str_replace_all(pathway, "_", " ")
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = cell_type, y = Expression, fill = Timepoint)) +
    geom_violin(scale = "width", position = position_dodge(0.8), color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, position = position_dodge(0.8), outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Week 25" = "#56B4E9", "Week 38" = "#E69F00")) +
    labs(
      title = "Telomere Maintenance Pathway",
      subtitle = str_wrap(clean_title, width = 70),
      x = "Cell Type",
      y = "Aggregate Module Score"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  
  # Save Plot
  file_name <- paste0(str_remove(pathway, "GOBP_"), ".png")
#  ggsave(file.path(si_dir, file_name), plot = p, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
  
  # Stats (Pseudobulk)
  stats <- plot_data %>% 
    group_by(Donor_Nr, cell_type, Timepoint) %>% 
    summarise(mean_score = mean(Expression, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(cell_type) %>% 
    t_test(mean_score ~ Timepoint) %>%
    add_significance("p")
  
  stats$module <- pathway
  all_pathway_stats[[pathway]] <- stats
  
  # Cleanup
  seurat_subset$Temp_Module_1 <- NULL
}

# 4. Final Assembly & Export
results_df <- bind_rows(all_pathway_stats) %>%
  adjust_pvalue(method = "BH", p.col = "p") %>%
  add_significance("p.adj")

write.csv(results_df, file.path(si_dir, "Telomere_Pathway_Stats.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

message("Success! Telomere analysis complete. Results in: ", si_dir)
```

## ED2 telomere heatmap clustered

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(msigdbr)
library(rstatix)
library(ggdendro)     # install.packages("ggdendro")
library(patchwork)
library(tibble)

SEED    <- 42
BASE_PT <- 7
si_dir  <- "SI_Figure_Telomeres"
dir.create(si_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ---- 1. Subset and gene sets -------------------------------------------------
seurat_subset <- subset(amnion_seurat_object,
                        subset = `Gestational Age` %in% c("Week 25", "Week 38"))

all_human_genesets <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens")
telomere_pathways  <- all_human_genesets %>%
  filter(grepl("TELOMERE_MAINTENANCE", gs_name, ignore.case = TRUE))
pathway_names <- unique(telomere_pathways$gs_name)

cat("Pathways found:", length(pathway_names), "\n"); print(pathway_names)

# ---- 2. Score every pathway --------------------------------------------------
donor_means <- list()

for (pathway in pathway_names) {
  genes <- telomere_pathways %>% filter(gs_name == pathway) %>%
    pull(gene_symbol) %>% unique()
  valid <- intersect(genes, rownames(seurat_subset))
  if (length(valid) < 5) { message("Skipping (too few genes): ", pathway); next }

  set.seed(SEED)
  seurat_subset <- AddModuleScore(seurat_subset, features = list(valid),
                                  name = "Temp_Module_")

  d <- FetchData(seurat_subset,
                 vars = c("Temp_Module_1", "Cell Type", "Gestational Age",
                          "Donor_Nr"))
  colnames(d) <- c("Expression", "cell_type", "Timepoint", "Donor_Nr")
  d$pathway <- pathway; d$n_genes <- length(valid)

  donor_means[[pathway]] <- d %>%
    group_by(pathway, n_genes, cell_type, Donor_Nr, Timepoint) %>%
    summarise(mean_score = mean(Expression, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  seurat_subset$Temp_Module_1 <- NULL
}

donor_df <- bind_rows(donor_means)

# ---- 3. Statistics -----------------------------------------------------------
stats_df <- donor_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(pathway, n_genes, cell_type) %>%
  dplyr::filter(dplyr::n_distinct(Timepoint) == 2,
                sum(Timepoint == "Week 25") >= 2,
                sum(Timepoint == "Week 38") >= 2,
                sd(mean_score, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) %>%
  dplyr::group_modify(~{
    tt <- t.test(mean_score ~ Timepoint, data = .x, var.equal = FALSE)
    m  <- .x %>% dplyr::group_by(Timepoint) %>%
            dplyr::summarise(m = mean(mean_score), s = sd(mean_score),
                             n = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop")
    sp <- sqrt(((m$n[1]-1)*m$s[1]^2 + (m$n[2]-1)*m$s[2]^2) / (sum(m$n)-2))
    tibble::tibble(n1 = m$n[1], n2 = m$n[2],
                   mean_week25 = m$m[1], mean_week38 = m$m[2],
                   sd_week25 = m$s[1],   sd_week38 = m$s[2],
                   statistic = unname(tt$statistic),
                   df = unname(tt$parameter), p = tt$p.value,
                   cohens_d = (m$m[2] - m$m[1]) / sp)
  }) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(p.adj = p.adjust(p, "BH"),
                p.adj.signif = as.character(
                  cut(p.adj, c(-Inf,.001,.01,.05,Inf),
                      c("***","**","*","ns"))),
                higher_at = ifelse(mean_week38 > mean_week25,
                                   "week 38", "week 25"),
                test = "two-sided Welch t-test on donor means, BH-adjusted")
# ---- 4. Delta matrix ---------------------------------------------------------
delta_df <- donor_df %>%
  group_by(pathway, n_genes, cell_type, Timepoint) %>%
  summarise(grand = mean(mean_score), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Timepoint, values_from = grand) %>%
  mutate(delta = `Week 38` - `Week 25`)

heat_df <- delta_df %>%
  left_join(stats_df %>% dplyr::select(pathway, cell_type, p, p.adj, p.adj.signif),
            by = c("pathway", "cell_type")) %>%
  mutate(
    # adjusted P in every tile, 2 decimals, leading zero dropped to save width
    p_label = ifelse(is.na(p.adj), "n.t.",
                     sub("^0\\.", ".", formatC(p.adj, format = "f", digits = 2))),
    p_face  = ifelse(!is.na(p.adj) & p.adj < 0.05, "bold", "plain"),
    pathway_label = paste0(
      str_wrap(str_to_sentence(gsub("_", " ",
                sub("^(GOBP_|REACTOME_)", "", pathway))), width = 38),
      " (", n_genes, ")"),
    cell_label = gsub("_", " ", cell_type))

# ---- 5. Hierarchical clustering of BOTH axes ---------------------------------
mat <- heat_df %>%
  dplyr::select(pathway_label, cell_label, delta) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = cell_label, values_from = delta) %>%
  column_to_rownames("pathway_label") %>%
  as.matrix()

mat[is.na(mat)] <- 0

row_hc <- hclust(dist(mat),    method = "average")   # pathways
col_hc <- hclust(dist(t(mat)), method = "average")   # cell types

heat_df$pathway_label <- factor(heat_df$pathway_label,
                                levels = rownames(mat)[row_hc$order])
heat_df$cell_label    <- factor(heat_df$cell_label,
                                levels = colnames(mat)[col_hc$order])

lim <- max(abs(heat_df$delta), na.rm = TRUE)

# ---- 6. Heatmap body ---------------------------------------------------------
p_heat <- ggplot(heat_df, aes(x = cell_label, y = pathway_label, fill = delta)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "white", high = "#B2182B",
                       midpoint = 0, limits = c(-lim, lim),
                       breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(4)) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0, 0), position = "right") +
  guides(fill = guide_colourbar(barwidth = unit(3, "mm"),
                                barheight = unit(25, "mm"),
                                ticks.linewidth = 0.2)) +
  theme_ncb(base_size = BASE_PT) +
  theme(axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1,
                                    size = BASE_PT),
        axis.text.y  = element_text(size = BASE_PT, lineheight = 0.9),
        panel.grid   = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA,
                                    linewidth = 0.25),
        legend.title = element_text(size = BASE_PT),
        legend.text  = element_text(size = BASE_PT),
        plot.margin  = margin(0, 1, 1, 0, "mm")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL,
       fill = "\u0394 module score\n(week 38 \u2212 week 25)")

# ---- 7. Dendrograms ----------------------------------------------------------
row_dendro <- ggplot(segment(dendro_data(as.dendrogram(row_hc)))) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend), linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0.5)) +
  scale_y_reverse(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  coord_flip() + theme_void() +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 1, 0, "mm"))

col_dendro <- ggplot(segment(dendro_data(as.dendrogram(col_hc)))) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend), linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0.5)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0, "mm"))

# ---- 8. Assemble -------------------------------------------------------------
layout <- "
#B
AC
"
p_final <- row_dendro + col_dendro + p_heat +
  plot_layout(design = layout,
              widths  = c(0.11, 1),
              heights = c(0.11, 1))

save_panel(p_final, file.path(si_dir, "ED2_telomere_heatmap_clustered"),
           width_mm = 170, height_mm = 135)

print(p_final)

# ---- 9. Export ---------------------------------------------------------------
write.csv(stats_df, file.path(si_dir, "Telomere_Pathway_Stats.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

dir.create("SourceData", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
writexl::write_xlsx(
  list(donor_means = as.data.frame(donor_df),
       delta       = as.data.frame(delta_df),
       statistics  = as.data.frame(stats_df)),
  file.path(si_dir, "SourceData_ED2_telomere.xlsx"))

## register in the single Source_Data.xlsx as well
sd_add("ED2_telomere_donor_values", as.data.frame(donor_df))
sd_add("ED2_telomere_delta",        as.data.frame(delta_df))
sd_add("ED2_telomere_statistics",   as.data.frame(stats_df))

# ---- 10. Legend text ---------------------------------------------------------
n_sig <- sum(stats_df$p.adj < 0.05)
cat("\n================= FIGURE LEGEND =================\n\n")
cat(sprintf(
"Telomere maintenance pathway activity between mid-gestation and term.
Change in mean module score (week 38 minus week 25) for %d telomere
maintenance gene sets across %d cell types. Module scores were computed per
nucleus using Seurat AddModuleScore with a fixed random seed and averaged per
donor. Numbers in each tile give the Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted P value from a
two-sided Welch t-test on donor-level means (n = 6 donors at week 25, n = 5 at
week 38); values below 0.05 are shown in bold, and 'n.t.' marks comparisons not
tested owing to insufficient donors. Numbers in parentheses after each pathway
name give the number of detected genes. Rows and columns are ordered by
hierarchical clustering (Euclidean distance, average linkage) of the score
differences. %s\n\n",
  n_distinct(heat_df$pathway), n_distinct(heat_df$cell_label),
  if (n_sig == 0)
    "No comparison remained significant after correction for multiple testing."
  else
    sprintf("%d of %d comparisons remained significant after correction.",
            n_sig, nrow(stats_df))))

```


### DAMPs

```{r}
"from: https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/physiology/articles/10.3389/fphys.2020.00602/full#T1"
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(rstatix)
library(stringr)

# 1. Setup Folder Structure
si_dir <- "SI_Figure_DAMPs"
if (!dir.exists(si_dir)) dir.create(si_dir)

# 2. Define Genes
damp_genes <- c(
  "ACAN", "BGN", "DCN", "FN1", "FGA", "FGB", "FGG", "TNC", "VCAN", # ECM DAMPs
  "PPIA", "ACTB", "HSPA1A", "HSPA1B", "HSPA2", "HSP90AA1", "S100A8", "S100A9", "S100A12", "APP", # Chaperones
  "HMGB1", "IL1A", "IL33", "SF3B3", "H3-3A" # Nuclear Alarmins
)

# Subset
seurat_subset <- subset(amnion_seurat_object, subset = `Gestational Age` %in% c("Week 25", "Week 38"))

# Verify genes
valid_genes <- intersect(damp_genes, rownames(seurat_subset))
all_gene_stats <- list()

message("Starting DAMPs analysis. Figures and stats saved to: ", si_dir)

# 3. Execution Loop
for (gene in valid_genes) {
  
  # A. Visualization
  plot_data <- FetchData(object = seurat_subset, vars = c(gene, "Cell Type", "Gestational Age"))
  colnames(plot_data)[1] <- "Expression"
  
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = `Cell Type`, y = Expression, fill = `Gestational Age`)) +
    geom_violin(scale = "width", position = position_dodge(0.8), color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, position = position_dodge(0.8), outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Week 25" = "#56B4E9", "Week 38" = "#E69F00")) +
    labs(
      title = paste("DAMP / Alarmin Profile:", gene),
      subtitle = "Gestational Divergence: Mid-Gestation vs. Term",
      x = "Cell Type",
      y = "Log-Normalized Expression"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  
  # Save plot
#  ggsave(
#    filename = file.path(si_dir, paste0(gene, "_DAMP.png")), 
#    plot = p, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300
#  )
  
  # B. Statistics (Pseudobulk)
  meta_scores <- FetchData(object = seurat_subset, vars = c("Donor_Nr", "Cell Type", "Gestational Age", gene))
  colnames(meta_scores) <- c("Donor_Nr", "cell_type", "Timepoint", "Expression")
  
  pseudobulk_df <- meta_scores %>%
    group_by(Donor_Nr, cell_type, Timepoint) %>%
    summarise(mean_expr = mean(Expression, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  
  cell_types <- unique(pseudobulk_df$cell_type)
  
  for (ct in cell_types) {
    ct_data <- pseudobulk_df %>% filter(cell_type == ct)
    if(length(unique(ct_data$Timepoint)) == 2 && nrow(ct_data) >= 3) {
      test_res <- ct_data %>% t_test(mean_expr ~ Timepoint) %>% add_significance("p")
      test_res$cell_type <- ct
      test_res$gene <- gene 
      all_gene_stats[[paste0(gene, "_", ct)]] <- test_res
    }
  }
}

# 4. Final Assembly
results_df <- bind_rows(all_gene_stats)

if (nrow(results_df) > 0) {
  results_df <- results_df %>%
    adjust_pvalue(method = "BH", p.col = "p") %>%
    add_significance("p.adj") %>%
    arrange(p.adj)
  
  write.csv(results_df, file.path(si_dir, "DAMP_Stats.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  message("Analysis Complete. Results and figures saved in ", si_dir)
}
```

## ED3 DAMP dotplot clustered

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(rstatix)
library(ggdendro)
library(patchwork)
library(tibble)

# =============================================================================
# Extended Data Figure 3 -- DAMP / alarmin expression, mid-gestation vs term
#
# DOTPLOT rather than heatmap, because a plain heatmap cannot distinguish
# "expressed but unchanged" from "not expressed at all" -- both give delta ~ 0.
#
#   dot COLOUR = change in mean expression (week 38 - week 25)
#   dot SIZE   = percentage of nuclei expressing the gene (detection rate)
#   grey X     = not tested (undetected, or too few donors)
#   asterisk   = BH-adjusted P < 0.05
#
# A gene that is essentially absent now appears as a vanishingly small dot,
# so it can no longer be mistaken for a stable, well-expressed gene.
# =============================================================================

BASE_PT   <- 7
MIN_PCT   <- 1      # % of nuclei expressing, below which we do not test
si_dir    <- "SI_Figure_DAMPs"
dir.create(si_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ---- 1. Gene list and subset -------------------------------------------------
damp_genes <- c(
  "ACAN", "BGN", "DCN", "FN1", "FGA", "FGB", "FGG", "TNC", "VCAN",
  "PPIA", "ACTB", "HSPA1A", "HSPA1B", "HSPA2", "HSP90AA1",
  "S100A8", "S100A9", "S100A12", "APP",
  "HMGB1", "IL1A", "IL33", "SF3B3", "H3-3A")

seurat_subset <- subset(amnion_seurat_object,
                        subset = `Gestational Age` %in% c("Week 25", "Week 38"))

valid_genes <- intersect(damp_genes, rownames(seurat_subset))
cat("Genes requested:", length(damp_genes),
    "| detected in object:", length(valid_genes), "\n")
if (length(setdiff(damp_genes, valid_genes))) {
  cat("Absent from object:\n"); print(setdiff(damp_genes, valid_genes))
}

# ---- 2. Fetch once, compute donor means AND detection rate -------------------
expr <- FetchData(seurat_subset,
                  vars = c(valid_genes, "Cell Type", "Gestational Age",
                           "Donor_Nr"))
colnames(expr)[(length(valid_genes) + 1):ncol(expr)] <-
  c("cell_type", "Timepoint", "Donor_Nr")

long_df <- expr %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(valid_genes), names_to = "gene",
               values_to = "Expression")

# donor-level means -> input to the statistics
donor_df <- long_df %>%
  group_by(gene, cell_type, Donor_Nr, Timepoint) %>%
  summarise(mean_expr = mean(Expression, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# detection rate per gene x cell type, pooled over both timepoints
detect_df <- long_df %>%
  group_by(gene, cell_type) %>%
  summarise(pct_expressing = 100 * mean(Expression > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_overall   = mean(Expression, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

cat("\nDetection rate summary (% of nuclei expressing):\n")
print(detect_df %>% group_by(gene) %>%
        summarise(max_pct = round(max(pct_expressing), 1), .groups = "drop") %>%
        arrange(max_pct) %>% as.data.frame())

# ---- 3. Statistics, only where the gene is actually detected ----------------
# ---- 3. Statistics, only where the gene is actually detected ----------------
testable <- detect_df %>% dplyr::filter(pct_expressing >= MIN_PCT) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, cell_type)

stats_df <- donor_df %>%
  dplyr::semi_join(testable, by = c("gene", "cell_type")) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(gene, cell_type) %>%
  dplyr::filter(dplyr::n_distinct(Timepoint) == 2,
                sum(Timepoint == "Week 25") >= 2,
                sum(Timepoint == "Week 38") >= 2,
                sd(mean_expr, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) %>%
  dplyr::group_modify(~{
    tt <- t.test(mean_expr ~ Timepoint, data = .x, var.equal = FALSE)
    m  <- .x %>% dplyr::group_by(Timepoint) %>%
            dplyr::summarise(m = mean(mean_expr), s = sd(mean_expr),
                             n = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop")
    sp <- sqrt(((m$n[1]-1)*m$s[1]^2 + (m$n[2]-1)*m$s[2]^2) / (sum(m$n)-2))
    tibble::tibble(n1 = m$n[1], n2 = m$n[2],
                   mean_week25 = m$m[1], mean_week38 = m$m[2],
                   sd_week25 = m$s[1],   sd_week38 = m$s[2],
                   statistic = unname(tt$statistic),
                   df = unname(tt$parameter), p = tt$p.value,
                   cohens_d = (m$m[2] - m$m[1]) / sp)
  }) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(p.adj = p.adjust(p, "BH"),
                p.adj.signif = as.character(
                  cut(p.adj, c(-Inf,.001,.01,.05,Inf),
                      c("***","**","*","ns"))),
                higher_at = ifelse(mean_week38 > mean_week25,
                                   "week 38", "week 25"),
                test = "two-sided Welch t-test on donor means, BH-adjusted")

# ---- 4. Assemble the plotting frame -----------------------------------------
delta_df <- donor_df %>%
  group_by(gene, cell_type, Timepoint) %>%
  summarise(grand = mean(mean_expr), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Timepoint, values_from = grand) %>%
  mutate(delta = `Week 38` - `Week 25`)

plot_df <- delta_df %>%
  left_join(detect_df, by = c("gene", "cell_type")) %>%
  left_join(stats_df %>% dplyr::select(gene, cell_type, p, p.adj, p.adj.signif),
            by = c("gene", "cell_type")) %>%
  mutate(tested     = !is.na(p.adj),
         star       = ifelse(tested & p.adj < 0.05, "*", ""),
         cell_label = gsub("_", " ", cell_type),
         # blank the colour for untested points so they cannot be over-read
         delta_show = ifelse(tested, delta, NA_real_))

# ---- 5. Cluster both axes on the delta matrix -------------------------------
mat <- plot_df %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, cell_label, delta) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = cell_label, values_from = delta) %>%
  column_to_rownames("gene") %>% as.matrix()
mat[is.na(mat)] <- 0

row_hc <- hclust(dist(mat),    method = "average")
col_hc <- hclust(dist(t(mat)), method = "average")

plot_df$gene       <- factor(plot_df$gene,
                             levels = rownames(mat)[row_hc$order])
plot_df$cell_label <- factor(plot_df$cell_label,
                             levels = colnames(mat)[col_hc$order])

lim <- max(abs(plot_df$delta_show), na.rm = TRUE)

# ---- 6. Dotplot --------------------------------------------------------------
p_main <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = cell_label, y = gene)) +
  # faint grid so empty positions are still readable
  geom_tile(fill = NA, colour = "grey92", linewidth = 0.2) +
  # untested / undetected: small grey cross
  geom_point(data = subset(plot_df, !tested),
             shape = 4, size = 0.6, stroke = 0.3, colour = "grey65") +
  # tested: size = detection rate, colour = change
  geom_point(data = subset(plot_df, tested),
             aes(size = pct_expressing, fill = delta_show),
             shape = 21, stroke = 0.15, colour = "grey30") +
  geom_text(aes(label = star), size = 9 / .pt, vjust = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "white", high = "#B2182B",
                       midpoint = 0, limits = c(-lim, lim),
                       breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(4), na.value = "grey85") +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 3.2, breaks = c(1, 10, 25, 50, 75)) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(add = 0.6)) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = expansion(add = 0.6), position = "right") +
  guides(fill = guide_colourbar(barwidth = unit(3, "mm"),
                                barheight = unit(22, "mm"),
                                ticks.linewidth = 0.2, order = 1),
         size = guide_legend(override.aes = list(fill = "grey60"), order = 2)) +
  theme_ncb(base_size = BASE_PT) +
  theme(axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1,
                                    size = BASE_PT),
        axis.text.y  = element_text(size = BASE_PT),
        panel.grid   = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA,
                                    linewidth = 0.25),
        legend.title = element_text(size = BASE_PT),
        legend.text  = element_text(size = BASE_PT),
        legend.key.size = unit(3, "mm"),
        plot.margin  = margin(0, 1, 1, 0, "mm")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL,
       fill = "\u0394 mean expression\n(week 38 \u2212 week 25)",
       size = "% nuclei\nexpressing")

# ---- 7. Dendrograms ----------------------------------------------------------
row_dendro <- ggplot(segment(dendro_data(as.dendrogram(row_hc)))) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend), linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0.6)) +
  scale_y_reverse(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  coord_flip() + theme_void() +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 1, 0, "mm"))

col_dendro <- ggplot(segment(dendro_data(as.dendrogram(col_hc)))) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend), linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0.6)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0, "mm"))

layout <- "
#B
AC
"
p_final <- row_dendro + col_dendro + p_main +
  plot_layout(design = layout,
              widths  = c(0.11, 1),
              heights = c(0.09, 1))

save_panel(p_final, file.path(si_dir, "ED3_DAMP_dotplot_clustered"),
           width_mm = 175, height_mm = 160)

print(p_final)

# ---- 8. Export ---------------------------------------------------------------
write.csv(stats_df, file.path(si_dir, "DAMP_Stats.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

writexl::write_xlsx(
  list(donor_means    = as.data.frame(donor_df),
       detection_rate = as.data.frame(detect_df),
       delta          = as.data.frame(delta_df),
       statistics     = as.data.frame(stats_df)),
  file.path(si_dir, "SourceData_ED3_DAMPs.xlsx"))

sd_add("ED3_DAMP_donor_values",    as.data.frame(donor_df))
sd_add("ED3_DAMP_detection_rate",  as.data.frame(detect_df))
sd_add("ED3_DAMP_statistics",      as.data.frame(stats_df))

cat("\nSaved to", si_dir, "\n")
```

### Oxidative Stress etc.

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(msigdbr)
library(rstatix)

# 1. Setup Folder Structure
si_dir <- "SI_Figure_Pathways"
if (!dir.exists(si_dir)) dir.create(si_dir)

# 2. Define the "Reviewer-Requested" Gene Sets
pathway_terms <- c(
  "GOBP_EXTRACELLULAR_MATRIX_ORGANIZATION",
  "GOBP_EXTRACELLULAR_MATRIX_DISASSEMBLY",
  "GOBP_CELLULAR_SENESCENCE",
  "GOBP_REPLICATIVE_SENESCENCE",
  "GOBP_RESPONSE_TO_OXIDATIVE_STRESS",
  "GOBP_CELLULAR_RESPONSE_TO_OXIDATIVE_STRESS"
)

# Fetch gene lists
all_human_genesets <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens")
all_pathway_stats <- list()

# Subset
seurat_subset <- subset(amnion_seurat_object, subset = `Gestational Age` %in% c("Week 25", "Week 38"))

message("Starting directed analysis. Saving figures to: ", si_dir)

# 3. Execution Loop
for (pathway in pathway_terms) {
  
  # Extract genes
  pathway_genes <- all_human_genesets %>%
    filter(gs_name == pathway) %>%
    pull(gene_symbol) %>%
    unique()
  
  valid_genes <- intersect(pathway_genes, rownames(seurat_subset))
  
  if (length(valid_genes) < 5) {
    message("Skipping ", pathway, " - Insufficient coverage.")
    next
  }
  
  # Calculate Module Score
  seurat_subset <- AddModuleScore(
    object = seurat_subset, 
    features = list(valid_genes), 
    name = "Temp_Module_"
  )
  
  # Fetch data
  plot_data <- FetchData(
    object = seurat_subset, 
    vars = c("Temp_Module_1", "Cell Type", "Gestational Age", "Donor_Nr")
  )
  colnames(plot_data) <- c("Expression", "cell_type", "Timepoint", "Donor_Nr")
  
  # Generate Plot
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = cell_type, y = Expression, fill = Timepoint)) +
    geom_violin(scale = "width", position = position_dodge(0.8), alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, position = position_dodge(0.8), outlier.shape = NA) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Week 25" = "#56B4E9", "Week 38" = "#E69F00")) +
    labs(
      title = "Directed Pathway Analysis",
      subtitle = str_replace_all(pathway, "_", " "),
      x = "Cell Type",
      y = "Module Score (Mean Expression)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  
  # Save Plot
  safe_name <- str_replace_all(pathway, "GOBP_", "")
#  ggsave(
#    filename = file.path(si_dir, paste0(safe_name, "_plot.png")), 
#    plot = p, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300
#  )
  
  # Statistics (Pseudobulk)
  stats <- plot_data %>% 
    group_by(Donor_Nr, cell_type, Timepoint) %>% 
    summarise(mean_score = mean(Expression, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(cell_type) %>% 
    t_test(mean_score ~ Timepoint) %>%
    add_significance("p")
  
  stats$module <- pathway
  all_pathway_stats[[pathway]] <- stats
  
  # Cleanup
  seurat_subset$Temp_Module_1 <- NULL
}

# 4. Final Assembly & Export
results_df <- bind_rows(all_pathway_stats) %>%
  adjust_pvalue(method = "BH", p.col = "p") %>%
  add_significance("p.adj")

write.csv(results_df, file.path(si_dir, "Pathway_Enrichment_Stats.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

message("Success! Plots and stats saved in: ", si_dir)
```

## ED5 directed pathways

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(msigdbr)
library(rstatix)

SEED    <- 42
BASE_PT <- 7
si_dir  <- "SI_Figure_Pathways"
dir.create(si_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ---- 1. Gene sets ------------------------------------------------------------
pathway_terms <- c(
  "GOBP_EXTERNAL_ENCAPSULATING_STRUCTURE_ORGANIZATION",  # was ECM organization
  "GOBP_EXTRACELLULAR_MATRIX_DISASSEMBLY",
  "GOBP_CELLULAR_SENESCENCE",
  "GOBP_REPLICATIVE_SENESCENCE",
  "GOBP_RESPONSE_TO_OXIDATIVE_STRESS",
  "GOBP_CELLULAR_RESPONSE_TO_OXIDATIVE_STRESS")

all_human_genesets <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens")

for (tm in pathway_terms) {
  n <- sum(all_human_genesets$gs_name == tm)
  cat(sprintf("%-46s %6d gene records\n", tm, n))
  if (n == 0) warning("Term not found in msigdbr: ", tm)
}

seurat_subset <- subset(amnion_seurat_object,
                        subset = `Gestational Age` %in% c("Week 25", "Week 38"))

# ---- 2. Score every pathway --------------------------------------------------
score_list <- list()

for (pathway in pathway_terms) {
  genes <- all_human_genesets %>% filter(gs_name == pathway) %>%
    pull(gene_symbol) %>% unique()
  valid <- intersect(genes, rownames(seurat_subset))
  cat(sprintf("  %-46s %5d detected genes\n", pathway, length(valid)))
  if (length(valid) < 5) { message("Skipping ", pathway); next }

  set.seed(SEED)
  seurat_subset <- AddModuleScore(seurat_subset, features = list(valid),
                                  name = "Temp_Module_")

  d <- FetchData(seurat_subset,
                 vars = c("Temp_Module_1", "Cell Type", "Gestational Age",
                          "Donor_Nr"))
  colnames(d) <- c("Score", "cell_type", "Timepoint", "Donor_Nr")
  d$pathway <- pathway; d$n_genes <- length(valid)
  score_list[[pathway]] <- d

  seurat_subset$Temp_Module_1 <- NULL
}

plot_data <- bind_rows(score_list) %>%
  mutate(cell_type = gsub("_", " ", cell_type))

# ---- 3. Facet labels: full GOBP name + gene count ---------------------------
label_lookup <- plot_data %>%
  distinct(pathway, n_genes) %>%
  mutate(facet_label = paste0(str_wrap(str_replace_all(pathway, "_", " "),
                                       width = 46),
                              "\nBased on ", n_genes, " detected genes"))

plot_data <- plot_data %>% left_join(label_lookup, by = c("pathway", "n_genes"))

facet_levels <- label_lookup %>%
  mutate(pathway = factor(pathway, levels = pathway_terms)) %>%
  arrange(pathway) %>% pull(facet_label)
plot_data$facet_label <- factor(plot_data$facet_label, levels = facet_levels)

# ---- 4. Statistics: donor pseudobulk per pathway x cell type ----------------
donor_df <- plot_data %>%
  dplyr::group_by(pathway, n_genes, facet_label, cell_type,
                  Donor_Nr, Timepoint) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(mean_score = mean(Score, na.rm = TRUE),
                   n_nuclei   = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop")

stats_df <- donor_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(pathway, n_genes, facet_label, cell_type) %>%
  dplyr::filter(dplyr::n_distinct(Timepoint) == 2,
                sum(Timepoint == "Week 25") >= 2,
                sum(Timepoint == "Week 38") >= 2,
                sd(mean_score, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) %>%
  dplyr::group_modify(~{
    tt <- t.test(mean_score ~ Timepoint, data = .x, var.equal = FALSE)
    m  <- .x %>% dplyr::group_by(Timepoint) %>%
            dplyr::summarise(m = mean(mean_score), s = sd(mean_score),
                             n = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop")
    sp <- sqrt(((m$n[1]-1)*m$s[1]^2 + (m$n[2]-1)*m$s[2]^2) / (sum(m$n)-2))
    tibble::tibble(n1 = m$n[1], n2 = m$n[2],
                   mean_week25 = m$m[1], mean_week38 = m$m[2],
                   sd_week25 = m$s[1],   sd_week38 = m$s[2],
                   statistic = unname(tt$statistic),
                   df = unname(tt$parameter), p = tt$p.value,
                   cohens_d = (m$m[2] - m$m[1]) / sp)
  }) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(p.adj = p.adjust(p, "BH"),
                p.adj.signif = as.character(
                  cut(p.adj, c(-Inf,.001,.01,.05,Inf),
                      c("***","**","*","ns"))),
                higher_at = ifelse(mean_week38 > mean_week25,
                                   "week 38", "week 25"),
                test = "two-sided Welch t-test on donor means, BH-adjusted")

# ---- 5. Asterisk positions ---------------------------------------------------
sig_df <- stats_df %>%
  filter(p.adj < 0.05) %>%
  left_join(plot_data %>%
              group_by(facet_label, cell_type) %>%
              summarise(y = max(Score, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop"),
            by = c("facet_label", "cell_type")) %>%
  mutate(label = p.adj.signif)

# ---- 6. Single faceted violin panel ------------------------------------------
p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = cell_type, y = Score, fill = Timepoint)) +
  geom_violin(scale = "width", position = position_dodge(0.8),
              alpha = 0.7, linewidth = 0.15, colour = "grey30") +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.12, position = position_dodge(0.8),
               outlier.shape = NA, linewidth = 0.15) +
  {if (nrow(sig_df) > 0)
    geom_text(data = sig_df, aes(x = cell_type, y = y * 1.05, label = label),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 8 / .pt, vjust = 0)} +
  facet_wrap(~facet_label, ncol = 2, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Week 25" = "#56B4E9", "Week 38" = "#E69F00")) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(4),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.10))) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1)) +
  theme_ncb(base_size = BASE_PT) +
  theme(axis.text.x        = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1,
                                          size = BASE_PT),
        axis.text.y        = element_text(size = BASE_PT),
        strip.text         = element_text(size = BASE_PT, hjust = 0,
                                          lineheight = 1.1,
                                          margin = margin(1, 1, 2, 1, "mm")),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        panel.border       = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA,
                                          linewidth = 0.25),
        panel.spacing      = unit(2.5, "mm"),
        legend.position    = "top",
        legend.title       = element_blank(),
        legend.key.size    = unit(3, "mm"),
        legend.margin      = margin(t = -1, b = -2, unit = "mm")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Module score")

save_panel(p, file.path(si_dir, "ED5_directed_pathways"),
           width_mm = 175, height_mm = 190)

print(p)

# ---- 7. Export ---------------------------------------------------------------
write.csv(stats_df, file.path(si_dir, "Pathway_Enrichment_Stats.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

dir.create("SourceData", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
writexl::write_xlsx(
  list(donor_means = as.data.frame(donor_df),
       statistics  = as.data.frame(stats_df)),
  file.path(si_dir, "SourceData_ED5_pathways.xlsx"))

sd_add("ED5_pathways_donor_values", as.data.frame(donor_df))
sd_add("ED5_pathways_statistics",   as.data.frame(stats_df))

cat("\nSaved to", si_dir, "\n")
```


### Specific Markers PPROM

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(rstatix)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Setup Folder Structure
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
si_dir <- "SI_Figure_SpecificMarkers"
if (!dir.exists(si_dir)) dir.create(si_dir)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Define Targeted PPROM Biomarkers
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
pprom_genes <- c(
  "CDKN2A", "CDKN1A", "TP53", "MAPK14",    # Senescence
  "MMP9", "MMP1", "MMP3", "TIMP1", "TIMP3",# ECM Degradation
  "SOD1", "SOD2", "CAT", "GPX1",           # Oxidative Stress
  "IL1B", "IL6", "CXCL8", "TNF"            # Inflammation / SASP
)

seurat_subset <- subset(amnion_seurat_object, subset = `Gestational Age` %in% c("Week 25", "Week 38"))

valid_genes <- intersect(pprom_genes, rownames(seurat_subset))

all_gene_stats <- list()

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Execution Loop with Auto-Save
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
message("Starting targeted PPROM analysis. Saving figures to: ", si_dir)

for (gene in valid_genes) {
  
  # A. Visualization
  plot_data <- FetchData(object = seurat_subset, vars = c(gene, "Cell Type", "Gestational Age"))
  colnames(plot_data)[1] <- "Expression"
  
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = `Cell Type`, y = Expression, fill = `Gestational Age`)) +
    geom_violin(scale = "width", position = position_dodge(0.8), color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, position = position_dodge(0.8), outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Week 25" = "#56B4E9", "Week 38" = "#E69F00")) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Targeted Analysis:", gene),
      subtitle = "PPROM Pathophysiology Marker",
      x = "Cell Type",
      y = "Log-Normalized Expression"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  
  # Save the plot
#  ggsave(
#    filename = file.path(si_dir, paste0(gene, "_boxplot.png")), 
#    plot = p, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300
#  )
  
  # B. Statistics (Pseudobulking)
  meta_scores <- FetchData(object = seurat_subset, vars = c("Donor_Nr", "Cell Type", "Gestational Age", gene))
  colnames(meta_scores) <- c("Donor_Nr", "cell_type", "Timepoint", "Expression")
  
  pseudobulk_df <- meta_scores %>%
    group_by(Donor_Nr, cell_type, Timepoint) %>%
    summarise(mean_expr = mean(Expression, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  
  cell_types <- unique(pseudobulk_df$cell_type)
  
  for (ct in cell_types) {
    ct_data <- pseudobulk_df %>% filter(cell_type == ct)
    if(length(unique(ct_data$Timepoint)) == 2 && nrow(ct_data) >= 3) {
      test_res <- ct_data %>% t_test(mean_expr ~ Timepoint) %>% add_significance("p")
      test_res$cell_type <- ct
      test_res$gene <- gene 
      all_gene_stats[[paste0(gene, "_", ct)]] <- test_res
    }
  }
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Final Export of Statistical Table
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
results_df <- bind_rows(all_gene_stats)

if (nrow(results_df) > 0) {
  results_df <- results_df %>%
    adjust_pvalue(method = "BH", p.col = "p") %>%
    add_significance("p.adj") %>%
    arrange(p.adj)
  
  # Save stats to CSV
  write.csv(results_df, file.path(si_dir, "PPROM_Markers_Stats.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  message("Success! Figures saved in ", si_dir, " and statistical results saved as 'PPROM_Markers_Stats.csv'")
}
```

## ED4 PPROM markers dotplot

```{r}

library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(rstatix)
library(ggdendro)
library(patchwork)
library(tibble)

# =============================================================================
# Extended Data Figure 4 -- Targeted PPROM pathophysiology markers
#
# DOTPLOT rather than heatmap: several of these genes (MMP1, MMP3, MMP9, IL6,
# TNF) are barely detected, and on a plain heatmap an undetected gene and a
# stable, well-expressed gene both show delta ~ 0. Encoding detection rate as
# dot size separates the two.
#
#   dot COLOUR = change in mean expression (week 38 - week 25)
#   dot SIZE   = % of nuclei expressing the gene
#   grey X     = not tested (below detection threshold or too few donors)
#   asterisk   = BH-adjusted P < 0.05
#   left bar   = functional class of each gene
# =============================================================================

BASE_PT <- 7
MIN_PCT <- 1        # % of nuclei expressing, below which we do not test
si_dir  <- "SI_Figure_SpecificMarkers"
dir.create(si_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ---- 1. Genes, grouped by function -------------------------------------------
gene_class <- c(
  CDKN2A = "Senescence",      CDKN1A = "Senescence",
  TP53   = "Senescence",      MAPK14 = "Senescence",
  MMP9   = "ECM degradation", MMP1   = "ECM degradation",
  MMP3   = "ECM degradation", TIMP1  = "ECM degradation",
  TIMP3  = "ECM degradation",
  SOD1   = "Oxidative stress", SOD2  = "Oxidative stress",
  CAT    = "Oxidative stress", GPX1  = "Oxidative stress",
  IL1B   = "Inflammation",     IL6   = "Inflammation",
  CXCL8  = "Inflammation",     TNF   = "Inflammation")

pprom_genes <- names(gene_class)

class_levels <- c("Senescence", "ECM degradation",
                  "Oxidative stress", "Inflammation")
class_cols   <- c("Senescence"       = "#8DA0CB",
                  "ECM degradation"  = "#66C2A5",
                  "Oxidative stress" = "#FC8D62",
                  "Inflammation"     = "#E78AC3")

seurat_subset <- subset(amnion_seurat_object,
                        subset = `Gestational Age` %in% c("Week 25", "Week 38"))

valid_genes <- intersect(pprom_genes, rownames(seurat_subset))
cat("Genes requested:", length(pprom_genes),
    "| detected in object:", length(valid_genes), "\n")
if (length(setdiff(pprom_genes, valid_genes))) {
  cat("Absent from object:\n"); print(setdiff(pprom_genes, valid_genes))
}

# ---- 2. Fetch once; donor means and detection rate ---------------------------
expr <- FetchData(seurat_subset,
                  vars = c(valid_genes, "Cell Type", "Gestational Age",
                           "Donor_Nr"))
colnames(expr)[(length(valid_genes) + 1):ncol(expr)] <-
  c("cell_type", "Timepoint", "Donor_Nr")

long_df <- expr %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(valid_genes), names_to = "gene",
               values_to = "Expression")

donor_df <- long_df %>%
  group_by(gene, cell_type, Donor_Nr, Timepoint) %>%
  summarise(mean_expr = mean(Expression, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

detect_df <- long_df %>%
  group_by(gene, cell_type) %>%
  summarise(pct_expressing = 100 * mean(Expression > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

cat("\nMaximum detection rate per gene (% nuclei, best cell type):\n")
print(detect_df %>% group_by(gene) %>%
        summarise(max_pct = round(max(pct_expressing), 1), .groups = "drop") %>%
        arrange(max_pct) %>% as.data.frame())

# ---- 3. Statistics -----------------------------------------------------------
# ---- 3. Statistics -----------------------------------------------------------
testable <- detect_df %>% dplyr::filter(pct_expressing >= MIN_PCT) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, cell_type)

stats_df <- donor_df %>%
  dplyr::semi_join(testable, by = c("gene", "cell_type")) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(gene, cell_type) %>%
  dplyr::filter(dplyr::n_distinct(Timepoint) == 2,
                sum(Timepoint == "Week 25") >= 2,
                sum(Timepoint == "Week 38") >= 2,
                sd(mean_expr, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) %>%
  dplyr::group_modify(~{
    tt <- t.test(mean_expr ~ Timepoint, data = .x, var.equal = FALSE)
    m  <- .x %>% dplyr::group_by(Timepoint) %>%
            dplyr::summarise(m = mean(mean_expr), s = sd(mean_expr),
                             n = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop")
    sp <- sqrt(((m$n[1]-1)*m$s[1]^2 + (m$n[2]-1)*m$s[2]^2) / (sum(m$n)-2))
    tibble::tibble(n1 = m$n[1], n2 = m$n[2],
                   mean_week25 = m$m[1], mean_week38 = m$m[2],
                   sd_week25 = m$s[1],   sd_week38 = m$s[2],
                   statistic = unname(tt$statistic),
                   df = unname(tt$parameter), p = tt$p.value,
                   cohens_d = (m$m[2] - m$m[1]) / sp)
  }) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(functional_class = unname(gene_class[gene]),
                p.adj = p.adjust(p, "BH"),
                p.adj.signif = as.character(
                  cut(p.adj, c(-Inf,.001,.01,.05,Inf),
                      c("***","**","*","ns"))),
                higher_at = ifelse(mean_week38 > mean_week25,
                                   "week 38", "week 25"),
                test = "two-sided Welch t-test on donor means, BH-adjusted")
# ---- 4. Plotting frame -------------------------------------------------------
delta_df <- donor_df %>%
  group_by(gene, cell_type, Timepoint) %>%
  summarise(grand = mean(mean_expr), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Timepoint, values_from = grand) %>%
  mutate(delta = `Week 38` - `Week 25`)

plot_df <- delta_df %>%
  left_join(detect_df, by = c("gene", "cell_type")) %>%
  left_join(stats_df %>% dplyr::select(gene, cell_type, p, p.adj, p.adj.signif),
            by = c("gene", "cell_type")) %>%
  mutate(tested     = !is.na(p.adj),
         star       = ifelse(tested & p.adj < 0.05, "*", ""),
         cell_label = gsub("_", " ", cell_type),
         delta_show = ifelse(tested, delta, NA_real_),
         class      = factor(unname(gene_class[gene]), levels = class_levels))

# ---- 5. Cluster CELL TYPES only; keep genes in functional-class order --------
mat <- plot_df %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, cell_label, delta) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = cell_label, values_from = delta) %>%
  column_to_rownames("gene") %>% as.matrix()
mat[is.na(mat)] <- 0

col_hc <- hclust(dist(t(mat)), method = "average")

gene_order <- plot_df %>% distinct(gene, class) %>%
  arrange(class, gene) %>% pull(gene)

plot_df$gene       <- factor(plot_df$gene, levels = rev(gene_order))
plot_df$cell_label <- factor(plot_df$cell_label,
                             levels = colnames(mat)[col_hc$order])

lim <- max(abs(plot_df$delta_show), na.rm = TRUE)

# ---- 6. Main dotplot ---------------------------------------------------------
p_main <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = cell_label, y = gene)) +
  geom_tile(fill = NA, colour = "grey92", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_point(data = subset(plot_df, !tested),
             shape = 4, size = 0.6, stroke = 0.3, colour = "grey65") +
  geom_point(data = subset(plot_df, tested),
             aes(size = pct_expressing, fill = delta_show),
             shape = 21, stroke = 0.15, colour = "grey30") +
  geom_text(aes(label = star), size = 9 / .pt, vjust = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "white", high = "#B2182B",
                       midpoint = 0, limits = c(-lim, lim),
                       breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(4), na.value = "grey85") +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 3.4, breaks = c(1, 10, 25, 50, 75)) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(add = 0.6)) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = expansion(add = 0.6), position = "right") +
  guides(fill = guide_colourbar(barwidth = unit(3, "mm"),
                                barheight = unit(20, "mm"),
                                ticks.linewidth = 0.2, order = 1),
         size = guide_legend(override.aes = list(fill = "grey60"), order = 2)) +
  theme_ncb(base_size = BASE_PT) +
  theme(axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1,
                                       size = BASE_PT),
        axis.text.y     = element_text(size = BASE_PT),
        panel.grid      = element_blank(),
        panel.border    = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA,
                                       linewidth = 0.25),
        legend.title    = element_text(size = BASE_PT),
        legend.text     = element_text(size = BASE_PT),
        legend.key.size = unit(3, "mm"),
        plot.margin     = margin(0, 1, 1, 0, "mm")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL,
       fill = "\u0394 mean expression\n(week 38 \u2212 week 25)",
       size = "% nuclei\nexpressing")

# ---- 7. Functional-class colour bar on the left ------------------------------
p_class <- ggplot(plot_df %>% distinct(gene, class),
                  aes(x = 1, y = gene, fill = class)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = class_cols, name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = expansion(add = 0.6)) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1, keyheight = unit(3, "mm"))) +
  theme_void(base_size = BASE_PT) +
  theme(legend.text = element_text(size = BASE_PT, family = FONT),
        legend.position = "left",
        plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 1, 0, "mm"))

# ---- 8. Cell type dendrogram on top ------------------------------------------
col_dendro <- ggplot(segment(dendro_data(as.dendrogram(col_hc)))) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend), linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0.6)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0, "mm"))

layout <- "
#B
AC
"
p_final <- p_class + col_dendro + p_main +
  plot_layout(design = layout,
              widths  = c(0.16, 1),
              heights = c(0.09, 1))

save_panel(p_final, file.path(si_dir, "ED4_PPROM_markers_dotplot"),
           width_mm = 175, height_mm = 130)

print(p_final)

# ---- 9. Export ---------------------------------------------------------------
write.csv(stats_df, file.path(si_dir, "PPROM_Markers_Stats.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

dir.create("SourceData", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
writexl::write_xlsx(
  list(donor_means    = as.data.frame(donor_df),
       detection_rate = as.data.frame(detect_df),
       delta          = as.data.frame(delta_df),
       statistics     = as.data.frame(stats_df)),
  file.path(si_dir, "SourceData_ED4_PPROM_markers.xlsx"))

sd_add("ED4_PPROM_donor_values",   as.data.frame(donor_df))
sd_add("ED4_PPROM_detection_rate", as.data.frame(detect_df))
sd_add("ED4_PPROM_statistics",     as.data.frame(stats_df))

cat("\nSaved to", si_dir, "\n")
```

### Cell Type Enrichment


```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(msigdbr)
library(enrichplot)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# 1. Setup & Directory Creation
main_dir <- "SI_Figure_Enrichment"
if (!dir.exists(main_dir)) dir.create(main_dir)

# Pre-load Databases
hallmark_db <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "H") %>% 
  dplyr::select(gs_name, gene_symbol)
reactome_db <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "C2", subcategory = "CP:REACTOME") %>% 
  dplyr::select(gs_name, gene_symbol)

# 2. Define Enrichment Function
# This function handles the logic for different databases and saves the plots
save_enrichment_plot <- function(gene_list, db_type, cell_type, direction, base_path) {
  if (length(gene_list) < 5) return(NULL)
  
  enrich_res <- NULL
  title <- paste(db_type, direction, "in", cell_type)
  
  # Logic based on database type
  if (db_type == "GO_BP") {
    enrich_res <- enrichGO(gene = gene_list, OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db, ont = "BP", pAdjustMethod = "BH", qvalueCutoff = 0.05)
  } else if (db_type == "KEGG") {
    ids <- bitr(gene_list, fromType="SYMBOL", toType="ENTREZID", OrgDb="org.Hs.eg.db")
    enrich_res <- enrichKEGG(gene = ids$ENTREZID, organism = 'hsa', pAdjustMethod = "BH", qvalueCutoff = 0.05)
  } else if (db_type %in% c("Hallmark", "Reactome")) {
    term2gene <- if(db_type == "Hallmark") hallmark_db else reactome_db
    enrich_res <- enricher(gene = gene_list, TERM2GENE = term2gene, pAdjustMethod = "BH", qvalueCutoff = 0.05)
  }
  
  # Save Plot
  if (!is.null(enrich_res) && nrow(enrich_res@result %>% filter(p.adjust < 0.05)) > 0) {
    p <- dotplot(enrich_res, showCategory = 10) + ggtitle(title)
    file_name <- file.path(base_path, paste0(db_type, "_", direction, ".png"))
#    ggsave(file_name, p, width = 8, height = 6)
  }
}

# 3. Main Loop
Idents(amnion_seurat_object) <- "Cell Type"
cell_types <- unique(Idents(amnion_seurat_object))

for (ct in cell_types) {
  message("Processing Cell Type: ", ct)
  
  # Create directory for this cell type
  ct_dir <- file.path(main_dir, gsub(" ", "_", ct))
  if (!dir.exists(ct_dir)) dir.create(ct_dir)
  
  # A. Differential Expression
  de_markers <- FindMarkers(
    object = amnion_seurat_object, 
    subset.ident = ct, 
    group.by = "Gestational Age", 
    ident.1 = "Week 38", 
    ident.2 = "Week 25"
  )
  
  up_genes <- rownames(de_markers[de_markers$p_val_adj < 0.05 & de_markers$avg_log2FC > 0, ])
  down_genes <- rownames(de_markers[de_markers$p_val_adj < 0.05 & de_markers$avg_log2FC < 0, ])
  
  # B. Run all Enrichments
  dbs <- c("GO_BP", "KEGG", "Hallmark", "Reactome")
  
  for (db in dbs) {
    save_enrichment_plot(up_genes, db, ct, "Up Week 38", ct_dir)
    save_enrichment_plot(down_genes, db, ct, "Up Week 25", ct_dir)
  }
}
```

```{r}
  } else if (db_type %in% c("Hallmark", "Reactome")) {

    enrich_res <- enricher(gene = gene_list, TERM2GENE = term2gene, pAdjustMethod = "BH", qvalueCutoff = 0.05)
```

# Functional enrichment

```{r enrichment-collect}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Functional enrichment across cell types.
#
# Results are collected into a single tidy data frame rather than written out
# as ~112 individual dot plots. `enrich_df` feeds both the Extended Data figure
# below and Supplementary Table 5.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
library(clusterProfiler); library(org.Hs.eg.db); library(msigdbr)
library(dplyr); library(purrr)

get_msig <- function(coll, subcoll = NULL) {
  a <- list(species = "Homo sapiens")
  if ("collection" %in% names(formals(msigdbr))) {
    a$collection <- coll; if (!is.null(subcoll)) a$subcollection <- subcoll
  } else {
    a$category <- coll;   if (!is.null(subcoll)) a$subcategory <- subcoll
  }
  do.call(msigdbr, a) %>% dplyr::select(gs_name, gene_symbol)
}

hallmark_db <- get_msig("H") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(gs_name = gsub("_", " ", gsub("^HALLMARK_", "", gs_name)))
reactome_db <- get_msig("C2", "CP:REACTOME") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(gs_name = gsub("_", " ", gsub("^REACTOME_", "", gs_name)))

run_enrichment <- function(gene_list, db_type, cell_type, direction) {
  if (length(gene_list) < 5) return(NULL)
  res <- tryCatch({
    if (db_type == "GO_BP") {
      enrichGO(gene_list, OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db, ont = "BP", keyType = "SYMBOL",
               pAdjustMethod = "BH", qvalueCutoff = 0.05)
    } else if (db_type == "KEGG") {
      ids <- bitr(gene_list, "SYMBOL", "ENTREZID", org.Hs.eg.db)
      enrichKEGG(ids$ENTREZID, organism = "hsa",
                 pAdjustMethod = "BH", qvalueCutoff = 0.05)
    } else {
      enricher(gene_list,
               TERM2GENE = if (db_type == "Hallmark") hallmark_db else reactome_db,
               pAdjustMethod = "BH", qvalueCutoff = 0.05)
    }
  }, error = function(e) { message("  enrichment failed: ", e$message); NULL })
  if (is.null(res) || nrow(as.data.frame(res)) == 0) return(NULL)
  as.data.frame(res) %>%
    dplyr::filter(p.adjust < 0.05) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(cell_type = cell_type, database = db_type,
                  direction = direction)
}

Idents(amnion_seurat_object) <- "Cell Type"
all_enrichment <- list(); skipped_celltypes <- character()

for (ct in levels(factor(Idents(amnion_seurat_object)))) {
  message("Enrichment: ", ct)
  de <- tryCatch(
    FindMarkers(amnion_seurat_object, subset.ident = ct,
                group.by = "Gestational Age",
                ident.1 = "Week 38", ident.2 = "Week 25"),
    error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(de) || nrow(de) == 0) next
  de$gene <- rownames(de)

  up   <- de$gene[de$p_val_adj < 0.05 & de$avg_log2FC > 0]
  down <- de$gene[de$p_val_adj < 0.05 & de$avg_log2FC < 0]
  if (length(up) < 5 && length(down) < 5) skipped_celltypes <- c(skipped_celltypes, ct)

  for (db in c("GO_BP", "KEGG", "Hallmark", "Reactome")) {
    all_enrichment[[paste(ct, db, "up")]]   <-
      run_enrichment(up,   db, ct, "Higher at week 38")
    all_enrichment[[paste(ct, db, "down")]] <-
      run_enrichment(down, db, ct, "Higher at week 25")
  }
}

enrich_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(purrr::compact(all_enrichment))

cat("\nCell types with fewer than 5 DE genes (not tested):\n")
print(skipped_celltypes)
cat("\nEnriched terms by database and direction:\n")
print(as.data.frame(enrich_df %>% dplyr::count(database, direction)))
```



## ED6 enrichment combined

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)

# =============================================================================
# Extended Data Figure 6 -- Functional enrichment, COMPRESSED to one panel
#
# HARD LIMIT: 180 mm wide x 200 mm high.
#
# The separate Hallmark (110 mm) + Reactome (170 mm) panels total 280 mm and
# do not fit. Two filters bring this down:
#
#   TOP_N          top terms per cell type per direction
#   MIN_CELLTYPES  a term must appear in at least this many cell types
#
# The breadth filter is the important one: terms found in a single cell type
# are the least generalizable and each consumes a full row. Everything removed
# here remains in SupplementaryTable_enrichment_full.xlsx.
#
# Both databases are combined with facet_grid(database ~ direction) and
# space = "free_y", so each database band is sized to its own term count.
#
# Requires: enrich_df from the enrichment script, figure_setup.R sourced.
# =============================================================================

BASE_PT       <- 7
TOP_N         <- 4      # top terms per cell type per direction
MIN_CELLTYPES <- 2     # term must be enriched in >= this many cell types
WRAP          <- 38     # characters before the term label wraps

MAX_WIDTH_MM  <- 180    # hard limits from the editor
MAX_HEIGHT_MM <- 200
MM_PER_ROW    <- 3.2    # empirical height per term row at 7 pt
FIXED_OVERHEAD<- 40     # axis labels, strips, legend

si_dir      <- "SI_Figure_Enrichment"
dbs_to_show <- c("Hallmark", "Reactome")

# ---- 1. Select terms ---------------------------------------------------------
selected <- enrich_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(database %in% dbs_to_show) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(database, cell_type, direction) %>%
  dplyr::slice_min(p.adjust, n = TOP_N, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

term_breadth <- selected %>%
  dplyr::group_by(database, Description) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_celltypes = dplyr::n_distinct(cell_type),
                   .groups = "drop")

keep <- term_breadth %>%
  dplyr::filter(n_celltypes >= MIN_CELLTYPES) %>%
  dplyr::select(database, Description)

cat("=========== TERM SELECTION ===========\n")
cat("TOP_N =", TOP_N, "| MIN_CELLTYPES =", MIN_CELLTYPES, "\n\n")
for (db in dbs_to_show) {
  before <- term_breadth %>% dplyr::filter(database == db) %>% nrow()
  after  <- keep         %>% dplyr::filter(database == db) %>% nrow()
  cat(sprintf("%-10s %3d terms after top-N -> %3d after breadth filter\n",
              db, before, after))
}

total_rows  <- nrow(keep)
needed_mm   <- round(total_rows * MM_PER_ROW + FIXED_OVERHEAD)

cat("\nRows to plot        :", total_rows, "\n")
cat("Height needed       :", needed_mm, "mm\n")
cat("Maximum allowed     :", MAX_HEIGHT_MM, "mm\n")

if (needed_mm > MAX_HEIGHT_MM) {
  cat("\n  *** TOO TALL BY", needed_mm - MAX_HEIGHT_MM, "mm ***\n")
  cat("  Raise MIN_CELLTYPES to", MIN_CELLTYPES + 1,
      "(removes the least generalizable terms), or\n")
  cat("  reduce TOP_N to", max(1, TOP_N - 1),
      "(removes the least significant terms).\n")
  cat("  Raising MIN_CELLTYPES usually cuts more and loses less.\n\n")
} else {
  cat("  Fits.\n\n")
}

# ---- 2. Plotting frame -- keep ALL cell types for the retained terms --------
plot_df <- enrich_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(database %in% dbs_to_show) %>%
  dplyr::semi_join(keep, by = c("database", "Description")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    term      = str_wrap(str_to_sentence(Description), width = WRAP),
    cell_type = gsub("_", " ", cell_type),
    database  = factor(database, levels = dbs_to_show),
    direction = factor(direction,
                       levels = c("Higher at week 25", "Higher at week 38")))

term_order <- plot_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(database, term) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n_distinct(cell_type), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(database, n) %>%
  dplyr::pull(term) %>% unique()
plot_df$term <- factor(plot_df$term, levels = term_order)

# ---- 3. One combined panel ---------------------------------------------------
p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = cell_type, y = term,
                         size = Count, colour = p.adjust)) +
  geom_point(stroke = 0) +
  facet_grid(database ~ direction, scales = "free_y", space = "free_y",
             switch = "y") +
  scale_colour_gradient(low = "#B2182B", high = "#2166AC", trans = "log10",
                        labels = scales::label_scientific(digits = 1)) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(0.4, 2.4), breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(3)) +
  guides(colour = guide_colourbar(barwidth = unit(2.5, "mm"),
                                  barheight = unit(16, "mm"),
                                  ticks.linewidth = 0.2, order = 1),
         size = guide_legend(keyheight = unit(2.4, "mm"), order = 2)) +
  theme_ncb(base_size = BASE_PT) +
  theme(axis.text.x       = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1,
                                         size = BASE_PT),
        axis.text.y       = element_text(size = BASE_PT, lineheight = 0.8),
        strip.text.x      = element_text(size = BASE_PT,
                                         margin = margin(1, 1, 1, 1, "mm")),
        strip.text.y.left = element_text(size = BASE_PT, angle = 90,
                                         margin = margin(1, 1, 1, 1, "mm")),
        strip.placement   = "outside",
        panel.border      = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA,
                                         linewidth = 0.25),
        panel.grid.major  = element_line(linewidth = 0.12, colour = "grey93"),
        panel.spacing     = unit(1.5, "mm"),
        legend.title      = element_text(size = BASE_PT),
        legend.text       = element_text(size = BASE_PT),
        legend.key.size   = unit(2.4, "mm")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, colour = "Adjusted P", size = "Gene count")

panel_height <- min(MAX_HEIGHT_MM, needed_mm)

save_panel(p, file.path(si_dir, "ED6_enrichment_combined"),
           width_mm = MAX_WIDTH_MM, height_mm = panel_height)

print(p)

cat("Saved ED6_enrichment_combined at",
    MAX_WIDTH_MM, "x", panel_height, "mm\n")
cat("Terms shown:", dplyr::n_distinct(plot_df$term),
    "of", dplyr::n_distinct(enrich_df$Description),
    "total enriched terms (full list in the supplementary table)\n")

if (needed_mm > MAX_HEIGHT_MM)
  cat("\nNOTE: the figure was capped at", MAX_HEIGHT_MM,
      "mm and the rows are therefore compressed. Adjust the filters above",
      "rather than accepting this.\n")
```
