## ED9 marker heatmap

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrastr)
library(patchwork)

# =============================================================================
# Extended Data Figure 9 -- Top marker genes per cell type
#
# The original used pheatmap at 10 x 15 inches (254 x 381 mm) with 140 gene
# rows. At 180 x 200 mm that is 1.25 mm per row, and 7 pt text needs ~3 mm.
# The gene count therefore has to come down: TOP_N = 4 gives 56 rows at
# ~3.1 mm each.
#
# Rebuilt in ggplot rather than pheatmap so that:
#   - theme_ncb applies (7 pt Arial, thin lines)
#   - the tile layer can be rasterised (2,800 cell columns would otherwise
#     produce an unusable SVG)
#   - the output size is controlled in mm by save_panel
#
# Cells are downsampled to N_PER_TYPE per cell type so column widths are
# comparable across cell types rather than dominated by the largest ones.
# =============================================================================

BASE_PT     <- 7
TOP_N       <- 5      # markers per cell type; 5 -> 70 rows, marginal at 7 pt
N_PER_TYPE  <- 200    # cells shown per cell type
SEED        <- 42
si_dir      <- "SI_Figure_Celltypeconfirmation"
dir.create(si_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ---- 1. Markers (reuse `markers` if FindAllMarkers already ran) -------------
Idents(amnion_seurat_object) <- amnion_seurat_object$cell_type

if (!exists("markers")) {
  markers <- FindAllMarkers(amnion_seurat_object, only.pos = TRUE,
                            min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25)
}

top_markers <- markers %>%
  dplyr::group_by(cluster) %>%
  dplyr::slice_max(avg_log2FC, n = TOP_N, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::arrange(cluster, dplyr::desc(avg_log2FC))

gene_order <- unique(top_markers$gene)
cat("Cell types:", dplyr::n_distinct(top_markers$cluster),
    "| genes shown:", length(gene_order), "\n")
cat("Height per gene row:", round(175 / length(gene_order), 2), "mm",
    "(needs >= 3 mm at 7 pt)\n")
if (175 / length(gene_order) < 3)
  cat("  --> reduce TOP_N\n")

# ---- 2. Downsample cells, scale the selected genes --------------------------
set.seed(SEED)
sub <- subset(amnion_seurat_object, downsample = N_PER_TYPE)
sub <- ScaleData(sub, features = gene_order, verbose = FALSE)

mat <- GetAssayData(sub, layer = "scale.data")[gene_order, , drop = FALSE]

cell_meta <- data.frame(cell      = colnames(sub),
                        cell_type = as.character(Idents(sub))) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(cell_type)

mat <- mat[, cell_meta$cell, drop = FALSE]
cell_meta$x <- seq_len(nrow(cell_meta))

cat("Cells shown:", ncol(mat), "\n")

# ---- 3. Long format for ggplot ----------------------------------------------
heat_long <- mat %>%
  as.matrix() %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-gene, names_to = "cell", values_to = "expr") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(cell_meta, by = "cell") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(gene = factor(gene, levels = rev(gene_order)),
                expr = pmax(pmin(expr, 2.5), -2.5))   # clip for contrast

# ---- 4. Heatmap body ---------------------------------------------------------
p_heat <- ggplot(heat_long, aes(x = x, y = gene, fill = expr)) +
  rasterise(geom_raster(), dpi = 900) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = c("#4B0082", "black", "#FFD700"),
                       limits = c(-2.5, 2.5),
                       breaks = c(-2, 0, 2)) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  guides(fill = guide_colourbar(barwidth = unit(2.5, "mm"),
                                barheight = unit(20, "mm"),
                                ticks.linewidth = 0.2)) +
  theme_ncb(base_size = BASE_PT) +
  theme(axis.text.y  = element_text(size = BASE_PT, face = "italic"),
        axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid   = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA,
                                    linewidth = 0.25),
        legend.title = element_text(size = BASE_PT),
        legend.text  = element_text(size = BASE_PT),
        plot.margin  = margin(0, 1, 1, 1, "mm")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Scaled\nexpression")

# ---- 5. Cell type annotation bar on top -------------------------------------
bar_df <- cell_meta %>%
  dplyr::mutate(cell_type = gsub("_", " ", cell_type))

label_pos <- bar_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(cell_type) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(x = mean(x), .groups = "drop")

p_bar <- ggplot(bar_df, aes(x = x, y = 1, fill = cell_type)) +
  rasterise(geom_raster(), dpi = 900) +
  geom_text(data = label_pos, aes(x = x, y = 1, label = cell_type),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, angle = 45, hjust = 0, vjust = 0,
            size = BASE_PT / .pt, nudge_y = 0.6) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0.5, 3.5)) +
  theme_void(base_size = BASE_PT) +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        plot.margin     = margin(1, 1, 0, 1, "mm"))

# ---- 6. Assemble -------------------------------------------------------------
p_final <- p_bar / p_heat +
  plot_layout(heights = c(0.16, 0.84))

save_panel(p_final, file.path(si_dir, "ED9_marker_heatmap"),
           width_mm = 180, height_mm = 200)

print(p_final)

# ---- 7. Export the full marker table ----------------------------------------
writexl::write_xlsx(
  list(top_markers = top_markers, all_markers = markers),
  file.path(si_dir, "SupplementaryTable_cell_type_markers.xlsx"))

cat("\nSaved to", si_dir, "\n")

```

```{r}
filtered_seurat_object <- subset(amnion_seurat_object, subset = Donor_Nr %in% male_fetus)
metadata <- filtered_seurat_object@meta.data
# Load required libraries
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

# Assuming metadata is already defined
# Ensure `cell_type` and `scType_Pique` are characters
metadata <- metadata %>%
  mutate(cell_type = as.character(cell_type), 
         scType_Pique = as.character(scType_Pique))

# Calculate the ratio of male and female cells for each cluster
ratio_df <- metadata %>%
  filter(!is.na(prediction)) %>%
  group_by(RNA_snn_res.1, prediction) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = prediction, values_from = count, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(total = Male + Female,
         Male_ratio = Male / total)

# Get cluster information for titles
cluster_info <- metadata %>%
  group_by(RNA_snn_res.1) %>%
  summarise(cell_type = unique(cell_type)[1],  # Get the first unique cell_type
            scType_Pique = unique(scType_Pique)[1],  # Get the first unique scType_Pique
            .groups = 'drop')

# Join the ratio data with cluster info
ratio_df <- ratio_df %>%
  left_join(cluster_info, by = "RNA_snn_res.1")

# Convert RNA_snn_res.1 to factor to maintain order
ratio_df$RNA_snn_res.1 <- factor(ratio_df$RNA_snn_res.1, levels = unique(ratio_df$RNA_snn_res.1))

# Plot 1: Total Number of Cells by Cell Type
ggplot(ratio_df, aes(x = RNA_snn_res.1, y = total, fill = "Total Cells")) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "red") +
  labs(x = "Clusters", 
       y = "Total Cells", 
       title = "Total Number of Cells by Cluster (Cell Type)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1)) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = ratio_df$cell_type)

# Plot 2: Male Ratio by Cell Type
ggplot(ratio_df, aes(x = RNA_snn_res.1, y = Male_ratio, fill = "Male Ratio")) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "blue") +
  labs(x = "Clusters", 
       y = "Male Ratio", 
       title = "Male Ratio by Cluster (Cell Type)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1)) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = ratio_df$cell_type)

# Plot 3: Total Number of Cells by scType_Pique
ggplot(ratio_df, aes(x = RNA_snn_res.1, y = total, fill = "Total Cells")) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "red") +
  labs(x = "Clusters", 
       y = "Total Cells", 
       title = "Total Number of Cells by Cluster (scType_Pique)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1)) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = ratio_df$scType_Pique)

# Plot 4: Male Ratio by scType_Pique
ggplot(ratio_df, aes(x = RNA_snn_res.1, y = Male_ratio, fill = "Male Ratio")) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "blue") +
  labs(x = "Clusters", 
       y = "Male Ratio", 
       title = "Male Ratio by Cluster (scType_Pique)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1)) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = ratio_df$scType_Pique)

amnion_ratio_df <- ratio_df
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

# Subset Seurat object for male fetuses
filtered_seurat_object <- subset(amnion_seurat_object, subset = Donor_Nr %in% male_fetus)

# Extract metadata
metadata <- filtered_seurat_object@meta.data

# Ensure 'Cell Type' and prediction are characters
metadata <- metadata %>%
  mutate(Cell_Type = as.character(`Cell Type`),
         prediction = as.character(prediction))  # Male/Female

# Summarize counts by Cell Type and prediction
ratio_df <- metadata %>%
  filter(!is.na(prediction)) %>%
  group_by(Cell_Type, prediction) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = prediction, values_from = count, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(total = Male + Female,
         Male_ratio = Male / total,
         color_group = ifelse(grepl("Fetus", Cell_Type), "Fetus", "Mother"))

# Order Cell_Type by Male_ratio descending
ratio_df$Cell_Type <- factor(ratio_df$Cell_Type, levels = ratio_df$Cell_Type[order(ratio_df$Male_ratio, decreasing = TRUE)])

# ---------------------------
# Plot: Male Ratio by Cell Type, colored by Fetus/Mother
ggplot(ratio_df, aes(x = Cell_Type, y = Male_ratio, fill = color_group)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Fetus" = "red", "Mother" = "blue")) +
  labs(x = "Cell Type", y = "Male Ratio", title = "Male Ratio by Cell Type") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1))
```

## ED10 sex prediction

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrastr)
library(shadowtext)
library(patchwork)

# =============================================================================
# Extended Data Figure 10 -- Fetal sex prediction validates cell origin
#
# v2 changes:
#   - panel order: CELL TYPES first, then clusters (a/c before b/d)
#   - the cell type UMAP is labelled with NAMES, not numbers
#   - reference line at 0.70 instead of 0.50
#   - coord_fixed removed: these four UMAPs may take their own aspect, but
#     they all share the same one so the panels still match each other
#
# Six panels, 2 columns x 3 rows at 180 x 200 mm.
# Analysis is restricted to donors carrying a MALE fetus, so that maternal
# (female) and fetal (male) nuclei are distinguishable by sex.
# =============================================================================

BASE_PT    <- 7
SEED       <- 123
REF_LINE   <- 0.70                       # separation threshold
male_fetus <- c(45, 49, 26, 41, 10, 1005)
si_dir     <- "SI_Figure_Sexes"
dir.create(si_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

obj <- subset(amnion_seurat_object, subset = Donor_Nr %in% male_fetus)
cat("Nuclei from male-fetus donors:", ncol(obj), "\n")

emb <- as.data.frame(Embeddings(obj, "umap")[, 1:2])
colnames(emb) <- c("UMAP_1", "UMAP_2")

md <- obj@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(cell_type  = gsub("_", " ", as.character(`Cell Type`)),
                cluster    = as.character(RNA_snn_res.1),
                prediction = as.character(prediction))

base_df <- cbind(emb, md[, c("cell_type", "cluster", "prediction")])
base_df$cell_id <- rownames(md)
set.seed(SEED)
base_df <- base_df[sample(nrow(base_df)), ]

# ---- a: cell type UMAP with NAMES -------------------------------------------
cent_ct <- base_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(cell_type) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(UMAP_1 = median(UMAP_1), UMAP_2 = median(UMAP_2),
                   .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(label = cell_type %>%
                  str_replace("T-Cell-Resting", "T cell") %>%
                  str_replace("Endometrial", "Endometr.") %>%
                  str_replace(" (Mother|Fetus)$", "\n\\1"))

p_a <- ggplot(base_df, aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2, colour = cell_type)) +
  rasterise(geom_point(size = 0.25, alpha = 0.6, stroke = 0), dpi = 900) +
  geom_shadowtext(data = cent_ct,
                  aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2, label = label),
                  inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 5.5 / .pt, fontface = "bold",
                  colour = "black", bg.colour = "white", bg.r = 0.15,
                  lineheight = 0.8) +
  theme_ncb(base_size = BASE_PT) +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        plot.title = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0.5,
                                  margin = margin(b = 1, unit = "mm")),
        axis.text  = element_text(size = 6.5)) +
  labs(x = "UMAP 1", y = "UMAP 2", title = "Cell types")

# ---- b: cluster UMAP with numbers -------------------------------------------
cent_cl <- base_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(cluster) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(UMAP_1 = median(UMAP_1), UMAP_2 = median(UMAP_2),
                   .groups = "drop")

p_b <- ggplot(base_df, aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2, colour = cluster)) +
  rasterise(geom_point(size = 0.25, alpha = 0.6, stroke = 0), dpi = 900) +
  geom_shadowtext(data = cent_cl,
                  aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2, label = cluster),
                  inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 6 / .pt, fontface = "bold",
                  colour = "black", bg.colour = "white", bg.r = 0.15) +
  theme_ncb(base_size = BASE_PT) +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        plot.title = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0.5,
                                  margin = margin(b = 1, unit = "mm")),
        axis.text  = element_text(size = 6.5)) +
  labs(x = "UMAP 1", y = "UMAP 2", title = "Clusters")

# ---- c/d: male ratio ---------------------------------------------------------
make_ratio <- function(groupvar, xlab, title) {
  d <- base_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(prediction), prediction %in% c("Male", "Female")) %>%
    dplyr::count(.data[[groupvar]], prediction, name = "n") %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = prediction, values_from = n,
                       values_fill = 0)
  names(d)[1] <- "grp"

  d <- d %>%
    dplyr::mutate(total      = Male + Female,
                  male_ratio = Male / total,
                  origin     = ifelse(grepl("Fetus", grp), "Fetal", "Maternal")) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(male_ratio)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(grp = factor(grp, levels = grp))

  ggplot(d, aes(x = grp, y = male_ratio, fill = origin)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.75, linewidth = 0) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = REF_LINE, linetype = "dashed",
               linewidth = 0.25, colour = "grey35") +
    annotate("text", x = Inf, y = REF_LINE, label = paste0(REF_LINE * 100, "%"),
             hjust = 1.1, vjust = -0.4, size = 6 / .pt, colour = "grey35") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Fetal" = "#D95F02", "Maternal" = "#1B9E77")) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.04))) +
    theme_ncb(base_size = BASE_PT) +
    theme(axis.text.x        = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1,
                                            size = 6),
          panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
          panel.border       = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA,
                                            linewidth = 0.25),
          plot.title         = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0.5,
                                            margin = margin(b = 1, unit = "mm")),
          legend.position    = "top",
          legend.title       = element_blank(),
          legend.key.size    = unit(2.6, "mm"),
          legend.margin      = margin(t = -1, b = -2, unit = "mm")) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = "Proportion male nuclei", title = title)
}

p_c <- make_ratio("cell_type", NULL,      "Male ratio by cell type")
p_d <- make_ratio("cluster",   "Cluster", "Male ratio by cluster")

# ---- e: sex prediction -------------------------------------------------------
p_e <- ggplot(base_df, aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2, colour = prediction)) +
  rasterise(geom_point(size = 0.25, alpha = 0.6, stroke = 0), dpi = 900) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Male" = "#1B9E77", "Female" = "#D95F02"),
                      na.value = "grey80") +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 1,
                               override.aes = list(size = 1.3, alpha = 1))) +
  theme_ncb(base_size = BASE_PT) +
  theme(legend.title    = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "top",
        legend.key.size = unit(2.6, "mm"),
        legend.margin   = margin(t = -1, b = -2, unit = "mm"),
        plot.title      = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0.5,
                                       margin = margin(b = 1, unit = "mm")),
        axis.text       = element_text(size = 6.5)) +
  labs(x = "UMAP 1", y = "UMAP 2", title = "Sex prediction (CellXY)")

# ---- f: XIST -----------------------------------------------------------------
xist <- FetchData(obj, vars = "XIST")
base_df$expr <- xist[base_df$cell_id, 1]        # explicit join on barcode
stopifnot(!all(is.na(base_df$expr)))
xist_df <- base_df[order(base_df$expr), ]

p_f <- ggplot(xist_df, aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2, colour = expr)) +
  rasterise(geom_point(size = 0.25, stroke = 0), dpi = 900) +
  scale_colour_gradient(low = "grey88", high = "#3B0F70") +
  guides(colour = guide_colourbar(barwidth = unit(14, "mm"),
                                  barheight = unit(2, "mm"),
                                  title.position = "left",
                                  ticks.linewidth = 0.2)) +
  theme_ncb(base_size = BASE_PT) +
  theme(legend.position = "top",
        legend.title    = element_text(size = BASE_PT, vjust = 1),
        legend.text     = element_text(size = BASE_PT),
        legend.margin   = margin(t = -1, b = -2, unit = "mm"),
        plot.title      = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0.5,
                                       margin = margin(b = 1, unit = "mm")),
        axis.text       = element_text(size = 6.5)) +
  labs(x = "UMAP 1", y = "UMAP 2", colour = "XIST",
       title = "XIST expression")

# ---- assemble: cell types first, then clusters ------------------------------
p_final <- (p_a | p_b) / (p_c | p_d) / (p_e | p_f) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a") &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold", family = FONT))

save_panel(p_final, file.path(si_dir, "ED10_sex_prediction"),
           width_mm = 180, height_mm = 200, source_data = FALSE)


# ---- source data -------------------------------------------------------------
ratio_export <- base_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(prediction)) %>%
  dplyr::count(cell_type, cluster, prediction, name = "n") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = prediction, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(total = Male + Female, male_ratio = Male / total)

writexl::write_xlsx(ratio_export,
                    file.path(si_dir, "SourceData_ED10_sex_ratio.xlsx"))

sd_add("ED10_sex_ratio", ratio_export)
cat("\nSaved to", si_dir, "\n")

```

```{r}
output_dir <- "SI_Figure_Celltypeconfirmation"
```

```{r}
# 2. Set active identity to your cell types
Idents(amnion_seurat_object) <- "cell_type" # Adjust to your metadata column name

# 3. Find unbiased markers for ALL cell types (this might take a couple of minutes)
print("Calculating cell type markers...")
all_markers <- FindAllMarkers(
  amnion_seurat_object, 
  only.pos = TRUE,          # Only look for genes up-regulated in that cluster
  min.pct = 0.25,           # Gene must be in at least 25% of the cells
  logfc.threshold = 0.25    # Minimum log-fold change
)

```

```{r}
# 4. Filter out the top 10 markers per cell type based on fold-change
top10_markers <- all_markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = avg_log2FC, n = 15) %>%
  ungroup()

# 5. CRITICAL STEP: DoHeatmap requires genes to be in the "scale.data" slot
# We run ScaleData quickly on just these specific top markers
amnion_seurat_object <- ScaleData(amnion_seurat_object, features = unique(top10_markers$gene))

# 6. Generate the Heatmap
# We downsample the cells temporarily just for the plot so it renders fast and looks clean
p_heatmap <- DoHeatmap(
  subset(amnion_seurat_object, downsample = 200), # Plots up to 100 cells per cluster max
  features = top10_markers$gene, 
  group.by = "cell_type",
  size = 4,          # Size of cell type labels at the top
  angle = 45         # Angle of labels
) + 
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = c("purple", "black", "yellow")) + # Classic Seurat heatmap colors
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 5, face = "italic"))    # Shrink gene text to fit 140 genes

# 7. Save the figure
```

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Ensure output directory exists
output_dir <- "SI_Figure_Celltypeconfirmation"
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) { dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE) }

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CRITICAL FIX 1: Lock in the exact order of your cell types
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Convert cell_type to a factor if it isn't already, and extract the clean order
amnion_seurat_object$cell_type <- factor(amnion_seurat_object$cell_type)
desired_cluster_order <- levels(amnion_seurat_object$cell_type)

# Force the Seurat object identities to use this exact factor ordering
Idents(amnion_seurat_object) <- "cell_type"

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CRITICAL FIX 2: Direct sorting (Seurat handles the Y-axis flip automatically!)
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
top15_markers <- all_markers %>%
  # Force the 'cluster' column to match your exact cell type factor levels
  mutate(cluster = factor(cluster, levels = desired_cluster_order)) %>%
  # Drop any NA clusters if they exist, then arrange strictly by this order
  filter(!is.na(cluster)) %>%
  arrange(cluster) %>%
  # Now grab the top 15 markers per cell type
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = avg_log2FC, n = 15, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

# Extract the genes while preserving this exact sorted cluster order
ordered_genes <- unique(top15_markers$gene)

# FIX: We use ordered_genes directly here. No rev() needed!
genes_for_heatmap <- ordered_genes

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Scale Data layer (Only on the selected features to save memory/time)
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
amnion_seurat_object <- ScaleData(amnion_seurat_object, features = genes_for_heatmap)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Generate the Diagonal Heatmap (Top-Left to Bottom-Right)
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
p_heatmap <- DoHeatmap(
  subset(amnion_seurat_object, downsample = 200), 
  features = genes_for_heatmap, 
  group.by = "cell_type",
  size = 4,          
  angle = 45         
) + 
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = c("purple", "black", "yellow")) + 
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 4, face = "italic"), 
    legend.position = "right"
  )

# 7. Save the figure
output_path <- file.path(output_dir, "Supplementary_Top15_Markers_Heatmap.png")
#ggsave(filename = output_path, plot = p_heatmap, width = 12, height = 18, dpi = 300)

print(paste("Perfect top-left to bottom-right heatmap saved to:", output_path))
```

## ED7 marker validation

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggrastr)
library(shadowtext)
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)

# =============================================================================
# Extended Data Figure 7 -- Marker gene validation of cell type annotations
# 180 x 200 mm
#
# v4: coord_fixed(ratio = 1) on every UMAP, so the reference plot and the 24
# feature plots all render at the true data aspect and therefore look identical
# in shape. Previously the reference was stretched across the full 180 mm in a
# 42 mm tall box while the feature plots were near square.
#
# With the aspect locked, the reference UMAP occupies only the width it needs
# and the numbered key moves back to its right.
# =============================================================================

BASE_PT   <- 7
PAIR_COLS <- 3      # cell type pairs per row (3 pairs = 6 feature plots)
si_dir    <- "SI_Figure_Celltypeconfirmation"
dir.create(si_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ---- 1. Marker panel ---------------------------------------------------------
marker_sets <- list(
  "Cytotrophoblast (CTB)"       = c("FGFR2", "PEG3"),
  "Decidual cells"              = c("PRL", "WT1"),
  "Endometrial cells"           = c("HNF1B", "PAEP"),
  "Epithelial cells"            = c("KRT24", "MUC16"),
  "Extravillous trophoblast"    = c("GCM1", "PAPPA2"),
  "Fibroblasts"                 = c("ACTA2", "PRRX1"),
  "Haematopoietic stem cells"   = c("VEGFC", "VWF"),
  "Lymphatic endothelial (LED)" = c("LYVE1", "PROX1"),
  "Macrophages"                 = c("CD163", "MS4A6A"),
  "Natural killer cells"        = c("GNLY", "NCAM1"),
  "Stromal cells"               = c("COL1A1", "PDGFRA"),
  "T cells (resting)"           = c("BCL11B", "CD2"))

all_genes <- unlist(marker_sets, use.names = FALSE)
present   <- intersect(all_genes, rownames(amnion_seurat_object))
cat("Markers requested:", length(all_genes), "| present:", length(present), "\n")
if (length(setdiff(all_genes, present))) {
  cat("NOT FOUND:\n"); print(setdiff(all_genes, present))
}
marker_sets <- lapply(marker_sets, function(g) intersect(g, present))
marker_sets <- marker_sets[lengths(marker_sets) > 0]

# ---- 2. Reference UMAP + key -------------------------------------------------
amnion_seurat_object[["Cell Type"]] <- amnion_seurat_object$cell_type %>%
  str_replace_all("_", " ") %>% str_replace_all("[0-9]", "") %>%
  str_replace_all("Macrophage- Mother", "Macrophage Mother") %>%
  str_replace_all("Macrophage- Fetus",  "Macrophage Fetus") %>% str_squish()

ct_levels <- sort(unique(amnion_seurat_object$`Cell Type`))
amnion_seurat_object$`Cell Type` <- factor(amnion_seurat_object$`Cell Type`,
                                           levels = ct_levels)
legend_labels <- paste0(seq_along(ct_levels), "  ", ct_levels)

umap_df <- data.frame(Embeddings(amnion_seurat_object, "umap")[, 1:2],
                      cell_type = amnion_seurat_object$`Cell Type`)
colnames(umap_df)[1:2] <- c("UMAP_1", "UMAP_2")

centroids <- umap_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(cell_type) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(UMAP_1 = median(UMAP_1), UMAP_2 = median(UMAP_2),
                   .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(label = as.integer(factor(cell_type, levels = ct_levels)))

set.seed(123)
ref_df <- umap_df[sample(nrow(umap_df)), ]

# harvest a two-column vertical key
p_ref_full <- ggplot(ref_df, aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2, colour = cell_type)) +
  rasterise(geom_point(size = 0.2, alpha = 0.6, stroke = 0), dpi = 900) +
  scale_colour_discrete(labels = legend_labels) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(ncol = 2,
                               override.aes = list(size = 1.1),
                               keyheight = unit(2.6, "mm"),
                               keywidth  = unit(2.4, "mm"))) +
  theme_ncb(base_size = BASE_PT) +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.text  = element_text(size = 6.5),
        legend.position = "right",
        legend.spacing.x = unit(0.5, "mm"))

key_only <- tryCatch(
  cowplot::get_plot_component(p_ref_full, "guide-box-right", return_all = TRUE),
  error = function(e) cowplot::get_legend(p_ref_full))

p_ref <- ggplot(ref_df, aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2, colour = cell_type)) +
  rasterise(geom_point(size = 0.2, alpha = 0.6, stroke = 0), dpi = 900) +
  geom_shadowtext(data = centroids,
                  aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2, label = label),
                  inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 6.5 / .pt, fontface = "bold",
                  colour = "black", bg.colour = "white", bg.r = 0.15) +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1) +                 # <<< true data aspect
  theme_ncb(base_size = BASE_PT) +
  labs(x = "UMAP 1", y = "UMAP 2") +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text   = element_text(size = 6.5),
        plot.margin = margin(0, 1, 0, 1, "mm"))

# reference row: UMAP left, key right
ref_row <- p_ref + cowplot::ggdraw(key_only) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(0.42, 0.58))

# ---- 3. Feature plots --------------------------------------------------------
expr_all <- FetchData(amnion_seurat_object, vars = present)
expr_max <- max(as.matrix(expr_all), na.rm = TRUE)

make_feature <- function(gene) {
  d <- data.frame(Embeddings(amnion_seurat_object, "umap")[, 1:2],
                  expr = FetchData(amnion_seurat_object, vars = gene)[, 1])
  colnames(d)[1:2] <- c("UMAP_1", "UMAP_2")
  d <- d[order(d$expr), ]

  ggplot(d, aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2, colour = expr)) +
    rasterise(geom_point(size = 0.18, stroke = 0), dpi = 900) +
    scale_colour_gradient(low = "grey88", high = "#3B0F70",
                          limits = c(0, expr_max)) +
    coord_fixed(ratio = 1) +               # <<< same aspect as the reference
    theme_void(base_size = BASE_PT) +
    theme(plot.title      = element_text(size = BASE_PT - 0.5, hjust = 0.5,
                                         face = "italic", family = FONT,
                                         margin = margin(b = 0.2, unit = "mm")),
          legend.position = "none",
          plot.margin     = margin(0.2, 0.2, 0.2, 0.2, "mm")) +
    labs(title = gene)
}

# ---- 4. Gene pairs under cell type subheaders -------------------------------
make_pair <- function(ct, genes) {
  inner <- wrap_plots(lapply(genes, make_feature), ncol = 2)
  wrap_elements(
    inner +
      plot_annotation(
        title = ct,
        theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(
          size = BASE_PT, hjust = 0.5, family = FONT, face = "plain",
          margin = margin(t = 0.5, b = 0.3, unit = "mm")))))
}

pair_plots    <- Map(make_pair, names(marker_sets), marker_sets)
grid_features <- wrap_plots(pair_plots, ncol = PAIR_COLS)

cat("Cell type groups:", length(pair_plots), "|", PAIR_COLS, "per row ->",
    ceiling(length(pair_plots) / PAIR_COLS), "rows\n")

# ---- 5. Shared expression colourbar -----------------------------------------
p_scale <- ggplot(data.frame(x = 1, y = 1, e = c(0, expr_max)),
                  aes(x, y, colour = e)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_colour_gradient(low = "grey88", high = "#3B0F70",
                        limits = c(0, expr_max), name = "Expression") +
  guides(colour = guide_colourbar(barwidth = unit(24, "mm"),
                                  barheight = unit(2, "mm"),
                                  title.position = "left",
                                  ticks.linewidth = 0.2)) +
  theme_void(base_size = BASE_PT) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.title    = element_text(size = BASE_PT, family = FONT, vjust = 1),
        legend.text     = element_text(size = BASE_PT, family = FONT))

scale_only <- tryCatch(
  cowplot::get_plot_component(p_scale, "guide-box-bottom", return_all = TRUE),
  error = function(e) cowplot::get_legend(p_scale))

# ---- 6. Assemble -------------------------------------------------------------
p_final <- ref_row /
           grid_features /
           cowplot::ggdraw(scale_only) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(0.26, 0.70, 0.04))


save_panel(p_final, file.path(si_dir, "ED7_marker_validation"),
           width_mm = 180, height_mm = 200, source_data = FALSE)

sd_add("ED7_marker_genes",
       data.frame(cell_type = rep(names(marker_sets), lengths(marker_sets)),
                  gene      = unlist(marker_sets, use.names = FALSE)))

print(p_final)
```


### Quality Plots from Parse

## ED8 QC cascade

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# =============================================================================
# Extended Data Figure 8 -- Per-sample quality control
#
# Replaces the 5-page Trailmaker QC output (36 samples x 4 diagnostic plots)
# with three panels built from the filtering cascade in Extended Data Table 2:
#
#   a  nuclei retained at each filtering step, one line per sample (log scale)
#   b  percentage of nuclei removed at each step, per sample (heatmap)
#   c  nuclei retained in the final dataset, per sample
#
# Every sample is still shown individually, on one page instead of five.
#
# All dplyr verbs are namespaced: select() is masked by AnnotationDbi (loaded
# via org.Hs.eg.db for the enrichment analysis), and count()/filter() by other
# Bioconductor packages. A silent mask gives wrong results rather than an error.
# =============================================================================

BASE_PT <- 7
si_dir  <- "SI_Figure_QC"
dir.create(si_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

xlsx_path <- "Supplementary_Data_Table.xlsx"

# ---- 1. Read the cascade table ----------------------------------------------
raw <- read_excel(xlsx_path, sheet = "Extended Data Table 2",
                  col_names = FALSE, .name_repair = "minimal")

hdr_row <- which(apply(raw, 1, function(r)
  any(trimws(as.character(r)) == "Sample", na.rm = TRUE)))[1]

qc <- read_excel(xlsx_path, sheet = "Extended Data Table 2",
                 skip = hdr_row - 1, .name_repair = "unique")
qc <- qc[, colSums(!is.na(qc)) > 0, drop = FALSE]
names(qc)[1] <- "Sample"

# keep only genuine sample rows: must name a tissue layer, must not be a total
qc <- qc %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Sample),
                !str_detect(Sample, regex("total", ignore_case = TRUE)),
                str_detect(Sample, "Amnion|Chorion"))

cat("Samples read:", nrow(qc), "(expected 36)\n")
print(names(qc))

count_cols <- names(qc)[!str_detect(names(qc), "Change") & names(qc) != "Sample"]
pct_cols   <- names(qc)[ str_detect(names(qc), "Change")]

step_labels <- c("Raw", "Cell size", "Mitochondrial",
                 "Genes vs\ntranscripts", "Doublet", "Unscored\n(NA)")
if (length(count_cols) != length(step_labels))
  warning("Expected 6 count columns, found ", length(count_cols))

# ---- 2. Annotate each sample -------------------------------------------------
qc <- qc %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    layer = dplyr::case_when(
      str_detect(Sample, "Amnion")  ~ "Amnion",
      str_detect(Sample, "Chorion") ~ "Chorion",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_),
    group = dplyr::case_when(
      str_detect(Sample, "25")                        ~ "Week 25",
      str_detect(Sample, "30")                        ~ "Week 30",
      str_detect(Sample, "Preeclampsia|Preeclmapisa") ~ "Week 34 (PE)",
      str_detect(Sample, "34")                        ~ "Week 34",
      str_detect(Sample, "Placenta")                  ~ "Week 38 (placenta)",
      str_detect(Sample, "38")                        ~ "Week 38",
      TRUE ~ "Other"),
    short = Sample %>%
      str_replace_all("Week,? ?", "W") %>%
      str_replace_all("Amnion",  "Am") %>%
      str_replace_all("Chorion", "Ch") %>%
      str_replace_all("Placenta ?Donor", "Pl") %>%
      str_replace_all("Preeclampsia|Preeclmapisa", "PE") %>%
      str_replace_all("Donor ?", "D") %>%
      str_replace_all(",", "") %>% str_squish())

cat("\nGroups assigned:\n")
print(table(qc$group, qc$layer, useNA = "ifany"))

if (any(qc$group == "Other") || any(is.na(qc$layer))) {
  cat("\n!! Rows that failed annotation:\n")
  print(qc %>% dplyr::filter(group == "Other" | is.na(layer)) %>%
          dplyr::select(Sample))
}

# ---- 3. Panel a: filtering cascade -------------------------------------------
cascade <- qc %>%
  dplyr::select(short, layer, group, dplyr::all_of(count_cols)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(dplyr::all_of(count_cols),
                      names_to = "step_raw", values_to = "n") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(step = factor(step_raw, levels = count_cols,
                              labels = step_labels),
                n = as.numeric(n))

p_a <- ggplot(cascade, aes(x = step, y = n, group = short, colour = group)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.25, alpha = 0.75) +
  geom_point(size = 0.5, stroke = 0, alpha = 0.75) +
  facet_wrap(~layer, ncol = 2) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = scales::label_number(
                  big.mark = ",", scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale()),
                breaks = c(10, 100, 1000, 10000, 100000)) +
  scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 1,
                               override.aes = list(linewidth = 0.8, size = 1))) +
  theme_ncb(base_size = BASE_PT) +
  theme(axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1,
                                       size = BASE_PT),
        strip.text      = element_text(size = BASE_PT,
                                       margin = margin(1, 1, 1, 1, "mm")),
        panel.border    = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA,
                                       linewidth = 0.25),
        legend.position = "top",
        legend.title    = element_blank(),
        legend.key.size = unit(3, "mm"),
        legend.margin   = margin(t = -1, b = -2, unit = "mm")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Nuclei retained")

# ---- 4. Panel b: percentage removed at each step -----------------------------
pct <- qc %>%
  dplyr::select(short, layer, group, dplyr::all_of(pct_cols)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(dplyr::all_of(pct_cols),
                      names_to = "step_raw", values_to = "pct") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(step  = factor(step_raw, levels = pct_cols,
                               labels = step_labels[-1]),
                pct   = abs(as.numeric(pct)),
                short = factor(short, levels = rev(sort(unique(qc$short)))))

p_b <- ggplot(pct, aes(x = step, y = short, fill = pct)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "rocket", direction = -1,
                       limits = c(0, 100), breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100)) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  guides(fill = guide_colourbar(barwidth = unit(2.5, "mm"),
                                barheight = unit(20, "mm"),
                                ticks.linewidth = 0.2)) +
  theme_ncb(base_size = BASE_PT) +
  theme(axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1,
                                    size = BASE_PT),
        axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 5.5),
        panel.grid   = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA,
                                    linewidth = 0.25),
        legend.title = element_text(size = BASE_PT),
        legend.text  = element_text(size = BASE_PT)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "% removed")

# ---- 5. Panel c: final nuclei per sample -------------------------------------
final_col <- count_cols[length(count_cols)]

final_df <- qc %>%
  dplyr::mutate(final = as.numeric(.data[[final_col]])) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(final) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(short = factor(short, levels = short))

p_c <- ggplot(final_df, aes(x = short, y = final, fill = group)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.75, linewidth = 0) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08)),
                     labels = scales::label_number(big.mark = ",")) +
  theme_ncb(base_size = BASE_PT) +
  theme(axis.text.x        = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5,
                                          size = 5.5),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        panel.border       = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA,
                                          linewidth = 0.25),
        legend.position    = "none") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Nuclei in final dataset")

cat("\nTotal nuclei in final dataset:", sum(final_df$final),
    "(should be 59,626)\n")

# ---- 6. Assemble -------------------------------------------------------------
p_final <- p_a / p_b / p_c +
  plot_layout(heights = c(0.30, 0.45, 0.25)) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a") &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold", family = FONT))

save_panel(p_final, file.path(si_dir, "ED8_QC_cascade"),
           width_mm = 180, height_mm = 200)

print(p_final)

cat("\nSaved to", si_dir, "\n")

```

# Supplementary tables

All supplementary tables are written here to a single Excel workbook, one sheet
per table. Tables 1 and 2 were prepared separately and are carried over from
`Supplementary_Data_Table.xlsx`.

```{r supplementary-tables}
library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(stringr)
library(writexl); library(readxl); library(purrr)

supp <- list()

## ---- Table 3: donor and sample characteristics ------------------------------
supp[["Supplementary Table 3"]] <- amnion_seurat_object@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::group_by(samples, Donor_Nr, layer, tissue_source,
                  timepoint, gestational_timepoint) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    `Nuclei retained`                   = dplyr::n(),
    `Median transcripts per nucleus`    = round(median(nCount_RNA)),
    `Median genes per nucleus`          = round(median(nFeature_RNA)),
    `Maximum mitochondrial content (%)` = round(max(percent.mt, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    `Fetal sex` = NA_character_,        # <<< fill in from the donor records
    `Excluded from cell type proportion analysis` =
      ifelse(Donor_Nr %in% c(1003, 1004), "Yes", "No")) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(layer, timepoint, Donor_Nr) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Sample = samples, `Donor number` = Donor_Nr,
                `Tissue layer` = layer, `Tissue source` = tissue_source,
                `Gestational age` = timepoint,
                `Gestational group` = gestational_timepoint)

## ---- Table 4: cell type marker genes ----------------------------------------
if (exists("all_markers")) {
  supp[["Supplementary Table 4"]] <- all_markers %>%
    dplyr::group_by(cluster) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(avg_log2FC), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Rank = dplyr::row_number()) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(`Cell type` = cluster, Gene = gene, Rank,
                  `Average log2 fold change` = avg_log2FC,
                  `Fraction expressing in cell type` = pct.1,
                  `Fraction expressing elsewhere` = pct.2,
                  `P value` = p_val, `Adjusted P value` = p_val_adj)
} else message("Table 4 skipped: `all_markers` not found")

## ---- Table 5: functional enrichment, all databases --------------------------
if (exists("enrich_df")) {
  supp[["Supplementary Table 5"]] <- enrich_df %>%
    dplyr::arrange(database, cell_type, direction, p.adjust) %>%
    dplyr::select(Database = database, `Cell type` = cell_type,
                  Direction = direction, Term = Description,
                  `Gene ratio` = GeneRatio, `Background ratio` = BgRatio,
                  `P value` = pvalue, `Adjusted P value` = p.adjust,
                  `Q value` = qvalue, `Gene count` = Count, Genes = geneID)
} else message("Table 5 skipped: `enrich_df` not found")

## ---- Table 6: cell-cell communication ---------------------------------------
if (exists("cell_cell_communication")) {
  supp[["Supplementary Table 6"]] <- cell_cell_communication
} else message("Table 6 skipped: `cell_cell_communication` not found")

## ---- Table 7: differential expression, term vs mid-gestation ----------------
if (exists("de_df")) {
  supp[["Supplementary Table 7"]] <- de_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(p_val_adj < 0.05) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Direction = ifelse(avg_log2FC > 0,
                                     "Higher at week 38", "Higher at week 25")) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(CellType, p_val_adj)
} else message("Table 7 skipped: `de_df` not found")

## ---- Table 8: differential expression, preeclampsia vs healthy --------------
if (exists("results_list")) {
  supp[["Supplementary Table 8"]] <- purrr::map_dfr(
    names(results_list), function(ct) {
      d <- results_list[[ct]]
      if (is.null(d) || !nrow(d)) return(NULL)
      d$cell_type <- ct; d }) %>%
    dplyr::filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(cell_type, adj.P.Val)
} else message("Table 8 skipped: `results_list` not found")

## ---- carry over Tables 1 and 2 ----------------------------------------------
if (file.exists("Supplementary_Data_Table.xlsx")) {
  for (s in readxl::excel_sheets("Supplementary_Data_Table.xlsx")) {
    supp[[s]] <- readxl::read_excel("Supplementary_Data_Table.xlsx",
                                    sheet = s, .name_repair = "minimal")

}

writexl::write_xlsx(supp, "Supplementary_Tables.xlsx")

cat("\nSupplementary_Tables.xlsx --", length(supp), "sheets\n")
for (nm in names(supp)) cat(sprintf("  %-30s %6d rows\n", nm, nrow(supp[[nm]])))
```

# Source data

Source data are reported per figure panel. For every boxplot of module scores or
gene expression, the sheet gives the **donor-level mean for each cell type at
each gestational timepoint** together with the **statistical comparison**
(two-sided Welch t-test on donor means, with Cohen's d). For the histology
quantifications the sheet gives the **individual image measurements** as well as
the donor means, satisfying the requirement that source data for all repeats be
provided.

```{r source-data-helpers}
library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(rstatix); library(stringr)

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## Donor-level summary + statistics for a module score or a single gene
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
sd_module <- function(obj, score_col, label,
                      cell_types = NULL,
                      timepoints = c("Week_25", "Week_38"),
                      rename_map = NULL) {

  stopifnot(score_col %in% colnames(obj@meta.data))

  md <- obj@meta.data %>%
    dplyr::select(Donor_Nr, cell_type, timepoint,
                  score = dplyr::all_of(score_col)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(timepoint %in% timepoints)

  if (!is.null(cell_types)) md <- md %>% dplyr::filter(cell_type %in% cell_types)
  if (!is.null(rename_map))
    md <- md %>% dplyr::mutate(cell_type = dplyr::recode(cell_type, !!!rename_map))

  ## donor-level means -- one row per donor x cell type x timepoint
  donor <- md %>%
    dplyr::group_by(cell_type, timepoint, Donor_Nr) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(mean_score = mean(score, na.rm = TRUE),
                     n_nuclei   = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::arrange(cell_type, timepoint, Donor_Nr)

  ## statistics per cell type
  stats <- donor %>%
    dplyr::group_by(cell_type) %>%
    dplyr::filter(dplyr::n_distinct(timepoint) == 2,
                  min(table(timepoint)) >= 2) %>%
    dplyr::group_modify(~{
      tt <- t.test(mean_score ~ timepoint, data = .x, var.equal = FALSE)
      m  <- .x %>% dplyr::group_by(timepoint) %>%
              dplyr::summarise(m = mean(mean_score), s = sd(mean_score),
                               n = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop")
      sp <- sqrt(((m$n[1]-1)*m$s[1]^2 + (m$n[2]-1)*m$s[2]^2) / (sum(m$n)-2))
      tibble::tibble(
        n_week25   = m$n[1],            n_week38   = m$n[2],
        mean_week25= m$m[1],            mean_week38= m$m[2],
        sd_week25  = m$s[1],            sd_week38  = m$s[2],
        t_statistic= unname(tt$statistic), df = unname(tt$parameter),
        p_value    = tt$p.value,
        cohens_d   = (m$m[1]-m$m[2]) / sp)
    }) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(p_adjusted = p.adjust(p_value, "BH"),
                  significance = cut(p_adjusted, c(-Inf,.001,.01,.05,Inf),
                                     c("***","**","*","ns")))

  sd_add(paste0(label, "_donor_values"), donor)
  sd_add(paste0(label, "_statistics"),   as.data.frame(stats))
  invisible(list(donor = donor, stats = stats))
}

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## Histology: individual images, donor means, and the comparison
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
sd_histology <- function(per_image, per_donor, label) {
  tt <- t.test(Percent_Positive ~ Timepoint, data = per_donor, var.equal = FALSE)
  m  <- per_donor %>% dplyr::group_by(Timepoint) %>%
          dplyr::summarise(m = mean(Percent_Positive),
                           s = sd(Percent_Positive), n = dplyr::n(),
                           .groups = "drop")
  sp <- sqrt(((m$n[1]-1)*m$s[1]^2 + (m$n[2]-1)*m$s[2]^2) / (sum(m$n)-2))

  sd_add(paste0(label, "_raw_images"),  as.data.frame(per_image))
  sd_add(paste0(label, "_donor_means"), as.data.frame(per_donor))
  sd_add(paste0(label, "_statistics"), data.frame(
    comparison   = "Week 38 vs Week 25",
    test         = "Two-sided Welch t-test on donor means",
    n_week25     = m$n[1],      n_week38     = m$n[2],
    mean_week25  = m$m[1],      mean_week38  = m$m[2],
    sd_week25    = m$s[1],      sd_week38    = m$s[2],
    t_statistic  = unname(tt$statistic), df = unname(tt$parameter),
    p_value      = tt$p.value,
    cohens_d     = (m$m[1]-m$m[2]) / sp))
}

## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## Donor-level expression of a set of genes (collagen / growth factor panels)
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
sd_genes <- function(obj, genes, label, cell_type = NULL,
                     timepoints = c("Week_25", "Week_38")) {

  genes <- intersect(genes, rownames(obj))
  o <- if (is.null(cell_type)) obj else
         subset(obj, cells = colnames(obj)[obj$cell_type == cell_type])

  d <- FetchData(o, vars = c(genes, "timepoint", "Donor_Nr")) %>%
    dplyr::filter(timepoint %in% timepoints) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(dplyr::all_of(genes),
                        names_to = "gene", values_to = "expression")

  donor <- d %>%
    dplyr::group_by(gene, timepoint, Donor_Nr) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(mean_expression = mean(expression, na.rm = TRUE),
                     n_nuclei = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::arrange(gene, timepoint, Donor_Nr)

  stats <- donor %>%
    dplyr::group_by(gene) %>%
    dplyr::filter(dplyr::n_distinct(timepoint) == 2,
                  min(table(timepoint)) >= 2,
                  sd(mean_expression) > 0) %>%
    dplyr::group_modify(~{
      tt <- t.test(mean_expression ~ timepoint, data = .x, var.equal = FALSE)
      m  <- .x %>% dplyr::group_by(timepoint) %>%
              dplyr::summarise(m = mean(mean_expression),
                               s = sd(mean_expression), n = dplyr::n(),
                               .groups = "drop")
      sp <- sqrt(((m$n[1]-1)*m$s[1]^2 + (m$n[2]-1)*m$s[2]^2) / (sum(m$n)-2))
      tibble::tibble(n_week25 = m$n[1], n_week38 = m$n[2],
                     mean_week25 = m$m[1], mean_week38 = m$m[2],
                     t_statistic = unname(tt$statistic), df = unname(tt$parameter),
                     p_value = tt$p.value, cohens_d = (m$m[1]-m$m[2]) / sp)
    }) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(p_adjusted = p.adjust(p_value, "BH"),
                  significance = cut(p_adjusted, c(-Inf,.001,.01,.05,Inf),
                                     c("***","**","*","ns")))

  sd_add(paste0(label, "_donor_values"), as.data.frame(donor))
  sd_add(paste0(label, "_statistics"),   as.data.frame(stats))
  invisible(list(donor = donor, stats = stats))
}
```

## Histology quantifications

```{r source-data-histology}
## Each sheet carries the individual image measurements AND the donor means,
## so that all repeats behind every plotted point are available.
read_hist <- function(csv, mode, exclude = NULL) {
  d <- readr::read_csv(csv, show_col_types = FALSE)
  if ("Classification" %in% names(d)) d <- dplyr::filter(d, is.na(Classification))
  if (!is.null(exclude)) d <- dplyr::filter(d, !stringr::str_detect(Image, fixed(exclude)))
  d <- d %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Timepoint = ifelse(stringr::str_detect(Image,"HT"),"Week 38","Week 25"),
                  Donor_raw = stringr::str_split_i(Image," - ",1)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Timepoint) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Donor = paste0("Donor_", as.integer(
      factor(Donor_raw, levels = unique(Donor_raw))))) %>% dplyr::ungroup()

  if (mode == "count") {
    per_image <- d %>% dplyr::transmute(Image, Donor, Timepoint,
      Num_positive = as.numeric(`Num Positive`),
      Num_detected = as.numeric(`Num Detections`),
      Percent_Positive = Num_positive / Num_detected * 100)
    per_donor <- per_image %>% dplyr::group_by(Donor, Timepoint) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(Total_positive = sum(Num_positive),
                       Total_detected = sum(Num_detected), .groups="drop") %>%
      dplyr::mutate(Percent_Positive = Total_positive/Total_detected*100)
  } else {
    per_image <- d %>% dplyr::transmute(Image, Donor, Timepoint,
      Positive_area = `First_Collagen12: Positive area µm^2`,
      Negative_area = `First_Collagen12: Negative area µm^2`,
      Percent_Positive = Positive_area/(Positive_area+Negative_area)*100)
    per_donor <- per_image %>% dplyr::group_by(Donor, Timepoint) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(Percent_Positive = mean(Percent_Positive), .groups="drop")
  }
  list(per_image = per_image, per_donor = per_donor)
}

h <- read_hist("HSPA2_measurements.csv", "count", "250414_HSPA2.czi")
sd_histology(h$per_image, h$per_donor, "Fig2d_HSPA2")

h <- read_hist("Col12_measurements.csv", "area")
sd_histology(h$per_image, h$per_donor, "Fig4f_ColXII")

h <- read_hist("CD163_measurements.csv", "count", "2025_11_17_250414_MMC1_CD163.czi")
sd_histology(h$per_image, h$per_donor, "Fig5e_CD163")
```

## Combined statistics table

```{r source-data-combined-stats}
## Every statistical comparison in the manuscript, in the format of
## Extended Data Table 1.
stat_sheets <- ls(.source_data)
stat_sheets <- stat_sheets[grepl("_statistics$", stat_sheets)]

combined <- purrr::map_dfr(stat_sheets, function(s) {
  d <- .source_data[[s]]
  tibble::tibble(
    Figure   = sub("_.*$", "", s),
    Panel    = sub("_statistics$", "", s),
    Group    = if ("cell_type" %in% names(d)) as.character(d$cell_type)
               else if ("gene" %in% names(d)) as.character(d$gene) else NA_character_,
    `t-statistic` = round(d$t_statistic, 2),
    df            = round(d$df, 2),
    `P-value`     = signif(d$p_value, 3),
    `Adjusted P`  = if ("p_adjusted" %in% names(d)) signif(d$p_adjusted, 3) else NA,
    `Cohen's d`   = round(d$cohens_d, 2))
}) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(`P-value`)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Figure, Panel, Group)

sd_add("ALL_statistics", as.data.frame(combined))

cat("\nCombined statistics:", nrow(combined), "comparisons across",
    dplyr::n_distinct(combined$Panel), "panels\n")
print(head(as.data.frame(combined), 15))
```

```{r}
## Every statistical comparison in the manuscript, in the format of
## Extended Data Table 1. Handles both column conventions in use:
##   panel helpers      -> t_statistic / p_value / p_adjusted
##   Extended Data      -> statistic   / p       / p.adj
pick <- function(d, ...) {
  for (nm in c(...)) if (nm %in% names(d)) return(d[[nm]])
  rep(NA_real_, nrow(d))
}
pick_chr <- function(d, ...) {
  for (nm in c(...)) if (nm %in% names(d)) return(as.character(d[[nm]]))
  rep(NA_character_, nrow(d))
}

stat_sheets <- ls(.source_data)
stat_sheets <- stat_sheets[grepl("_statistics$", stat_sheets)]

combined <- purrr::map_dfr(stat_sheets, function(s) {
  d <- .source_data[[s]]
  if (!nrow(d)) return(NULL)
  tibble::tibble(
    Figure = sub("_.*$", "", s),
    Panel  = sub("_statistics$", "", s),
    Group  = pick_chr(d, "cell_type", "Cell Type", "gene", "Origin",
                      "module", "set"),
    Subgroup = if ("module" %in% names(d) && "cell_type" %in% names(d))
                 as.character(d$module) else NA_character_,
    `n group 1`   = pick(d, "n1", "n_week25"),
    `n group 2`   = pick(d, "n2", "n_week38"),
    `t-statistic` = round(pick(d, "t_statistic", "statistic"), 2),
    df            = round(pick(d, "df"), 2),
    `P-value`     = signif(pick(d, "p_value", "p"), 3),
    `Adjusted P`  = signif(pick(d, "p_adjusted", "p.adj"), 3),
    `Cohen's d`   = round(pick(d, "cohens_d"), 2),
    Test          = pick_chr(d, "test"))
}) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(`P-value`)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Figure, Panel, Group)

sd_add("ALL_statistics", as.data.frame(combined))

cat("\nCombined statistics:", nrow(combined), "comparisons across",
    dplyr::n_distinct(combined$Panel), "panels\n")
print(head(as.data.frame(combined), 15))
```


```{r write-source-data}
sd_write("Source_Data.xlsx")
```
